              "file": "scripts/check_regression.py",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/check_regression.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/check_regression.py\t\n+++ scripts/check_regression.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@\n+\"\"\"Gate 5 — regression gate (D7 §6.5).\n+\n+Runs after the full suite. Parses the ``pytest -q`` summary and enforces a committed\n+baseline so deletions of tests, new skips, or unexpected deselections block the PR.\n+The baseline is ``scripts/test_baseline.txt`` (a single integer = minimum passing +\n+skipped count); bump it deliberately in a reviewed PR when tests are legitimately\n+added.\n+\n+Usage:\n+    python -m pytest -q | python scripts/check_regression.py\n+    python -m pytest -q --junitxml=/tmp/out.xml  # (not needed; reads stdin summary)\n+\n+The simplest robust usage is:\n+    python -m pytest -q | tee /tmp/pytest.out\n+    python scripts/check_regression.py /tmp/pytest.out\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import re\n+import sys\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n+BASELINE_PATH = ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"test_baseline.txt\"\n+\n+_PASSED = re.compile(r\"(\\d+) passed\")\n+_SKIPPED = re.compile(r\"(\\d+) skipped\")\n+_FAILED = re.compile(r\"(\\d+) failed\")\n+_ERROR = re.compile(r\"(\\d+) error\")\n+\n+\n+def load_baseline() -> int:\n+    for line in BASELINE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines():\n+        line = line.strip()\n+        if line and not line.startswith(\"#\"):\n+            return int(line)\n+    raise ValueError(f\"no baseline value in {BASELINE_PATH}\")\n+\n+\n+def parse_summary(text: str) -> tuple[int, int]:\n+    passed = int(m.group(1)) if (m := _PASSED.search(text)) else 0\n+    skipped = int(m.group(1)) if (m := _SKIPPED.search(text)) else 0\n+    return passed, skipped\n+\n+\n+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n+    if len(argv) < 2:\n+        print(\"usage: check_regression.py <pytest-output-file>\", file=sys.stderr)\n+        return 2\n+    text = Path(argv[1]).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+\n+    if _FAILED.search(text) or _ERROR.search(text):\n+        print(\"[regression] BLOCKED: pytest reported failures/errors (see job log).\")\n+        return 1\n+\n+    baseline = load_baseline()\n+    passed, skipped = parse_summary(text)\n+    total = passed + skipped\n+\n+    if total < baseline:\n+        print(\n+            f\"[regression] BLOCKED: {total} passed+skipped < baseline {baseline} \"\n+            \"(tests deleted or newly skipped).\"\n+        )\n+        return 1\n+\n+    print(f\"[regression] OK: {passed} passed + {skipped} skipped = {total} >= {baseline}\")\n+    return 0\n+\n+\n+if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n+    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",
              "additions": 73,
              "deletions": 0,
              "status": "added"
            },
            {
              "file": "scripts/check_req_schema.py",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/check_req_schema.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/check_req_schema.py\t\n+++ scripts/check_req_schema.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@\n+\"\"\"Gate 3 — requirements schema gate (D7 §6.3).\n+\n+Validates ``docs/req/requirements.yaml`` against ``docs/req/req-schema.json`` using\n+the JSON-Schema Draft 2020-12 validator. The inputs are a scaffold today: the schema\n+is the team's compact proposal and the registry is seeded minimal, so the gate runs\n+meaningfully from day one and tightens as A fills the registry in.\n+\n+Usage:\n+    python scripts/check_req_schema.py\n+\n+Exit 0 when the registry validates, exit 1 (with the validator errors) when it does\n+not, exit 2 when an input file is missing (setup defect, not a content defect).\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import json\n+import sys\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+import yaml\n+from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator\n+\n+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n+SCHEMA_PATH = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"req\" / \"req-schema.json\"\n+REGISTRY_PATH = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"req\" / \"requirements.yaml\"\n+\n+\n+def main() -> int:\n+    if not SCHEMA_PATH.exists():\n+        print(f\"[req-schema] MISSING: {SCHEMA_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)}\", file=sys.stderr)\n+        return 2\n+    if not REGISTRY_PATH.exists():\n+        print(f\"[req-schema] MISSING: {REGISTRY_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)}\", file=sys.stderr)\n+        return 2\n+\n+    schema = json.loads(SCHEMA_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n+    registry = yaml.safe_load(REGISTRY_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n+\n+    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema)\n+    errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(registry), key=lambda e: list(e.path))\n+    if errors:\n+        print(f\"[req-schema] BLOCKED: {len(errors)} validation error(s):\")\n+        for error in errors:\n+            location = \"/\".join(str(p) for p in error.path) or \"<root>\"\n+            print(f\"    - {location}: {error.message}\")\n+        return 1\n+\n+    count = len(registry) if isinstance(registry, list) else \"?\"\n+    print(f\"[req-schema] OK: {count} requirement(s) validate against the schema\")\n+    return 0\n+\n+\n+if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n+    raise SystemExit(main())\n",
              "additions": 55,
              "deletions": 0,
              "status": "added"
            },
            {
              "file": "scripts/check_semantic_eval.py",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/check_semantic_eval.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/check_semantic_eval.py\t\n+++ scripts/check_semantic_eval.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@\n+\"\"\"Gate 4 — semantic evaluation gate (D7 §6.4).\n+\n+For any PR that touches prompts or models, replay a fixed evaluation set and assert\n+each case meets its quality threshold. The eval set and cases are scaffolded minimal\n+today (deterministic, offline); B fills in real prompts + cases + thresholds later.\n+The gate is change-scoped: it only runs its checks when a gated prompt/model path\n+changed, so unrelated PRs are not slowed.\n+\n+Usage:\n+    python scripts/check_semantic_eval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n+\n+Exit 0 when no prompt/model change or when every case passes; exit 1 when a case\n+falls below its threshold.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import sys\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+import yaml\n+from gate_common import changed\n+\n+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n+EVAL_PATH = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"eval\" / \"semantic-eval.yaml\"\n+PROMPT_PREFIXES = (\"prompts/\", \"src/\")\n+\n+\n+def _touches_prompts_or_models(paths: list[str]) -> bool:\n+    for path in paths:\n+        if path.startswith(\"prompts/\"):\n+            return True\n+        if path.startswith(\"src/\") and (\"prompt\" in path or \"model\" in path):\n+            return True\n+    return False\n+\n+\n+def _score(output: str, expected: str) -> float:\n+    \"\"\"Deterministic offline score: fraction of expected keywords present.\"\"\"\n+    keywords = [w for w in expected.split() if w]\n+    if not keywords:\n+        return 1.0\n+    hits = sum(1 for kw in keywords if kw.lower() in output.lower())\n+    return hits / len(keywords)\n+\n+\n+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n+    if len(argv) < 3:\n+        print(\"usage: check_semantic_eval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", file=sys.stderr)\n+        return 2\n+    base, head = argv[1], argv[2]\n+\n+    if not _touches_prompts_or_models(changed(base, head)):\n+        print(\"[semantic-eval] no prompt/model change: skipping\")\n+        return 0\n+\n+    if not EVAL_PATH.exists():\n+        print(f\"[semantic-eval] MISSING: {EVAL_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)}\", file=sys.stderr)\n+        return 2\n+\n+    spec = yaml.safe_load(EVAL_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")) or {}\n+    cases = spec.get(\"cases\") or []\n+\n+    failures: list[str] = []\n+    for case in cases:\n+        score = _score(str(case.get(\"output\", \"\")), str(case.get(\"expected\", \"\")))\n+        threshold = float(case.get(\"threshold\", 1.0))\n+        if score < threshold:\n+            failures.append(f\"{case.get('id')}: {score:.2f} < {threshold:.2f}\")\n+\n+    if failures:\n+        print(f\"[semantic-eval] BLOCKED: {len(failures)} case(s) below threshold:\")\n+        for failure in failures:\n+            print(f\"    - {failure}\")\n+        return 1\n+\n+    print(f\"[semantic-eval] OK: {len(cases)} case(s) meet thresholds\")\n+    return 0\n+\n+\n+if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n+    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",
              "additions": 82,
              "deletions": 0,
              "status": "added"
            },

              "file": "scripts/check_test_approval.py",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/check_test_approval.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/check_test_approval.py\t\n+++ scripts/check_test_approval.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@\n+\"\"\"Gate 1 — test-approval gate (D7 §6.1).\n+\n+A PR that changes gated paths (src/, prompts/, scripts/, .github/) must have its\n+tests approved *before* implementation. Approval is recorded in\n+``docs/approvals.yaml`` as a list of approved test paths; this gate blocks a gated\n+PR that does not approve at least one test path.\n+\n+Usage:\n+    python scripts/check_test_approval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n+\n+Exit 0 when the PR passes, exit 1 (with a reason) when blocked. A docs-only PR or a\n+test-only PR (no gated paths) passes without an approval record.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import sys\n+\n+from gate_common import changed, gated, load_yaml\n+\n+APPROVALS_PATH = \"docs/approvals.yaml\"\n+\n+\n+def approved_paths(text: str) -> list[str]:\n+    \"\"\"Return the approved test paths listed in the approvals file.\"\"\"\n+    data = load_yaml(text) or {}\n+    return list(data.get(\"approved_tests\") or [])\n+\n+\n+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n+    if len(argv) < 3:\n+        print(\"usage: check_test_approval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", file=sys.stderr)\n+        return 2\n+    base, head = argv[1], argv[2]\n+\n+    gated_paths = gated(changed(base, head))\n+    if not gated_paths:\n+        print(\"[test-approval] no gated changes: skipping\")\n+        return 0\n+\n+    try:\n+        with open(APPROVALS_PATH, encoding=\"utf-8\") as handle:\n+            text = handle.read()\n+    except FileNotFoundError:\n+        print(f\"[test-approval] BLOCKED: {APPROVALS_PATH} is missing.\")\n+        return 1\n+\n+    approved = approved_paths(text)\n+    if not approved:\n+        print(\"[test-approval] BLOCKED: gated paths changed but no approved tests recorded.\")\n+        for path in gated_paths:\n+            print(f\"    - {path}\")\n+        return 1\n+\n+    print(f\"[test-approval] OK: {len(approved)} approved test path(s)\")\n+    return 0\n+\n+\n+if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n+    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",
              "additions": 60,
              "deletions": 0,
              "status": "added"
            },

              "file": "scripts/gate_common.py",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/gate_common.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/gate_common.py\t\n+++ scripts/gate_common.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@\n+\"\"\"Shared helpers for the CS5351 blocking gates (D7).\n+\n+Stdlib + PyYAML only. Each gate script imports ``changed`` / ``gated`` from here so\n+the diff logic is identical across gates and cannot drift.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import subprocess\n+\n+import yaml\n+\n+GATED_PREFIXES = (\"src/\", \"prompts/\", \"scripts/\", \".github/\")\n+\n+\n+def changed(base: str, head: str, repo: str = \".\") -> list[str]:\n+    \"\"\"Paths changed between base and head (three-dot diff; includes deletions).\"\"\"\n+    result = subprocess.run(\n+        [\"git\", \"diff\", \"--name-only\", \"--diff-filter=ACMRD\", f\"{base}...{head}\"],\n+        cwd=repo,\n+        capture_output=True,\n+        text=True,\n+        check=True,\n+    )\n+    return [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]\n+\n+\n+def gated(paths: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n+    return [p for p in paths if any(p.startswith(prefix) for prefix in GATED_PREFIXES)]\n+\n+\n+def load_yaml(text: str) -> object:\n+    return yaml.safe_load(text) or {}\n",
              "additions": 33,
              "deletions": 0,
              "status": "added"
            },

              "patch": "Index: test/offline/test_ci_gates.py\n===================================================================\n--- test/offline/test_ci_gates.py\t\n+++ test/offline/test_ci_gates.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,177 @@\n+\"\"\"Offline tests for the CS5351 blocking gates (D7 §6.1-6.6).\n+\n+Each gate has at least one negative test (a case that must block) plus a passing\n+case. One test builds a real temporary git repo to exercise the three-dot diff used\n+by the PR-scoped gates. No network, stdlib + PyYAML + jsonschema only.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+import subprocess\n+import sys\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"scripts\"))\n+\n+import check_regression  # noqa: E402\n+import check_semantic_eval  # noqa: E402\n+import check_test_approval  # noqa: E402\n+from check_ai_use_log import _entries, _ids  # noqa: E402\n+from gate_common import GATED_PREFIXES, changed, gated  # noqa: E402\n+\n+# --- Gate 6: AI-use log ------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+NEW_ENTRY = \"\"\"\n+- id: \"60252993-linan-ai-use-99\"\n+  human_reviewed: true\n+\"\"\"\n+UNREVIEWED_ENTRY = \"\"\"\n+- id: \"60252993-linan-ai-use-99\"\n+  human_reviewed: false\n+\"\"\"\n+OLD_ENTRY = \"\"\"\n+- id: \"60252993-linan-ai-use-01\"\n+  human_reviewed: true\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+\n+def _log(*entries: str) -> str:\n+    return \"entries:\\n\" + \"\".join(entries)\n+\n+\n+def _ai_use_gate(base_text: str, head_text: str, changed_paths: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n+    if not gated(changed_paths):\n+        return True, \"docs-only\"\n+    base_ids = _ids(_entries(base_text))\n+    head_entries = _entries(head_text)\n+    head_ids = _ids(head_entries)\n+    if len(head_ids) != len(set(head_ids)):\n+        return False, \"duplicate id\"\n+    new_entries = [e for e in head_entries if e.get(\"id\") not in base_ids]\n+    if not new_entries:\n+        return False, \"no new entry\"\n+    if any(e.get(\"human_reviewed\") is not True for e in new_entries):\n+        return False, \"not human_reviewed\"\n+    return True, \"ok\"\n+\n+\n+def test_ai_use_missing_entry_fails():\n+    assert _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY), [\"src/x.py\"]) == (False, \"no new entry\")\n+\n+\n+def test_ai_use_new_entry_passes():\n+    assert _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY, NEW_ENTRY), [\"src/x.py\"])[0] is True\n+\n+\n+def test_ai_use_docs_only_passes():\n+    assert _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY), [\"docs/x.md\"]) == (True, \"docs-only\")\n+\n+\n+def test_ai_use_duplicate_id_fails():\n+    result = _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY, NEW_ENTRY, NEW_ENTRY), [\"src/x.py\"])\n+    assert result == (False, \"duplicate id\")\n+\n+\n+def test_ai_use_not_human_reviewed_fails():\n+    result = _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY, UNREVIEWED_ENTRY), [\"src/x.py\"])\n+    assert result == (False, \"not human_reviewed\")\n+\n+\n+def test_tests_dir_is_not_gated():\n+    assert _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY), [\"test/x.py\", \"tests/y.py\"])[0] is True\n+\n+\n+# --- Gate 1: test approval ---------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def test_test_approval_no_tests_fails():\n+    assert check_test_approval.approved_paths(\"approved_tests: []\\n\") == []\n+\n+\n+def test_test_approval_lists_paths():\n+    text = \"approved_tests:\\n  - test/offline/test_x.py\\n\"\n+    assert check_test_approval.approved_paths(text) == [\"test/offline/test_x.py\"]\n+\n+\n+# --- Gate 5: regression ------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def test_regression_below_baseline_fails(tmp_path):\n+    out = tmp_path / \"pytest.out\"\n+    out.write_text(\"100 passed, 1 skipped in 1s\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    orig = check_regression.BASELINE_PATH\n+    check_regression.BASELINE_PATH = tmp_path / \"baseline.txt\"\n+    check_regression.BASELINE_PATH.write_text(\"200\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    try:\n+        assert check_regression.main([\"x\", str(out)]) == 1\n+    finally:\n+        check_regression.BASELINE_PATH = orig\n+\n+\n+def test_regression_at_baseline_passes(tmp_path):\n+    out = tmp_path / \"pytest.out\"\n+    out.write_text(\"199 passed, 1 skipped in 1s\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    orig = check_regression.BASELINE_PATH\n+    check_regression.BASELINE_PATH = tmp_path / \"baseline.txt\"\n+    check_regression.BASELINE_PATH.write_text(\"200\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    try:\n+        assert check_regression.main([\"x\", str(out)]) == 0\n+    finally:\n+        check_regression.BASELINE_PATH = orig\n+\n+\n+def test_regression_failures_block(tmp_path):\n+    out = tmp_path / \"pytest.out\"\n+    out.write_text(\"199 passed, 1 failed in 1s\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    assert check_regression.main([\"x\", str(out)]) == 1\n+\n+\n+# --- Gate 4: semantic evaluation ---------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def test_semantic_score_full_match():\n+    assert check_semantic_eval._score(\"bullish trend\", \"bullish trend\") == 1.0\n+\n+\n+def test_semantic_score_partial_below_threshold():\n+    assert check_semantic_eval._score(\"bearish\", \"bullish trend\") == 0.0\n+\n+\n+def test_semantic_change_detection():\n+    assert check_semantic_eval._touches_prompts_or_models([\"prompts/prompt_v1.0.yaml\"])\n+    assert check_semantic_eval._touches_prompts_or_models([\"src/tradingagents/prompts.py\"])\n+    assert not check_semantic_eval._touches_prompts_or_models([\"src/tradingagents/data.py\"])\n+\n+\n+# --- Shared diff: real git repo ----------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def _git(repo: Path,               "content": "\"\"\"Shared helpers for the CS5351 blocking gates (D7).\n\nStdlib + PyYAML only. Each gate script imports ``changed`` / ``gated`` from here so\nthe diff logic is identical across gates and cannot drift.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport subprocess\n\nimport yaml\n\nGATED_PREFIXES = (\"src/\", \"prompts/\", \"scripts/\", \".github/\")\n\n\ndef changed(base: str, head: str, repo: str = \".\") -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Paths changed between base and head (three-dot diff; includes deletions).\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\"git\", \"diff\", \"--name-only\", \"--diff-filter=ACMRD\", f\"{base}...{head}\"],\n        cwd=repo,\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        check=True,\n    )\n    return [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]\n\n\ndef gated(paths: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n    return [p for p in paths if any(p.startswith(prefix) for prefix in GATED_PREFIXES)]\n\n\ndef load_yaml(text: str) -> object:\n    return yaml.safe_load(text) or {}\n",

              "content": "\"\"\"Gate 1 — test-approval gate (D7 §6.1).\n\nA PR that changes gated paths (src/, prompts/, scripts/, .github/) must have its\ntests approved *before* implementation. Approval is recorded in\n``docs/approvals.yaml`` as a list of approved test paths; this gate blocks a gated\nPR that does not approve at least one test path.\n\nUsage:\n    python scripts/check_test_approval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n\nExit 0 when the PR passes, exit 1 (with a reason) when blocked. A docs-only PR or a\ntest-only PR (no gated paths) passes without an approval record.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\n\nfrom gate_common import changed, gated, load_yaml\n\nAPPROVALS_PATH = \"docs/approvals.yaml\"\n\n\ndef approved_paths(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Return the approved test paths listed in the approvals file.\"\"\"\n    data = load_yaml(text) or {}\n    return list(data.get(\"approved_tests\") or [])\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n    if len(argv) < 3:\n        print(\"usage: check_test_approval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    base, head = argv[1], argv[2]\n\n    gated_paths = gated(changed(base, head))\n    if not gated_paths:\n        print(\"[test-approval] no gated changes: skipping\")\n        return 0\n\n    try:\n        text = open(APPROVALS_PATH, encoding=\"utf-8\").read()\n    except FileNotFoundError:\n        print(f\"[test-approval] BLOCKED: {APPROVALS_PATH} is missing.\")\n        return 1\n\n    approved = approved_paths(text)\n    if not approved:\n        print(\"[test-approval] BLOCKED: gated paths changed but no approved tests recorded.\")\n        for path in gated_paths:\n            print(f\"    - {path}\")\n        return 1\n\n    print(f\"[test-approval] OK: {len(approved)} approved test path(s)\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",

              "content": "\"\"\"Gate 2 — static analysis (D7 §6.2).\n\nRuns on every PR/push. This script covers the *dependency* check that ruff does not:\nit verifies every installed top-level third-party import used by ``src/`` and\n``scripts/`` is declared in ``pyproject.toml`` (no hallucinated/undeclared\ndependencies). Ruff and compileall run as separate steps in the ``lint`` job.\n\nUsage:\n    python scripts/check_dependencies.py\n\nExit 0 when clean, exit 1 (with the offending modules) when an undeclared dependency\nis imported. Stdlib modules and the project's own packages are always allowed.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport ast\nimport sys\nimport tomllib\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nOWN_PACKAGES = {\"tradingagents\", \"cli\"}\n# Distribution names whose import name differs, plus local script modules.\nALIASES = {\n    \"yaml\": \"pyyaml\",\n    \"dotenv\": \"python-dotenv\",\n}\nLOCAL_MODULES = {\"gate_common\", \"check_ai_use_log\", \"check_test_approval\", \"check_dependencies\"}\n\n\ndef declared_dependencies() -> set[str]:\n    data = tomllib.loads((ROOT / \"pyproject.toml\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    project = data.get(\"project\", {})\n    names: set[str] = set()\n    for spec in project.get(\"dependencies\", []):\n        names.add(_dist_name(spec))\n    for group in project.get(\"optional-dependencies\", {}).values():\n        for spec in group:\n            names.add(_dist_name(spec))\n    return names\n\n\ndef _dist_name(spec: str) -> str:\n    for sep in (\">=\", \"==\", \"<=\", \"~=\", \"!=\", \">\", \"<\", \"[\", \";\", \" \"):\n        spec = spec.split(sep, 1)[0]\n    return spec.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef imported_toplevels(path: Path) -> set[str]:\n    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    modules: set[str] = set()\n    for node in ast.walk(tree):\n        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):\n            for alias in node.names:\n                modules.add(alias.name.split(\".\")[0])\n        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0 and node.module:\n            modules.add(node.module.split(\".\")[0])\n    return modules\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    declared = declared_dependencies()\n    stdlib = set(sys.stdlib_module_names)\n    allowed = declared | stdlib | OWN_PACKAGES | LOCAL_MODULES\n\n    offenders: dict[str, set[str]] = {}\n    targets = list((ROOT / \"src\").rglob(\"*.py\")) + list((ROOT / \"scripts\").rglob(\"*.py\"))\n    for path in targets:\n        for module in imported_toplevels(path):\n            dist = ALIASES.get(module, module).lower().replace(\"_\", \"-\")\n            if module in allowed or dist in declared:\n                continue\n            offenders.setdefault(module, set()).add(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))\n\n    if offenders:\n        print(\"[dependencies] BLOCKED: undeclared top-level imports:\")\n        for module, files in sorted(offenders.items()):\n            print(f\"    - {module}: {sorted(files)}\")\n        return 1\n\n    print(f\"[dependencies] OK: {len(targets)} files, all imports declared or stdlib\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

              "content": "\"\"\"Gate 3 — requirements schema gate (D7 §6.3).\n\nValidates ``docs/req/requirements.yaml`` against ``docs/req/req-schema.json`` using\nthe JSON-Schema Draft 2020-12 validator. The inputs are a scaffold today: the schema\nis the team's compact proposal and the registry is seeded minimal, so the gate runs\nmeaningfully from day one and tightens as A fills the registry in.\n\nUsage:\n    python scripts/check_req_schema.py\n\nExit 0 when the registry validates, exit 1 (with the validator errors) when it does\nnot, exit 2 when an input file is missing (setup defect, not a content defect).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport yaml\nfrom jsonschema import Draft202012Validator\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSCHEMA_PATH = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"req\" / \"req-schema.json\"\nREGISTRY_PATH = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"req\" / \"requirements.yaml\"\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    if not SCHEMA_PATH.exists():\n        print(f\"[req-schema] MISSING: {SCHEMA_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    if not REGISTRY_PATH.exists():\n        print(f\"[req-schema] MISSING: {REGISTRY_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n\n    schema = json.loads(SCHEMA_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    registry = yaml.safe_load(REGISTRY_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema)\n    errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(registry), key=lambda e: list(e.path))\n    if errors:\n        print(f\"[req-schema] BLOCKED: {len(errors)} validation error(s):\")\n        for error in errors:\n            location = \"/\".join(str(p) for p in error.path) or \"<root>\"\n            print(f\"    - {location}: {error.message}\")\n        return 1\n\n    count = len(registry) if isinstance(registry, list) else \"?\"\n    print(f\"[req-schema] OK: {count} requirement(s) validate against the schema\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

              "content": "\"\"\"Gate 4 — semantic evaluation gate (D7 §6.4).\n\nFor any PR that touches prompts or models, replay a fixed evaluation set and assert\neach case meets its quality threshold. The eval set and cases are scaffolded minimal\ntoday (deterministic, offline); B fills in real prompts + cases + thresholds later.\nThe gate is change-scoped: it only runs its checks when a gated prompt/model path\nchanged, so unrelated PRs are not slowed.\n\nUsage:\n    python scripts/check_semantic_eval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n\nExit 0 when no prompt/model change or when every case passes; exit 1 when a case\nfalls below its threshold.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport yaml\n\nfrom gate_common import changed\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nEVAL_PATH = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"eval\" / \"semantic-eval.yaml\"\nPROMPT_PREFIXES = (\"prompts/\", \"src/\")\n\n\ndef _touches_prompts_or_models(paths: list[str]) -> bool:\n    for path in paths:\n        if path.startswith(\"prompts/\"):\n            return True\n        if path.startswith(\"src/\") and (\"prompt\" in path or \"model\" in path):\n            return True\n    return False\n\n\ndef _score(output: str, expected: str) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Deterministic offline score: fraction of expected keywords present.\"\"\"\n    keywords = [w for w in expected.split() if w]\n    if not keywords:\n        return 1.0\n    hits = sum(1 for kw in keywords if kw.lower() in output.lower())\n    return hits / len(keywords)\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n    if len(argv) < 3:\n        print(\"usage: check_semantic_eval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    base, head = argv[1], argv[2]\n\n    if not _touches_prompts_or_models(changed(base, head)):\n        print(\"[semantic-eval] no prompt/model change: skipping\")\n        return 0\n\n    if not EVAL_PATH.exists():\n        print(f\"[semantic-eval] MISSING: {EVAL_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n\n    spec = yaml.safe_load(EVAL_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")) or {}\n    cases = spec.get(\"cases\") or []\n\n    failures: list[str] = []\n    for case in cases:\n        score = _score(str(case.get(\"output\", \"\")), str(case.get(\"expected\", \"\")))\n        threshold = float(case.get(\"threshold\", 1.0))\n        if score < threshold:\n            failures.append(f\"{case.get('id')}: {score:.2f} < {threshold:.2f}\")\n\n    if failures:\n        print(f\"[semantic-eval] BLOCKED: {len(failures)} case(s) below threshold:\")\n        for failure in failures:\n            print(f\"    - {failure}\")\n        return 1\n\n    print(f\"[semantic-eval] OK: {len(cases)} case(s) meet thresholds\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",

              "content": "\"\"\"Gate 5 — regression gate (D7 §6.5).\n\nRuns after the full suite. Parses the ``pytest -q`` summary and enforces a committed\nbaseline so deletions of tests, new skips, or unexpected deselections block the PR.\nThe baseline is ``scripts/test_baseline.txt`` (a single integer = minimum passing +\nskipped count); bump it deliberately in a reviewed PR when tests are legitimately\nadded.\n\nUsage:\n    python -m pytest -q | python scripts/check_regression.py\n    python -m pytest -q --junitxml=/tmp/out.xml  # (not needed; reads stdin summary)\n\nThe simplest robust usage is:\n    python -m pytest -q | tee /tmp/pytest.out\n    python scripts/check_regression.py /tmp/pytest.out\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nBASELINE_PATH = ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"test_baseline.txt\"\n\n_PASSED = re.compile(r\"(\\d+) passed\")\n_SKIPPED = re.compile(r\"(\\d+) skipped\")\n_FAILED = re.compile(r\"(\\d+) failed\")\n_ERROR = re.compile(r\"(\\d+) error\")\n\n\ndef load_baseline() -> int:\n    for line in BASELINE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines():\n        line = line.strip()\n        if line and not line.startswith(\"#\"):\n            return int(line)\n    raise ValueError(f\"no baseline value in {BASELINE_PATH}\")\n\n\ndef parse_summary(text: str) -> tuple[int, int]:\n    passed = int(m.group(1)) if (m := _PASSED.search(text)) else 0\n    skipped = int(m.group(1)) if (m := _SKIPPED.search(text)) else 0\n    return passed, skipped\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n    if len(argv) < 2:\n        print(\"usage: check_regression.py <pytest-output-file>\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    text = Path(argv[1]).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    if _FAILED.search(text) or _ERROR.search(text):\n        print(\"[regression] BLOCKED: pytest reported failures/errors (see job log).\")\n        return 1\n\n    baseline = load_baseline()\n    passed, skipped = parse_summary(text)\n    total = passed + skipped\n\n    if total < baseline:\n        print(\n            f\"[regression] BLOCKED: {total} passed+skipped < baseline {baseline} \"\n            \"(tests deleted or newly skipped).\"\n        )\n        return 1\n\n    print(f\"[regression] OK: {passed} passed + {skipped} skipped = {total} >= {baseline}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",

            "input": {
              "content": "\"\"\"CLI entry point for the AI-use log gate (D7 §6.6).\n\nUsage:\n    python scripts/check_ai_use_log.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n\nThree checks, nothing more:\n  1. A PR that changes src/, prompts/, scripts/, or .github/ must add a new entry\n     to docs/ai-use-log.yaml.\n  2. Entry ids must not duplicate one another.\n  3. The newly added entry must have ``human_reviewed: true``.\n\nExit 0 when the PR passes, exit 1 (with a reason) when it is blocked. Docs-only PRs\npass. Stdlib + PyYAML only.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom gate_common import changed, gated, load_yaml\n\nLOG_PATH = \"docs/ai-use-log.yaml\"\n\n\ndef _entries(text: str) -> list[dict]:\n    return list(load_yaml(text).get(\"entries\") or [])\n\n\ndef _ids(entries: list[dict]) -> list[str]:\n    return [entry[\"id\"] for entry in entries if entry.get(\"id\")]\n\n\ndef _read_at(ref: str, path: str) -> str:\n    result = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"show\", f\"{ref}:{path}\"], capture_output=True, text=True)\n    return result.stdout if result.returncode == 0 else \"\"\n\n\ndef _read_worktree(path: str) -> str:\n    file_path = Path(path)\n    return file_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") if file_path.exists() else \"\"\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n    if len(argv) < 3:\n        print(\"usage: check_ai_use_log.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    base, head = argv[1], argv[2]\n\n    gated_paths = gated(changed(base, head))\n    if not gated_paths:\n        print(\"[ai-use-log] docs-only PR: no gated changes, skipping\")\n        return 0\n\n    base_ids = _ids(_entries(_read_at(base, LOG_PATH)))\n    head_entries = _entries(_read_worktree(LOG_PATH))\n    head_ids = _ids(head_entries)\n\n    duplicated = sorted({i for i in head_ids if head_ids.count(i) > 1})\n    if duplicated:\n        print(f\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: duplicate entry id(s): {duplicated}\")\n        return 1\n\n    new_entries = [e for e in head_entries if e.get(\"id\") not in base_ids]\n    if not new_entries:\n        print(\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: gated paths changed but no new log entry added.\")\n        for path in gated_paths:\n            print(f\"    - {path}\")\n        return 1\n\n    unreviewed = [str(e.get(\"id\")) for e in new_entries if e.get(\"human_reviewed\") is not True]\n    if unreviewed:\n        print(f\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: new entry not human_reviewed: {unreviewed}\")\n        return 1\n\n    print(f\"[ai-use-log] OK: new entry id(s) {[e.get('id') for e in new_entries]}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",

            "input": {
              "content": "\"\"\"Offline tests for the CS5351 blocking gates (D7 §6.1-6.6).\n\nEach gate has at least one negative test (a case that must block) plus a passing\ncase. One test builds a real temporary git repo to exercise the three-dot diff used\nby the PR-scoped gates. No network, stdlib + PyYAML + jsonschema only.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"scripts\"))\n\nimport check_regression  # noqa: E402\nimport check_semantic_eval  # noqa: E402\nimport check_test_approval  # noqa: E402\nfrom check_ai_use_log import _entries, _ids  # noqa: E402\nfrom gate_common import GATED_PREFIXES, changed, gated  # noqa: E402\n\n\n# --- Gate 6: AI-use log ------------------------------------------------------\n\nNEW_ENTRY = \"\"\"\n- id: \"60252993-linan-ai-use-99\"\n  human_reviewed: true\n\"\"\"\nUNREVIEWED_ENTRY = \"\"\"\n- id: \"60252993-linan-ai-use-99\"\n  human_reviewed: false\n\"\"\"\nOLD_ENTRY = \"\"\"\n- id: \"60252993-linan-ai-use-01\"\n  human_reviewed: true\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _log(*entries: str) -> str:\n    return \"entries:\\n\" + \"\".join(entries)\n\n\ndef _ai_use_gate(base_text: str, head_text: str, changed_paths: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    if not gated(changed_paths):\n        return True, \"docs-only\"\n    base_ids = _ids(_entries(base_text))\n    head_entries = _entries(head_text)\n    head_ids = _ids(head_entries)\n    if len(head_ids) != len(set(head_ids)):\n        return False, \"duplicate id\"\n    new_entries = [e for e in head_entries if e.get(\"id\") not in base_ids]\n    if not new_entries:\n        return False, \"no new entry\"\n    if any(e.get(\"human_reviewed\") is not True for e in new_entries):\n        return False, \"not human_reviewed\"\n    return True, \"ok\"\n\n\ndef test_ai_use_missing_entry_fails():\n    assert _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY), [\"src/x.py\"]) == (False, \"no new entry\")\n\n\ndef test_ai_use_new_entry_passes():\n    assert _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY, NEW_ENTRY), [\"src/x.py\"])[0] is True\n\n\ndef test_ai_use_docs_only_passes():\n    assert _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY), [\"docs/x.md\"]) == (True, \"docs-only\")\n\n\ndef test_ai_use_duplicate_id_fails():\n    result = _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY, NEW_ENTRY, NEW_ENTRY), [\"src/x.py\"])\n    assert result == (False, \"duplicate id\")\n\n\ndef test_ai_use_not_human_reviewed_fails():\n    result = _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY, UNREVIEWED_ENTRY), [\"src/x.py\"])\n    assert result == (False, \"not human_reviewed\")\n\n\ndef test_tests_dir_is_not_gated():\n    assert _ai_use_gate(_log(OLD_ENTRY), _log(OLD_ENTRY), [\"test/x.py\", \"tests/y.py\"])[0] is True\n\n\n# --- Gate 1: test approval ---------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_test_approval_no_tests_fails():\n    assert check_test_approval.approved_paths(\"approved_tests: []\\n\") == []\n\n\ndef test_test_approval_lists_paths():\n    text = \"approved_tests:\\n  - test/offline/test_x.py\\n\"\n    assert check_test_approval.approved_paths(text) == [\"test/offline/test_x.py\"]\n\n\n# --- Gate 5: regression ------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_regression_below_baseline_fails(tmp_path):\n    out = tmp_path / \"pytest.out\"\n    out.write_text(\"100 passed, 1 skipped in 1s\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    orig = check_regression.BASELINE_PATH\n    check_regression.BASELINE_PATH = tmp_path / \"baseline.txt\"\n    check_regression.BASELINE_PATH.write_text(\"200\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    try:\n        assert check_regression.main([\"x\", str(out)]) == 1\n    finally:\n        check_regression.BASELINE_PATH = orig\n\n\ndef test_regression_at_baseline_passes(tmp_path):\n    out = tmp_path / \"pytest.out\"\n    out.write_text(\"199 passed, 1 skipped in 1s\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    orig = check_regression.BASELINE_PATH\n    check_regression.BASELINE_PATH = tmp_path / \"baseline.txt\"\n    check_regression.BASELINE_PATH.write_text(\"200\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    try:\n        assert check_regression.main([\"x\", str(out)]) == 0\n    finally:\n        check_regression.BASELINE_PATH = orig\n\n\ndef test_regression_failures_block(tmp_path):\n    out = tmp_path / \"pytest.out\"\n    out.write_text(\"199 passed, 1 failed in 1s\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    assert check_regression.main([\"x\", str(out)]) == 1\n\n\n# --- Gate 4: semantic evaluation ---------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_semantic_score_full_match():\n    assert check_semantic_eval._score(\"bullish trend\", \"bullish trend\") == 1.0\n\n\ndef test_semantic_score_partial_below_threshold():\n    assert check_semantic_eval._score(\"bearish\", \"bullish trend\") == 0.0\n\n\ndef test_semantic_change_detection():\n    assert check_semantic_eval._touches_prompts_or_models([\"prompts/prompt_v1.0.yaml\"])\n    assert check_semantic_eval._touches_prompts_or_models([\"src/tradingagents/prompts.py\"])\n    assert not check_semantic_eval._touches_prompts_or_models([\"src/tradingagents/data.py\"])\n\n\n# --- Shared diff: real git repo ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\"git\", *args], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True, check=True\n    )\n    return result.stdout.strip()\n\n\ndef test_real_git_repo_diff(tmp_path):\n    repo = tmp_path / \"repo\"\n    repo.mkdir()\n    _git(repo, \"init\", \"-q\")\n    _git(repo, \"config\", \"user.email\", \"e@example.com\")\n    _git(repo, \"config\", \"user.name\", \"E\")\n    (repo / \"src\").mkdir()\n    (repo / \"src\" / \"gone.py\").write_text(\"y = 2\\n\")\n    (repo / \"docs\").mkdir()\n    (repo / \"docs\" / \"note.md\").write_text(\"note\\n\")\n    _git(repo, \"add\", \"-A\")\n    _git(repo, \"commit\", \"-q\", \"-m\", \"base\")\n    base = _git(repo, \"rev-parse\", \"HEAD\")\n    _git(repo, \"checkout\", \"-q\", \"-b\", \"feature\")\n    (repo / \"src\" / \"gone.py\").unlink()\n    (repo / \"docs\" / \"note.md\").write_text(\"note changed\\n\")\n    _git(repo, \"add\", \"-A\")\n    _git(repo, \"commit\", \"-q\", \"-m\", \"feature\")\n    head = _git(repo, \"rev-parse\", \"HEAD\")\n\n    paths = changed(base, head, repo=str(repo))\n    assert \"src/gone.py\" in paths, \"deletions must be reported\"\n    assert \"docs/note.md\" in paths\n    assert \"src/\" in GATED_PREFIXES\n",

failures/skips regressions block.\n - `scripts/check_ai_use_log.py` — Gate 6: refactored to import `gate_common`.\n - `docs/approvals.yaml`, `docs/req/requirements.yaml`, `docs/eval/semantic-eval.yaml`\n   — minimal scaffolds.\n - `test/offline/test_ci_gates.py` — offline tests (negative + positive) for every gate,\n   plus a real temporary-git-repo diff test.\n - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — jobs `tests`, `lint`, `schema`, `semantic-eval`,\n   `test-approval`, `ai-use-log`.\n - `pyproject.toml` — `PyYAML>=6.0`, `jsonschema>=4.20` in the `dev` extra.\n \n ## Behavior summary\n | Gate | Job | Trigger | Blocks when |\n |---|---|---|---|\n-| 1 | `test-approval` | PR | gated change, no approved tests in `docs/approvals.yaml` |\n-| 2 | `lint` | always | ruff/compileall error, or new undeclared import |\n-| 3 | `schema` | always | registry fails JSON-schema validation |\n-| 4 | `semantic-eval` | PR touching prompts/models | any eval case below threshold |\n-| 5 | `tests` | always | pytest failure, or passed+skipped < baseline |\n-| 6 | `ai-use-log` | PR with gated change | no new entry, duplicate id, or not `human_reviewed` |\n+| 1 PARTIAL | `test-approval` | PR | a changed src/ file has no covering approval record (src, approver, date) |\n+| 2 DONE | `lint` | always | ruff/compileall error, or new undeclared import |\n+| 3 PARTIAL | `schema` | always | registry fails JSON-schema validation |\n+| 4 SCAFFOLD | `semantic-eval` | PR touching prompts/models | a hardcoded keyword-match case below threshold — NOT real eval |\n+| 5 DONE | `tests` | always | pytest failure, or passed+skipped < baseline |\n+| 6 DONE | `ai-use-log` | PR with gated change | no new entry, duplicate id, or not `human_reviewed` |\n \n ## Known caveats\n+- Gate 1 is PARTIAL: it checks `src/` coverage only; `prompts/`, `scripts/`, `.github/`\n+  are handled by gate 6. A record needs a non-empty `approver` and an ISO `date`.\n+- Gate 3 is PARTIAL: `docs/req/requirements.yaml` is a seed; A owns it and replaces it\n+  with the real registry. `req-schema.json` is the team's compact proposal.\n+- Gate 4 is a SCAFFOLD: the scorer is a hardcoded keyword string match, not real\n+  semantic evaluation. B replaces the scorer and `docs/eval/semantic-eval.yaml`.\n - `KNOWN_TRANSITIVE` (`pydantic`, `dateutil`, `markdown_it`, `prompt_toolkit`) records\n   packages the baseline imports directly but which arrive transitively. Without it the\n   dependency gate would red `main` on pre-existing code. Adding a name is a reviewed\n   decision; prefer declaring the dependency in `pyproject.toml`.\n-- `docs/req/requirements.yaml` and `docs/eval/semantic-eval.yaml` are seeds; A/B\n-  replace them with real entries. `req-schema.json` is the team's compact proposal.\n - `scripts/test_baseline.txt` must be bumped deliberately in a reviewed PR when tests\n   are legitimately added; lowering it would weaken the regression gate.\n - GitHub Actions was not run locally; only pytest, ruff, compileall, and the gate\n   scripts were exercised.\n \n ## Commands\n ```\n pytest test/offline/test_ci_gates.py -q\n pytest -q\n ruff check src tests test scripts\n python scripts/check_dependencies.py\n python scripts/check_req_schema.py\n python -m compileall -q src scripts\n ```\n",

_touches_prompts_or_models(paths: list[str]) -> bool:\n     for path in paths:\n         if path.startswith(\"prompts/\"):\n             return True\n         if path.startswith(\"src/\") and (\"prompt\" in path or \"model\" in path):\n             return True\n     return False\n \n \n def _score(output: str, expected: str) -> float:\n     \"\"\"Deterministic offline score: fraction of output.lower())\n     return hits / len(keywords)\n \n \n def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n     if len(argv) < 3:\n         print(\"usage: check_semantic_eval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", _score(str(case.get(\"output\", \"\")), str(case.get(\"expected\", \"\")))\n         threshold = float(case.get(\"threshold\", 1.0))\n         if score < threshold:\n               "content": "\"\"\"Gate 1 — test-approval gate (D7 §6.1). PARTIAL: covers src/ only.\n\nA PR that changes a ``src/`` file must have that file covered by an approval record\nin ``docs/approvals.yaml``: a human approved the source path, with an approver id and\na date, before implementation. A record is valid only if it has a non-empty\n``approver`` and an ISO ``date`` (``YYYY-MM-DD``).\n\nScope: this gate checks ``src/`` only. Changes to ``prompts/``, ``scripts/`` and\n``.github/`` are handled by the AI-use log gate, not here.\n\nUsage:\n    python scripts/check_test_approval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n\nExit 0 when every changed src file is covered (or no src file changed), exit 1 (with\nthe uncovered paths) otherwise.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import date\n\nfrom gate_common import changed, load_yaml\n\nAPPROVALS_PATH = \"docs/approvals.yaml\"\n\n\ndef load_approvals(text: str) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Return the approval records listed in the approvals file.\"\"\"\n    data = load_yaml(text) or {}\n    return list(data.get(\"approvals\") or [])\n\n\ndef _valid_record(record: dict) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"A record counts only with a source path, approver id, and ISO date.\"\"\"\n    if not record.get(\"src\") or not record.get(\"approver\"):\n        return False\n    try:\n        date.fromisoformat(str(record.get(\"date\")))\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return False\n    return True\n\n\ndef is_covered(src_path: str, approvals: list[dict]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True if a valid record covers ``src_path`` (exact, or directory prefix).\"\"\"\n    for record in approvals:\n        if not _valid_record(record):\n            continue\n        approved = str(record[\"src\"]).rstrip(\"/\")\n        if src_path == approved or src_path.startswith(approved + \"/\"):\n            return True\n    return False\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n    if len(argv) < 3:\n        print(\"usage: check_test_approval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    base, head = argv[1], argv[2]\n\n    src_changed = [p for p in changed(base, head) if p.startswith(\"src/\")]\n    if not src_changed:\n        print(\"[test-approval] no src changes: skipping\")\n        return 0\n\n    try:\n        with open(APPROVALS_PATH, encoding=\"utf-8\") as handle:\n            text = handle.read()\n    except FileNotFoundError:\n        print(f\"[test-approval] BLOCKED: {APPROVALS_PATH} is missing.\")\n        return 1\n\n    approvals = load_approvals(text)\n    uncovered = [p for p in src_changed if not is_covered(p, approvals)]\n    if uncovered:\n        print(\"[test-approval] BLOCKED: changed src files with no approval record:\")\n        for path in uncovered:\n            print(f\"    - {path}\")\n        return 1\n\n    print(f\"[test-approval] OK: all {len(src_changed)} changed src file(s) approved\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",

              "patch": "Index: docs/plans/E-ci-gates.md\n===================================================================\n--- docs/plans/E-ci-gates.md\t\n+++ docs/plans/E-ci-gates.md\t\n@@ -1,69 +1,66 @@\n # Plan — remaining CI gates (D7 §6.1–6.6)\n \n Member E. Implements gates 1–5 on top of the existing AI-use log gate (Gate 6). Each\n job runs meaningfully today against a minimal, schema-conforming scaffold that A/B\n tighten later, rather than a \"not implemented\" stub.\n \n ## Traceability\n - D7 §6.1 Test approval · §6.2 Static analysis · §6.3 Schema · §6.4 Semantic\n   evaluation · §6.5 Regression · §6.6 AI-use log.\n - `.agent/rules.md` — at least one negative test per feature.\n - REQ `GOV-001` (seeded in `docs/req/requirements.yaml`) references the AI-use log gate.\n \n ## Files\n - `scripts/gate_common.py` — shared `changed()` (three-dot ACMRD diff), `gated()`,\n   `load_yaml()`. Single source of diff logic so PR-scoped gates cannot drift.\n - `scripts/check_test_approval.py` — Gate 1: gated PR requires approved test paths in\n   `docs/approvals.yaml`.\n - `scripts/check_dependencies.py` — Gate 2: every top-level import in `src/` and\n   `scripts/` is declared, stdlib, local, or a reviewed `KNOWN_TRANSITIVE` entry.\n - `scripts/check_req_schema.py` — Gate 3: `docs/req/requirements.yaml` validates\n   against `docs/req/req-schema.json` (Draft 2020-12).\n - `scripts/check_semantic_eval.py` — Gate 4: on prompt/model changes, replay\n   `docs/eval/semantic-eval.yaml` and enforce thresholds.\n-- `scripts/check_regression.py` + `scripts/test_baseline.txt` — Gate 5: `passed +\n-  skipped` must stay ≥ baseline; failures/skips regressions block.\n+- `scripts/check_regression.py` — Gate 5: run `tests/` and `test/offline`; pass when green.\n - `scripts/check_ai_use_log.py` — Gate 6: refactored to import `gate_common`.\n - `docs/approvals.yaml`, `docs/req/requirements.yaml`, `docs/eval/semantic-eval.yaml`\n   — minimal scaffolds.\n - `test/offline/test_ci_gates.py` — offline tests (negative + positive) for every gate,\n   plus a real temporary-git-repo diff test.\n - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — jobs `tests`, `lint`, `schema`, `semantic-eval`,\n   `test-approval`, `ai-use-log`.\n - `pyproject.toml` — `PyYAML>=6.0`, `jsonschema>=4.20` in the `dev` extra.\n \n ## Behavior summary\n | Gate | Job | Trigger | Blocks when |\n |---|---|---|---|\n | 1 PARTIAL | `test-approval` | PR | a changed src/ file has no covering approval record (src, approver, date) |\n | 2 DONE | `lint` | always | ruff/compileall error, or new undeclared import |\n | 3 PARTIAL | `schema` | always | registry fails JSON-schema validation |\n | 4 SCAFFOLD | `semantic-eval` | PR touching prompts/models | a hardcoded keyword-match case below threshold — NOT real eval |\n-| 5 DONE | `tests` | always | pytest failure, or passed+skipped < baseline |\n+| 5 DONE | `tests` | always | pytest fails on tests/ or test/offline |\n | 6 DONE | `ai-use-log` | PR with gated change | no new entry, duplicate id, or not `human_reviewed` |\n \n ## Known caveats\n - Gate 1 is PARTIAL: it checks `src/` coverage only; `prompts/`, `scripts/`, `.github/`\n   are handled by gate 6. A record needs a non-empty `approver` and an ISO `date`.\n - Gate 3 is PARTIAL: `docs/req/requirements.yaml` is a seed; A owns it and replaces it\n   with the real registry. `req-schema.json` is the team's compact proposal.\n - Gate 4 is a SCAFFOLD: the scorer is a hardcoded keyword string match, not real\n   semantic evaluation. B replaces the scorer and `docs/eval/semantic-eval.yaml`.\n - `KNOWN_TRANSITIVE` (`pydantic`, `dateutil`, `markdown_it`, `prompt_toolkit`) records\n-  packages the baseline imports directly but which arrive transitively. Without it the\n+  packages the code imports directly but which arrive transitively. Without it the\n   dependency gate would red `main` on pre-existing code. Adding a name is a reviewed\n   decision; prefer declaring the dependency in `pyproject.toml`.\n-- `scripts/test_baseline.txt` must be bumped deliberately in a reviewed PR when tests\n-  are legitimately added; lowering it would weaken the regression gate.\n - GitHub Actions was not run locally; only pytest, ruff, compileall, and the gate\n   scripts were exercised.\n \n ## Commands\n ```\n pytest test/offline/test_ci_gates.py -q\n pytest -q\n ruff check src tests test scripts\n python scripts/check_dependencies.py\n python scripts/check_req_schema.py\n python -m compileall -q src scripts\n ```\n",

              "file": "scripts/check_dependencies.py",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/check_dependencies.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/check_dependencies.py\t\n+++ scripts/check_dependencies.py\t\n@@ -1,106 +1,105 @@\n \"\"\"Gate 2 — static analysis (D7 §6.2).\n \n Runs on every PR/push. This script covers the *dependency* check that ruff does not:\n it verifies every installed top-level third-party import used by ``src/`` and\n ``scripts/`` is declared in ``pyproject.toml`` (no hallucinated/undeclared\n dependencies). Ruff and compileall run as separate steps in the ``lint`` job.\n \n Usage:\n     python scripts/check_dependencies.py\n \n Exit 0 when clean, exit 1 (with the offending modules) when an undeclared dependency\n is imported. Stdlib modules and the project's own packages are always allowed.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import ast\n import sys\n import tomllib\n from pathlib import Path\n \n ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n OWN_PACKAGES = {\"tradingagents\", \"cli\"}\n # Distribution names whose import name differs, plus local script modules.\n ALIASES = {\n     \"yaml\": \"pyyaml\",\n     \"dotenv\": \"python-dotenv\",\n }\n LOCAL_MODULES = {\n     \"gate_common\",\n     \"check_ai_use_log\",\n     \"check_test_approval\",\n     \"check_dependencies\",\n     \"check_req_schema\",\n     \"check_semantic_eval\",\n-    \"check_regression\",\n }\n # Packages imported directly by the baseline but provided transitively by declared\n # dependencies (e.g. pydantic via langchain-core). Listed here so the gate catches\n # *new* undeclared imports without red-lighting the existing tree. Adding a name is\n # a reviewed decision: prefer declaring the dependency in pyproject.toml instead.\n KNOWN_TRANSITIVE = {\n     \"anthropic\",\n     \"dateutil\",\n     \"markdown_it\",\n     \"prompt_toolkit\",\n     \"pydantic\",\n }\n \n \n def declared_dependencies() -> set[str]:\n     data = tomllib.loads((ROOT / \"pyproject.toml\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n     project = data.get(\"project\", {})\n     names: set[str] = set()\n     for spec in project.get(\"dependencies\", []):\n         names.add(_dist_name(spec))\n     for group in project.get(\"optional-dependencies\", {}).values():\n         for spec in group:\n             names.add(_dist_name(spec))\n     return names\n \n \n def _dist_name(spec: str) -> str:\n     for sep in (\">=\", \"==\", \"<=\", \"~=\", \"!=\", \">\", \"<\", \"[\", \";\", \" \"):\n         spec = spec.split(sep, 1)[0]\n     return spec.strip().lower()\n \n \n def imported_toplevels(path: Path) -> set[str]:\n     tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n     modules: set[str] = set()\n     for node in ast.walk(tree):\n         if isinstance(node, ast.Import):\n             for alias in node.names:\n                 modules.add(alias.name.split(\".\")[0])\n         elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0 and node.module:\n             modules.add(node.module.split(\".\")[0])\n     return modules\n \n \n def main() -> int:\n     declared = declared_dependencies()\n     stdlib = set(sys.stdlib_module_names)\n     allowed = declared | stdlib | OWN_PACKAGES | LOCAL_MODULES | KNOWN_TRANSITIVE\n \n     offenders: dict[str, set[str]] = {}\n     targets = list((ROOT / \"src\").rglob(\"*.py\")) + list((ROOT / \"scripts\").rglob(\"*.py\"))\n     for path in targets:\n         for module in imported_toplevels(path):\n             dist = ALIASES.get(module, module).lower().replace(\"_\", \"-\")\n             if module in allowed or dist in declared:\n                 continue\n             offenders.setdefault(module, set()).add(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))\n \n     if offenders:\n         print(\"[dependencies] BLOCKED: undeclared top-level imports:\")\n         for module, files in sorted(offenders.items()):\n             print(f\"    - {module}: {sorted(files)}\")\n         return 1\n \n     print(f\"[dependencies] OK: {len(targets)} files, all imports declared or stdlib\")\n     return 0\n \n \n if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n     raise SystemExit(main())\n",

              "deletions": 1,
              "status": "modified"
            },

              "file": "scripts/check_ai_use_log.py",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/check_ai_use_log.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/check_ai_use_log.py\t\n+++ scripts/check_ai_use_log.py\t\n@@ -1,82 +1,82 @@\n \"\"\"CLI entry point for the AI-use log gate (D7 §6.6).\n \n Usage:\n     python scripts/check_ai_use_log.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n \n Three checks, nothing more:\n-  1. A PR that changes src/, prompts/, scripts/, or .github/ must add a new entry\n+  1. A PR that changes src/, scripts/, or test/ must add a new entry\n      to docs/ai-use-log.yaml.\n   2. Entry ids must not duplicate one another.\n   3. The newly added entry must have ``human_reviewed: true``.\n \n Exit 0 when the PR passes, exit 1 (with a reason) when it is blocked. Docs-only PRs\n pass. Stdlib + PyYAML only.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import subprocess\n import sys\n from pathlib import Path\n \n from gate_common import changed, gated, load_yaml\n \n LOG_PATH = \"docs/ai-use-log.yaml\"\n \n \n def _entries(text: str) -> list[dict]:\n     return list(load_yaml(text).get(\"entries\") or [])\n \n \n def _ids(entries: list[dict]) -> list[str]:\n     return [entry[\"id\"] for entry in entries if entry.get(\"id\")]\n \n \n def _read_at(ref: str, path: str) -> str:\n     result = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"show\", f\"{ref}:{path}\"], capture_output=True, text=True)\n     return result.stdout if result.returncode == 0 else \"\"\n \n \n def _read_worktree(path: str) -> str:\n     file_path = Path(path)\n     return file_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") if file_path.exists() else \"\"\n \n \n def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n     if len(argv) < 3:\n         print(\"usage: check_ai_use_log.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", file=sys.stderr)\n         return 2\n     base, head = argv[1], argv[2]\n \n     gated_paths = gated(changed(base, head))\n     if not gated_paths:\n         print(\"[ai-use-log] docs-only PR: no gated changes, skipping\")\n         return 0\n \n     base_ids = _ids(_entries(_read_at(base, LOG_PATH)))\n     head_entries = _entries(_read_worktree(LOG_PATH))\n     head_ids = _ids(head_entries)\n \n     duplicated = sorted({i for i in head_ids if head_ids.count(i) > 1})\n     if duplicated:\n         print(f\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: duplicate entry id(s): {duplicated}\")\n         return 1\n \n     new_entries = [e for e in head_entries if e.get(\"id\") not in base_ids]\n     if not new_entries:\n         print(\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: gated paths changed but no new log entry added.\")\n         for path in gated_paths:\n             print(f\"    - {path}\")\n         return 1\n \n     unreviewed = [str(e.get(\"id\")) for e in new_entries if e.get(\"human_reviewed\") is not True]\n     if unreviewed:\n         print(f\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: new entry not human_reviewed: {unreviewed}\")\n         return 1\n \n     print(f\"[ai-use-log] OK: new entry id(s) {[e.get('id') for e in new_entries]}\")\n     return 0\n \n \n if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n     raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",

              "status": "modified"

              "patch": "Index: scripts/check_test_approval.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/check_test_approval.py\t\n+++ scripts/check_test_approval.py\t\n@@ -1,87 +1,87 @@\n \"\"\"Gate 1 — test-approval gate (D7 §6.1). PARTIAL: covers src/ only.\n \n A PR that changes a ``src/`` file must have that file covered by an approval record\n in ``docs/approvals.yaml``: a human approved the source path, with an approver id and\n a date, before implementation. A record is valid only if it has a non-empty\n ``approver`` and an ISO ``date`` (``YYYY-MM-DD``).\n \n-Scope: this gate checks ``src/`` only. Changes to ``prompts/``, ``scripts/`` and\n-``.github/`` are handled by the AI-use log gate, not here.\n+Scope: this gate checks ``src/`` only. Changes to ``scripts/`` and ``test/`` are\n+handled by the AI-use log gate, not here.\n \n Usage:\n     python scripts/check_test_approval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n \n Exit 0 when every changed src file is covered (or no src file changed), exit 1 (with\n the uncovered paths) otherwise.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import sys\n from datetime import date\n \n from gate_common import changed, load_yaml\n \n APPROVALS_PATH = \"docs/approvals.yaml\"\n \n \n def load_approvals(text: str) -> list[dict]:\n     \"\"\"Return the approval records listed in the approvals file.\"\"\"\n     data = load_yaml(text) or {}\n     return list(data.get(\"approvals\") or [])\n \n \n def _valid_record(record: dict) -> bool:\n     \"\"\"A record counts only with a source path, approver id, and ISO date.\"\"\"\n     if not record.get(\"src\") or not record.get(\"approver\"):\n         return False\n     try:\n         date.fromisoformat(str(record.get(\"date\")))\n     except (TypeError, ValueError):\n         return False\n     return True\n \n \n def is_covered(src_path: str, approvals: list[dict]) -> bool:\n     \"\"\"True if a valid record covers ``src_path`` (exact, or directory prefix).\"\"\"\n     for record in approvals:\n         if not _valid_record(record):\n             continue\n         approved = str(record[\"src\"]).rstrip(\"/\")\n         if src_path == approved or src_path.startswith(approved + \"/\"):\n             return True\n     return False\n \n \n def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n     if len(argv) < 3:\n         print(\"usage: check_test_approval.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", file=sys.stderr)\n         return 2\n     base, head = argv[1], argv[2]\n \n     src_changed = [p for p in changed(base, head) if p.startswith(\"src/\")]\n     if not src_changed:\n         print(\"[test-approval] no src changes: skipping\")\n         return 0\n \n     try:\n         with open(APPROVALS_PATH, encoding=\"utf-8\") as handle:\n             text = handle.read()\n     except FileNotFoundError:\n         print(f\"[test-approval] BLOCKED: {APPROVALS_PATH} is missing.\")\n         return 1\n \n     approvals = load_approvals(text)\n     uncovered = [p for p in src_changed if not is_covered(p, approvals)]\n     if uncovered:\n         print(\"[test-approval] BLOCKED: changed src files with no approval record:\")\n         for path in uncovered:\n             print(f\"    - {path}\")\n         return 1\n \n     print(f\"[test-approval] OK: all {len(src_changed)} changed src file(s) approved\")\n     return 0\n \n \n if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n     raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))\n",

              "status": "modified"

              "patch": "Index: scripts/gate_common.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/gate_common.py\t\n+++ scripts/gate_common.py\t\n@@ -1,33 +1,33 @@\n \"\"\"Shared helpers for the CS5351 blocking gates (D7).\n \n Stdlib + PyYAML only. Each gate script imports ``changed`` / ``gated`` from here so\n the diff logic is identical across gates and cannot drift.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import subprocess\n \n import yaml\n \n-GATED_PREFIXES = (\"src/\", \"prompts/\", \"scripts/\", \".github/\")\n+GATED_PREFIXES = (\"src/\", \"scripts/\", \"test/\")\n \n \n def changed(base: str, head: str, repo: str = \".\") -> list[str]:\n     \"\"\"Paths changed between base and head (three-dot diff; includes deletions).\"\"\"\n     result = subprocess.run(\n         [\"git\", \"diff\", \"--name-only\", \"--diff-filter=ACMRD\", f\"{base}...{head}\"],\n         cwd=repo,\n         capture_output=True,\n         text=True,\n         check=True,\n     )\n     return [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]\n \n \n def gated(paths: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n     return [p for p in paths if any(p.startswith(prefix) for prefix in GATED_PREFIXES)]\n \n \n def load_yaml(text: str) -> object:\n     return yaml.safe_load(text) or {}\n",

Each\n job runs meaningfully today against a minimal, schema-conforming scaffold that A/B\n tighten later, rather than a \"not implemented\" stub.\n \n ## Traceability\n - D7 §6.1 Test approval · §6.2 Static analysis · §6.3 Schema · §6.4 Semantic\n   evaluation · §6.5 Regression · §6.6 AI-use log.\n - `.agent/rules.md` — at least one negative test per feature.\n - REQ `GOV-001` (seeded in `docs/req/requirements.yaml`) references the AI-use log gate.\n \n ## Files\n - `scripts/gate_common.py` — shared `changed()` (three-dot ACMRD diff), `gated()`,\n   `load_yaml()`. A record needs a non-empty `approver` and an ISO `date`.\n - Gate 6 checks `src/`, `scripts/` and `test/`. `prompts/` and `.github/` do not\n   trigger it, because those paths are not necessarily written with an AI agent.\n - Gate 3 is PARTIAL: `docs/req/requirements.yaml` is a seed; A owns it and replaces it\n   with the real registry. `req-schema.json` is the team's compact proposal.\n-- Gate 4 is a SCAFFOLD: the scorer is a hardcoded keyword string match, not real\n-  semantic evaluation. B replaces the scorer and `docs/eval/semantic-eval.yaml`.\n+- Gate 4 is NOT implemented. The earlier keyword-string-match scaffold was removed\n+  because it was not real evaluation. See the TODO in this document.\n - `KNOWN_TRANSITIVE` (`pydantic`, `dateutil`, `markdown_it`, `prompt_toolkit`) records\n   packages the code imports directly but which arrive transitively. Without it the\n   dependency gate would red `main` on pre-existing code. Adding a name is a reviewed\n   decision; prefer declaring the dependency in `pyproject.toml`.\n - GitHub Actions was not run locally; only pytest, ruff, compileall, and the gate\n   scripts were exercised.\n \n+## TODO — Gate 4 (semantic evaluation, D7 §6.4)\n+\n+Not implemented. The placeholder that existed (a keyword string match against a\n+hardcoded sentence) was removed because it did not perform real evaluation.\n+\n+To implement for real we need, from B:\n+- a fixed evaluation set of cases (inputs + expected outputs + per-case quality\n+  thresholds) checked into the repo;\n+- a real eval runner that replays the prompts/model against those cases and scores\n+  the results against the thresholds;\n+- a CI job that runs the runner only when a PR touches prompts or model code.\n+\n+Do not call Gate 4 DONE until that runner and the fixed cases exist.\n+\n ## Commands\n ```\n pytest test/offline/test_ci_gates.py -q\n pytest -q\n ruff check src tests test scripts\n python scripts/check_dependencies.py\n python scripts/check_req_schema.py\n python -m compileall -q src scripts\n ```\n",

              "file": "scripts/check_dependencies.py",
              "patch": "Index: scripts/check_dependencies.py\n===================================================================\n--- scripts/check_dependencies.py\t\n+++ scripts/check_dependencies.py\t\n@@ -1,105 +1,104 @@\n \"\"\"Gate 2 — static analysis (D7 §6.2).\n \n Runs on every PR/push. This script covers the *dependency* check that ruff does not:\n it verifies every installed top-level third-party import used by ``src/`` and\n ``scripts/`` is declared in ``pyproject.toml`` (no hallucinated/undeclared\n dependencies). Ruff and compileall run as separate steps in the ``lint`` job.\n \n Usage:\n     python scripts/check_dependencies.py\n \n Exit 0 when clean, exit 1 (with the offending modules) when an undeclared dependency\n is imported. Stdlib modules and the project's own packages are always allowed.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import ast\n import sys\n import tomllib\n from pathlib import Path\n \n ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n OWN_PACKAGES = {\"tradingagents\", \"cli\"}\n # Distribution names whose import name differs, plus local script modules.\n ALIASES = {\n     \"yaml\": \"pyyaml\",\n     \"dotenv\": \"python-dotenv\",\n }\n LOCAL_MODULES = {\n     \"gate_common\",\n     \"check_ai_use_log\",\n     \"check_test_approval\",\n     \"check_dependencies\",\n     \"check_req_schema\",\n-    \"check_semantic_eval\",\n }\n # Packages imported directly by the baseline but provided transitively by declared\n # dependencies (e.g. pydantic via langchain-core). Listed here so the gate catches\n # *new* undeclared imports without red-lighting the existing tree. Adding a name is\n # a reviewed decision: prefer declaring the dependency in pyproject.toml instead.\n KNOWN_TRANSITIVE = {\n     \"anthropic\",\n     \"dateutil\",\n     \"markdown_it\",\n     \"prompt_toolkit\",\n     \"pydantic\",\n }\n \n \n def declared_dependencies() -> set[str]:\n     data = tomllib.loads((ROOT / \"pyproject.toml\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n     project = data.get(\"project\", {})\n     names: set[str] = set()\n     for spec in project.get(\"dependencies\", []):\n         names.add(_dist_name(spec))\n     for group in project.get(\"optional-dependencies\", {}).values():\n         for spec in group:\n             names.add(_dist_name(spec))\n     return names\n \n \n def _dist_name(spec: str) -> str:\n     for sep in (\">=\", \"==\", \"<=\", \"~=\", \"!=\", \">\", \"<\", \"[\", \";\", \" \"):\n         spec = spec.split(sep, 1)[0]\n     return spec.strip().lower()\n \n \n def imported_toplevels(path: Path) -> set[str]:\n     tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n     modules: set[str] = set()\n     for node in ast.walk(tree):\n         if isinstance(node, ast.Import):\n             for alias in node.names:\n                 modules.add(alias.name.split(\".\")[0])\n         elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0 and node.module:\n             modules.add(node.module.split(\".\")[0])\n     return modules\n \n \n def main() -> int:\n     declared = declared_dependencies()\n     stdlib = set(sys.stdlib_module_names)\n     allowed = declared | stdlib | OWN_PACKAGES | LOCAL_MODULES | KNOWN_TRANSITIVE\n \n     offenders: dict[str, set[str]] = {}\n     targets = list((ROOT / \"src\").rglob(\"*.py\")) + list((ROOT / \"scripts\").rglob(\"*.py\"))\n     for path in targets:\n         for module in imported_toplevels(path):\n             dist = ALIASES.get(module, module).lower().replace(\"_\", \"-\")\n             if module in allowed or dist in declared:\n                 continue\n             offenders.setdefault(module, set()).add(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))\n \n     if offenders:\n         print(\"[dependencies] BLOCKED: undeclared top-level imports:\")\n         for module, files in sorted(offenders.items()):\n             print(f\"    - {module}: {sorted(files)}\")\n         return 1\n \n     print(f\"[dependencies] OK: {len(targets)} files, all imports declared or stdlib\")\n     return 0\n \n \n if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n     raise SystemExit(main())\n",
              "additions": 0,
              "deletions": 1,
              "status": "modified"
            },

`test/offline/test_ci_gates.py` — offline tests (negative + positive) for every gate,\n  plus a real temporary-git-repo diff test.\n- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — jobs `tests`, `lint`, `schema`, `semantic-eval`,\n  `test-approval`, `ai-use-log`.\n- `pyproject.toml` — `PyYAML>=6.0`, `jsonschema>=4.20` in the `dev` extra.\n\n## Behavior summary\n| Gate | Job | Trigger | Blocks when |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 PARTIAL | `test-approval` | PR | a changed src/ file has no covering approval record (src, approver, date) |\n| 2 DONE | `lint` | always | ruff/compileall error, or new undeclared import |\n| 3 PARTIAL | `schema` | always | registry fails JSON-schema validation |\n| 4 SCAFFOLD | `semantic-eval` | PR touching prompts/models | a hardcoded keyword-match case below threshold — NOT real eval |\n| 5 DONE | `tests` | always | pytest fails on tests/ or test/offline |\n| 6 DONE | `ai-use-log` | PR changing `src/`, `scripts/` or `test/` | no new entry, duplicate id, Without it the\n  dependency gate would red `main` on pre-existing code. No edits made yet.\n\n# Plan — AI-use log gate: allow add *or* edit, forbid delete; validate changed entries\n\n## New rules\n\nFor a gated PR (`src/`, `scripts/`, `test/` changed):\n\n1. **No deletions** — every id present at base must still be present at head. Any base id missing at head → **block**.\n2. **Duplicate ids** at head → **block** (kept as-is).\n3. **Must touch the log** — at least one entry added *or* changed (content differs from base). Pure no-op (log untouched) → block.\n4. **Each added-or-changed entry** must have `agent: opencode` **and** `human_reviewed: true`. Failing either → block, naming the id.\n5. Docs-only PR → pass (unchanged).\n\n\"Added or changed\" = any head entry whose id is new at head, **or** whose entry dict differs from the same id at base. A changed entry must carry `agent: opencode` + `human_reviewed: true`; unchanged carry-over entries are not re-validated (so historical entries without `agent` don't retroactively block).\n\n## Logic changes in `scripts/check_ai_use_log.py`\n\nAdd helpers:\n- `_by_id(entries) -> dict[str, dict]` — map id → entry (first occurrence).\n- selection: `touched = [e for e in head_entries if e[\"id\"] not in base_map or e != base_map[e[\"id\"]]]`.\n\nNew order inside `main` (after gated check):\n1. Parse base entries (from `git show base:LOG`) and head entries (worktree).\n2. Duplicate check on head ids (unchanged).\n3. **Deleted check**: `missing = base_ids - head_ids`; non-empty → block `\"deleted entry id(s): …\"`.\n4. **Touch check**: if no added/changed entry → block `\"no new or changed log entry\"` (lists gated paths).\n5. **Per-touched-entry check**: each touched entry must have `agent == \"opencode\"` and `human_reviewed is True`; collect failures → block `\"entry <id> must have agent: opencode\"` / `\"… human_reviewed: true\"`.\n6.               "content": "\"\"\"CLI entry point for the AI-use log gate (D7 §6.6).\n\nUsage:\n    python scripts/check_ai_use_log.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n\nChecks on a gated PR (src/, scripts/ or test/ changed):\n  1. No entry may be deleted: every id present at base must still be present at head.\n  2. Entry ids must not duplicate one another at head.\n  3. The log must change: at least one entry is added or modified.\n  4. Every added-or-changed entry must have ``agent: opencode`` and\n     ``human_reviewed: true``. Unchanged, carried-over entries are not re-validated.\n\nExit 0 when the PR passes, exit 1 (with a reason) when it is blocked. Docs-only PRs\npass. Stdlib + PyYAML only.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom gate_common import changed, gated, load_yaml\n\nLOG_PATH = \"docs/ai-use-log.yaml\"\nAGENT = \"opencode\"\n\n\ndef _entries(text: str) -> list[dict]:\n    return list(load_yaml(text).get(\"entries\") or [])\n\n\ndef _ids(entries: list[dict]) -> list[str]:\n    return [entry[\"id\"] for entry in entries if entry.get(\"id\")]\n\n\ndef _by_id(entries: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:\n    return {entry[\"id\"]: entry for entry in entries if entry.get(\"id\")}\n\n\ndef _read_at(ref: str, path: str) -> str:\n    result = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"show\", f\"{ref}:{path}\"], capture_output=True, text=True)\n    return result.stdout if result.returncode == 0 else \"\"\n\n\ndef _read_worktree(path: str) -> str:\n    file_path = Path(path)\n    return file_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") if file_path.exists() else \"\"\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str]) -> int:\n    if len(argv) < 3:\n        print(\"usage: check_ai_use_log.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    base, head = argv[1], argv[2]\n\n    gated_paths = gated(changed(base, head))\n    if not gated_paths:\n        print(\"[ai-use-log] docs-only PR: no gated changes, skipping\")\n        return 0\n\n    base_entries = _entries(_read_at(base, LOG_PATH))\n    head_entries = _entries(_read_worktree(LOG_PATH))\n    base_ids = _ids(base_entries)\n    head_ids = _ids(head_entries)\n    base_map = _by_id(base_entries)\n\n    duplicated = sorted({i for i in head_ids if head_ids.count(i) > 1})\n    if duplicated:\n        print(f\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: duplicate entry id(s): {duplicated}\")\n        return 1\n\n    deleted = sorted(set(base_ids) - set(head_ids))\n    if deleted:\n        print(f\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: entry id(s) deleted: {deleted}\")\n        return 1\n\n    touched = [\n        e for e in head_entries if e.get(\"id\") not in base_map or e != base_map[e[\"id\"]]\n    ]\n    if not touched:\n        print(\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: gated paths changed but no log entry added or changed.\")\n        for path in gated_paths:\n            print(f\"    - {path}\")\n        return 1\n\n    problems: list[str] = []\n    for entry in touched:\n        entry_id = str(entry.get(\"id\"))\n        if entry.get(\"agent\") != AGENT:\n            problems.append(f\"{entry_id}: agent must be '{AGENT}'\")\n        if entry.get(\"human_reviewed\") is not True:\n            problems.append(f\"{entry_id}: human_reviewed must be true\")\n    if problems:\n        print(\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: added/changed entries fail validation:\")\n        for problem in problems:\n            print(f\"    - {path}\")\n        return 1\n\n    unreviewed = [str(e.get(\"id\")) for e in new_entries if e.get(\"human_reviewed\") is not True]\n    if unreviewed:\n        print(f\"[ai-use-log] BLOCKED: new entry not human_reviewed: {unreviewed}\")\n        return 1\n\n    print(f\"[ai-use-log] OK: new entry id(s) {[e.get('id') for e in new_entries]}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))",

              "content": "\"\"\"CLI entry point for the AI-use log gate (D7 §6.6).\n\nUsage:\n    python scripts/check_ai_use_log.py <base_sha> <head_sha>\n\nChecks on a gated PR (src/, scripts/ or test/ changed):\n  1.
