              "newString": "def test_cli_usage_error_exits_two(capsys):\n    code = compare_runs.main([\"compare_runs.py\"])\n    assert code == 2\n\n\n# --- Outcome / stop_reason counts per variant --------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_outcome_and_stop_reason_counts_per_variant():\n    a = _manifest(\n        run_id=\"v2-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261121t1200\",\n        outcome=\"Buy\",\n        stop_reason=\"completed\",\n    )\n    b = _manifest(\n        run_id=\"v2-nvda-2026-11-20-r2-20261121t1300\",\n        outcome=\"Buy\",\n        stop_reason=\"budget\",\n    )\n    c = _manifest(\n        run_id=\"v2-nvda-2026-11-20-r3-20261121t1400\",\n        outcome=None,\n        stop_reason=\"completed\",\n    )\n    summary = compare_runs.compare_manifests([a, b, c]).averages[\"v2\"]\n    assert summary[\"outcome_counts\"] == {\"Buy\": 2, \"null\": 1}\n    assert summary[\"stop_reason_counts\"] == {\"completed\": 2, \"budget\": 1}\n\n\ndef test_counts_labelled_per_variant():\n    v0 = _manifest(run_id=\"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261121t1200\", outcome=\"Hold\")\n    v2 = _manifest(run_id=\"v2-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261121t1200\", outcome=\"Buy\")\n    averages = compare_runs.compare_manifests([v0, v2]).averages\n    assert averages[\"v0\"][\"outcome_counts\"] == {\"Hold\": 1}\n    assert averages[\"v2\"][\"outcome_counts\"] == {\"Buy\": 1}\n\n\n# --- Provider keys present in any manifest -----------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_tier_provider_in_non_baseline_manifest_is_compared():\n    baseline = _manifest()  # no tier provider keys\n    other_config = dict(CONFIG, deep_think_provider=\"anthropic\")\n    other = _manifest(config_snapshot=other_config, run_id=\"v2-nvda-2026-11-20-r2-x\")\n    with pytest.raises(IncomparableRunsError) as exc:\n        compare_runs.compare_manifests([baseline, other])\n    assert \"deep_think_provider\" in str(exc.value)\n\n\ndef test_tier_provider_present_in_all_and_matching_passes():\n    config = dict(CONFIG, quick_think_provider=\"openai\")\n    a = _manifest(config_snapshot=config, run_id=\"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\")\n    b = _manifest(config_snapshot=dict(config), run_id=\"v2-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\")\n    comparison = compare_runs.compare_manifests([a, b])\n    assert comparison.guard[\"quick_think_provider\"] == \"openai\"\n\n\ndef test_tier_provider_present_only_in_later_manifest_recorded_in_guard():\n    config = dict(CONFIG, quick_think_provider=\"openai\")\n    baseline = _manifest()  # omits it -> None\n    later = _manifest(config_snapshot=config, run_id=\"v2-nvda-2026-11-20-r2-x\")\n    with pytest.raises(IncomparableRunsError):\n        compare_runs.compare_manifests([baseline, later])\n\n\n# --- Bad / missing manifest files --------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_missing_file_reports_filename(tmp_path):\n    missing = tmp_path / \"nope.json\"\n    with pytest.raises(IncomparableRunsError) as exc:\n        compare_runs.compare_manifest_files([missing])\n    assert \"nope.json\" in str(exc.value)\n\n\ndef test_bad_json_reports_filename(tmp_path):\n    bad = tmp_path / \"bad.json\"\n    bad.write_text(\"{not json\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    with pytest.raises(IncomparableRunsError) as exc:\n        compare_runs.compare_manifest_files([bad])\n    assert \"bad.json\" in str(exc.value)\n\n\ndef test_unsupported_schema_reports_filename(tmp_path):\n    bad = tmp_path / \"old.json\"\n    bad.write_text(json.dumps({\"schema_version\": 999}), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    with pytest.raises(IncomparableRunsError) as exc:\n        compare_runs.compare_manifest_files([bad])\n    assert \"old.json\" in str(exc.value)\n\n\ndef test_cli_missing_file_reports_name_no_traceback(tmp_path, capsys):\n    missing = tmp_path / \"gone.json\"\n    code = compare_runs.main([\"compare_runs.py\", str(missing)])\n    assert code == 1\n    err = capsys.readouterr().err\n    assert \"gone.json\" in err\n    assert \"Traceback\" not in err\n\n\ndef test_cli_bad_json_reports_name_no_traceback(tmp_path, capsys):\n    bad = tmp_path / \"bad.json\"\n    bad.write_text(\"<html>\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    code = compare_runs.main([\"compare_runs.py\", str(bad)])\n    assert code == 1\n    err = capsys.readouterr().err\n    assert \"bad.json\" in err\n    assert \"Traceback\" not in err",

              "patch": "Index: src/cli/run.py\n===================================================================\n--- src/cli/run.py\t\n+++ src/cli/run.py\t\n@@ -1,464 +1,605 @@\n \"\"\"Running one analysis from the CLI: build the graph, stream it into the live view, save the report.\"\"\"\n \n import os\n import sys\n import time\n import webbrowser\n+from datetime import UTC, datetime\n from functools import wraps\n from pathlib import Path\n \n import typer\n from rich.live import Live\n \n from cli.display import (\n     ANALYST_ORDER,\n     AnalystWallTimeTracker,\n     classify_message_type,\n     console,\n     create_layout,\n     display_complete_report,\n     message_buffer,\n     update_analyst_statuses,\n     update_display,\n     update_research_team_status,\n )\n from cli.selections import depth_from_env, get_user_selections, unattended_gaps\n from cli.stats_handler import StatsCallbackHandler\n+from tradingagents import __version__\n from tradingagents.agents.rating import is_review, run_rating\n from tradingagents.dataflows.symbols import safe_ticker_component\n from tradingagents.default_config import DEFAULT_CONFIG\n from tradingagents.graph.analyst_execution import (\n     build_analyst_execution_plan,\n )\n from tradingagents.graph.trading_graph import TradingAgentsGraph\n+from tradingagents.run_recorder import RunEvent, build_run_id, write_manifest\n \n \n def _run_directory(config: dict, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Where this run writes, with the ticker validated as a path component.\n \n     Every other path that interpolates a ticker checks it first; a value of\n     \"..\" here would place the run outside the results directory.\n     \"\"\"\n     return Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / safe_ticker_component(ticker) / trade_date\n \n \n+def _manifest_config_snapshot(config: dict) -> dict:\n+    \"\"\"Scalars from ``config`` that are safe to record in a run manifest.\n+\n+    The recorder already drops secret-pattern keys; keeping only scalar values\n+    here also excludes nested objects and lists that are not comparable settings.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    return {\n+        key: value\n+        for key, value in config.items()\n+        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None\n+    }\n+\n+\n+def write_run_manifest(\n+    *,\n+    config: dict,\n+    ticker: str,\n+    trade_date: str,\n+    asset_type: str,\n+    outcome: str | None,\n+    usage: dict,\n+    failure: str | None,\n+    variant: str,\n+    repeat: int,\n+    at: datetime,\n+    version: str,\n+    duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n+    started_at: float | None = None,\n+    clock=None,\n+) -> Path:\n+    \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n+\n+    Fields owned by other members are placeholders until they land: ``stop_reason``\n+    (C) is ``None``, ``prompt_hashes`` (B) is ``{}``, ``evidence_snapshot`` (A) is\n+    ``None``. ``duration_seconds`` is measured from ``started_at`` and ``clock``\n+    (``time.time`` by default) when not supplied; passing both keeps it testable.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    run_id = build_run_id(variant, ticker, trade_date, repeat, at)\n+    if duration_seconds is None and started_at is not None:\n+        now = (clock or time.time)()\n+        duration_seconds = max(0.0, now - started_at)\n+\n+    event = RunEvent(\n+        run_id=run_id,\n+        created_at=at.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(),\n+        version=version,\n+        ticker=ticker,\n+        trade_date=trade_date,\n+        asset_type=asset_type,\n+        outcome=outcome,\n+        config_snapshot=_manifest_config_snapshot(config),\n+        prompt_hashes={},\n+        evidence_snapshot=None,\n+        usage=usage,\n+        duration_seconds=duration_seconds,\n+        failure=failure,\n+        stop_reason=None,\n+    )\n+    manifest_dir = Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\" / run_id\n+    manifest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    return write_manifest(event, manifest_dir / \"manifest.json\")\n+\n+\n+def _make_manifest_writer(config: dict, selections: dict, stats_handler):\n+    \"\"\"Return a ``write(failure=..., outcome=...)`` bound to this run's inputs.\n+\n+    The run_id variant is ``v0`` (the original path) until variant selection is\n+    wired; ``repeat`` is 1 and ``created_at`` is now, both supplied here so the\n+    recorder never reads the clock itself.\n+    \"\"\"\n+\n+    def write(*, failure, outcome):\n+        return write_run_manifest(\n+            config=config,\n+            ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n+            trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n+            asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n+            outcome=outcome,\n+            usage=stats_handler.get_stats(),\n+            failure=failure,\n+            variant=\"v0\",\n+            repeat=1,\n+            at=datetime.now(UTC),\n+            version=__version__,\n+        )\n+\n+    return write\n+\n+\n+def _finalize_run_manifest(\n+    *,\n+    write,\n+    graph,\n+    ticker: str,\n+    trade_date: str,\n+    asset_type: str,\n+    portfolio,\n+    final_state,\n+    failure: BaseException | None,\n+) -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Write the manifest, then dispose of (or keep) the checkpoint.\n+\n+    The manifest is written **before** the checkpoint is cleared, so a crash in\n+    teardown never loses the record. A failed run still writes a manifest with\n+    ``failure`` set and keeps its checkpoint for resume; the failure is re-raised.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    outcome = None if final_state is None else run_rating(final_state)\n+    write(failure=None if failure is None else str(failure), outcome=outcome)\n+\n+    if failure is not None:\n+        raise failure\n+\n+    if final_state is not None:\n+        graph.record_decision(ticker, trade_date, final_state)\n+    graph.clear_checkpoint_on_success(ticker, trade_date, asset_type, portfolio)\n+\n+\n def _announce_checkpoint_state(graph, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Say whether this run resumed a saved one, where the user can see it.\n \n     The graph logs this, but nothing in the CLI configures logging and the live\n     view owns the screen, so a resume was invisible.\n     \"\"\"\n     if getattr(graph, \"_resuming\", False):\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Resuming the saved run for {ticker} on {trade_date}\"\n         )\n     else:\n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Starting fresh for {ticker} on {trade_date}\")\n \n \n def _build_run_config(selections: dict, checkpoint: bool | None) -> dict:\n     \"\"\"Assemble the run config from interactive selections, honoring env precedence.\n \n     Round counts and checkpoint follow \"explicit env/flag wins\": an env-applied\n     value on DEFAULT_CONFIG is preserved unless the user overrode it on the CLI.\n     \"\"\"\n     config = DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy()\n     # Research depth sets both round counts, but an explicit env override\n     # (TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS / _MAX_RISK_ROUNDS) wins over the\n     # interactive selection — leave the env-applied value in place (#977).\n     rounds = ((\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS\", \"max_debate_rounds\"),\n               (\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_RISK_ROUNDS\", \"max_risk_discuss_rounds\"))\n     depth_was_asked = not depth_from_env()\n     for env_var, key in rounds:\n         if not os.environ.get(env_var):\n             config[key] = selections[\"research_depth\"]\n         elif depth_was_asked:\n             # The depth question appeared (it is skipped only when both are\n             # set), so say which half of the answer the environment overrode.\n             console.print(\n                 f\"[green]✓ {key} from environment:[/green] {config[key]} \"\n                 f\"(set by {env_var}, so the research depth you chose does not apply to it)\"\n             )\n     config[\"quick_think_llm\"] = selections[\"quick_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"deep_think_llm\"] = selections[\"deep_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"backend_url\"] = selections[\"backend_url\"]\n     config[\"llm_provider\"] = selections[\"llm_provider\"].lower()\n     # Provider-specific thinking configuration. Only the main provider's is\n     # asked; a tier on another provider keeps its configured value (#1440).\n     for key in (\"google_thinking_level\", \"openai_reasoning_effort\", \"anthropic_effort\"):\n         if selections.get(key) is not None:\n             config[key] = selections[key]\n     config[\"output_language\"] = selections.get(\"output_language\", \"English\")\n     # --checkpoint/--no-checkpoint overrides only when explicitly given; omitting\n     # the flag preserves TRADINGAGENTS_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED / the default (#976).\n     if checkpoint is not None:\n         config[\"checkpoint_enabled\"] = checkpoint\n     return config\n \n \n def run_analysis(checkpoint: bool | None = None, portfolio=None, flags=None):\n     flags = flags or {}\n     # With no terminal nothing can answer a prompt: name every question still\n     # open before any model is called, rather than stopping at the first one.\n     if not (sys.stdin and sys.stdin.isatty()):\n         gaps = unattended_gaps(flags)\n         if gaps:\n             console.print(\"[red]No terminal to answer the setup questions. Set:[/red]\")\n             for gap in gaps:\n                 console.print(f\"  {gap}\")\n             raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n \n     selections = get_user_selections(flags)\n \n     config = _build_run_config(selections, checkpoint)\n \n     stats_handler = StatsCallbackHandler()\n \n     # Normalize analyst selection to predefined order (selection is a 'set', order is fixed)\n     selected_set = {analyst.value for analyst in selections[\"analysts\"]}\n     selected_analyst_keys = [a for a in ANALYST_ORDER if a in selected_set]\n     analyst_execution_plan = build_analyst_execution_plan(selected_analyst_keys)\n     analyst_wall_time_tracker = AnalystWallTimeTracker(analyst_execution_plan)\n \n     graph = TradingAgentsGraph(\n         selected_analyst_keys,\n         config=config,\n         debug=True,\n         callbacks=[stats_handler],\n     )\n \n     message_buffer.init_for_analysis(selected_analyst_keys)\n \n     # Track start time for elapsed display\n     start_time = time.time()\n \n     results_dir = _run_directory(config, selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"])\n     results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     report_dir = results_dir / \"reports\"\n     report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     log_file = results_dir / \"message_tool.log\"\n     log_file.touch(exist_ok=True)\n \n     def save_message_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n             func(*args, **kwargs)\n             timestamp, message_type, content = obj.messages[-1]\n             content = content.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")  # Replace newlines with spaces\n             with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                 f.write(f\"{timestamp} [{message_type}] {content}\\n\")\n         return wrapper\n \n     def save_tool_call_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n             func(*args, **kwargs)\n             timestamp, tool_name, args = obj.tool_calls[-1]\n             args_str = \", \".join(f\"{k}={v}\" for k, v in args.items())\n             with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                 f.write(f\"{timestamp} [Tool Call] {tool_name}({args_str})\\n\")\n         return wrapper\n \n     def save_report_section_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(section_name, content):\n             func(section_name, content)\n             if section_name in obj.report_sections and obj.report_sections[section_name] is not None:\n                 content = obj.report_sections[section_name]\n                 if content:\n                     file_name = f\"{section_name}.md\"\n                     text = \"\\n\".join(str(item) for item in content) if isinstance(content, list) else content\n                     with open(report_dir / file_name, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                         f.write(text)\n         return wrapper\n \n     message_buffer.add_message = save_message_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_message\")\n     message_buffer.add_tool_call = save_tool_call_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_tool_call\")\n     message_buffer.update_report_section = save_report_section_decorator(message_buffer, \"update_report_section\")\n \n     layout = create_layout()\n \n     # The alternate screen keeps a layout taller than the window from redrawing\n     # by scrolling; the final report prints after this block, on the normal screen.\n     with Live(layout, refresh_per_second=4, screen=True):\n         # Initial display\n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Selected ticker: {selections['ticker']}\")\n         if selections[\"asset_type\"] != \"stock\":\n             message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Detected asset type: {selections['asset_type']}\")\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Analysis date: {selections['analysis_date']}\"\n         )\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\",\n             f\"Selected analysts: {', '.join(analyst.value for analyst in selections['analysts'])}\",\n         )\n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         # The analysts start together.\n         for spec in analyst_execution_plan.specs:\n             message_buffer.update_agent_status(spec.agent_node, \"in_progress\")\n             analyst_wall_time_tracker.mark_started(spec.key)\n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         spinner_text = (\n             f\"Analyzing {selections['ticker']} on {selections['analysis_date']}...\"\n         )\n         update_display(layout, spinner_text, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         # The same initial state propagate() builds, with the resolved\n         # instrument identity; the graph's Memory Log step settles past\n         # decisions and loads their lessons alongside the analysts.\n         init_agent_state = graph.create_run_state(\n             selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"], selections[\"asset_type\"], portfolio\n         )\n         # Recompile with a checkpointer and inject the thread_id so --checkpoint\n         # actually saves and resumes on the CLI path (#1249); a no-op when\n         # checkpointing is disabled. Torn down in the finally below.\n         checkpoint_tid = graph.begin_checkpoint(\n             selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"], selections[\"asset_type\"], portfolio\n         )\n         if checkpoint_tid is not None:\n             args.setdefault(\"config\", {}).setdefault(\"configurable\", {})[\"thread_id\"] = checkpoint_tid\n             _announce_checkpoint_state(graph, selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"])\n \n         # Stream the analysis. On resume, feed None so LangGraph continues the\n         # interrupted run instead of re-appending the initial state (#1249); the\n         # try/finally tears the checkpointer down even if the stream raises.\n         trace = []\n         try:\n             for messages, chunk in graph.stream_run(graph.checkpoint_input(init_agent_state), **args):\n                 for message in messages:\n                     msg_id = getattr(message, \"id\", None)\n                     if msg_id is not None:\n                         if msg_id in message_buffer._processed_message_ids:\n                             continue\n                         message_buffer._processed_message_ids.add(msg_id)\n \n                     msg_type, content = classify_message_type(message)\n                     if content and content.strip():\n                         message_buffer.add_message(msg_type, content)\n \n                     if hasattr(message, \"tool_calls\") and message.tool_calls:\n tool_call[\"args\"])\n                             else:\n                                 message_buffer.add_tool_call(tool_call.name, tool_call.args)\n \n                 if chunk is None:   # a step inside an analyst's graph: messages only\n                     update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n                     continue\n \n                 update_analyst_statuses(\n                     message_buffer,\n                     chunk,\n                     wall_time_tracker=analyst_wall_time_tracker,\n                 )\n \n update_research_team_status(\"in_progress\")\n                     if bull_hist:\n                         message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"investment_plan\", message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                         \"trader_investment_plan\", chunk[\"trader_investment_plan\"]\n                     )\n                     if chunk.get(\"risk_debate_state\"):\n                     risk_state = chunk[\"risk_debate_state\"]\n                     agg_hist = risk_state.get(\"aggressive_history\", \"\").strip()\n                     con_hist = risk_state.get(\"conservative_history\", \"\").strip()\n                     neu_hist = risk_state.get(\"neutral_history\", \"\").strip()\n                     judge =          message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"final_trade_decision\", f\"### Conservative Analyst Analysis\\n{con_hist}\"\n                         )\n                     if neu_hist:\n                         if message_buffer.agent_status.get(\"Neutral Analyst\") != \"completed\":\n                             message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Neutral                     )\n                     if judge and message_buffer.agent_status.get(\"Portfolio Manager\") != \"completed\":\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Portfolio Manager\", \"in_progress\")\n                         message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"final_trade_decision\", f\"### Portfolio Manager Decision\\n{judge}\"\n                         )\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Aggressive Analyst\", \"completed\")\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Conservative Analyst\", \"completed\")\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Neutral Analyst\", \"completed\")\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Portfolio Manager\", \"completed\")\n \n                 update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n                 trace.append(chunk)\n \n             # Streamed chunks are per-node deltas, not full state. Merge them\n             # so every report field populated across the run is present.\n             final_state = {}\n             for chunk in trace:\n                 final_state.update(chunk)\n \n-            # Clean run: log the decision, then drop this run's checkpoint so a\n-            # later run starts fresh. A mid-stream failure skips both, keeping\n-            # the checkpoint for resume.\n-            graph.record_decision(selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"], final_state)\n-            graph.clear_checkpoint_on_success(\n-                selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"], selections[\"asset_type\"], portfolio\n+            # Clean run: write the manifest, log the decision, then drop this run's\n+            # checkpoint so a later run starts fresh. The manifest is written first,\n+            # inside _finalize_run_manifest, so teardown can never lose the record.\n+            manifest_write = _make_manifest_writer(config, selections, stats_handler)\n+            _finalize_run_manifest(\n+                write=manifest_write,\n+                graph=graph,\n+                ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n+                trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n+                asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n+                portfolio=portfolio,\n+                final_state=final_state,\n+                failure=None,\n             )\n+        except BaseException as failure:\n+            # A failure mid-run still leaves a manifest; the checkpoint is kept for\n+            # resume and the failure is re-raised after the finally below.\n+            manifest_write = _make_manifest_writer(config, selections, stats_handler)\n+            _finalize_run_manifest(\n+                write=manifest_write,\n+                graph=graph,\n+                ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n+                trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n+                asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n+                portfolio=portfolio,\n+                final_state=None,\n+                failure=failure,\n+            )\n         finally:\n             # Always restore the plain uncheckpointed graph, even on failure.\n             graph.end_checkpoint()\n \n         for agent in message_buffer.agent_status:\n             message_buffer.update_agent_status(agent, \"completed\")\n \n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Completed analysis for {selections['analysis_date']}\"\n         )\n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", analyst_wall_time_tracker.format_summary())\n \n         for section in message_buffer.report_sections:\n             if section in final_state:\n                 message_buffer.update_report_section(section, final_state[section])\n \n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n     # Post-analysis prompts (outside Live context for clean interaction)\n     console.print(\"\\n[bold cyan]Analysis Complete![/bold cyan]\\n\")\n \n     # A decision nobody can read is not a position. Say so here rather than\n     # leaving the run to look like a normal result.\n     if is_review(run_rating(final_state)):\n         console.print(\n             \"[yellow]No rating could be read from the final decision, so this run \"\n             \"is recorded for review rather than as a position. Re-run, or read the \"\n             \"decision text below and judge it yourself.[/yellow]\\n\"\n         )\n     console.print(f\"[dim]{analyst_wall_time_tracker.format_summary()}[/dim]\")\n \n     _offer_reports(final_state, graph, selections[\"ticker\"],\n                    save=flags.get(\"save\"), show=flags.get(\"show\"), html=flags.get(\"html\"))\n \n \n def _yes(question: str) -> bool:\n     return typer.prompt(question, default=\"Y\").strip().upper() in (\"Y\", \"YES\", \"\")\n \n \n def _graphical_browser():\n     \"\"\"A browser that opens a page in its own window on this machine, or None.\n \n     Over SSH the page sits on the remote machine, and a terminal browser (lynx,\n     w3m, elinks) would take over the terminal, so neither is offered.\n     \"\"\"\n     if os.environ.get(\"SSH_CONNECTION\") or os.environ.get(\"SSH_TTY\"):\n         return None\n     try:\n         browser = webbrowser.get()\n     except webbrowser.Error:\n         return None\n     if type(browser) is webbrowser.GenericBrowser or isinstance(browser, webbrowser.Elinks):\n         return None\n     return browser\n \n \n def _open_page(page: Path) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Offer to open the saved page in a browser window, and say where it is if opening fails.\"\"\"\n     browser = _graphical_browser()\n     if browser is None or not _yes(\"Open it in your browser?\"):\n         return\n     try:\n         opened = browser.open(page.as_uri())\n     except (webbrowser.Error, OSError):\n         opened = False\n     if not opened:\n         console.print(f\"  [dim]Could not open a browser; the page is at:[/dim] {page}\")\n \n \n def _offer_reports(final_state, graph, ticker, save=None, show=None, html=None):\n     \"\"\"Save the report tree and show it; ``save``/``show``/``html`` answer the questions when given.\n \n     A saved report includes the HTML page unless ``html`` is False. Replace newlines with spaces\n            with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                f.write(f\"{timestamp} [{message_type}] {content}\\n\")\n        return wrapper\n\n    def save_tool_call_decorator(obj, func_name):\n        func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n\n        @wraps(func)\n        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n            func(*args, **kwargs)\n            timestamp, tool_name, args = obj.tool_calls[-1]\n            args_str = \", \".join(f\"{k}={v}\" for k, v in args.items())\n            with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                f.write(f\"{timestamp} [Tool Call] {tool_name}({args_str})\\n\")\n        return wrapper\n\n    def save_report_section_decorator(obj, func_name):\n        func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n\n        @wraps(func)\n        def wrapper(section_name, content):\n            func(section_name, content)\n            if section_name in obj.report_sections and obj.report_sections[section_name] is not None:\n                content = obj.report_sections[section_name]\n                if content:\n                    file_name = f\"{section_name}.md\"\n                    text = \"\\n\".join(str(item) for item in content) if isinstance(content, list) else content\n                    with open(report_dir / file_name, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                        f.write(text)\n        return wrapper\n\n    message_buffer.add_message = save_message_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_message\")\n    message_buffer.add_tool_call = save_tool_call_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_tool_call\")\n    message_buffer.update_report_section = save_report_section_decorator(message_buffer, \"update_report_section\")\n\n    layout = create_layout()\n\n    #               "content": "\"\"\"Offline tests for wiring the run recorder into the CLI run path.\n\nThe CLI's ``run_analysis`` builds a graph and streams it, which cannot run offline;\nthe manifest-writing logic is therefore extracted into small helpers that these\ntests exercise directly. A failing run still writes a manifest with ``failure`` set.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\n\nimport pytest\n\nimport cli.run as cli_run\n\nfrom tradingagents.run_recorder import read_manifest\n\nFIXED_AT = datetime(2026, 11, 21, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)\n\n\ndef _config(**overrides) -> dict:\n    config = {\n        \"results_dir\": \"/tmp/results\",\n        \"llm_provider\": \"openai\",\n        \"quick_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-luna\",\n        \"deep_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-sol\",\n        \"output_language\": \"English\",\n        \"openai_api_key\": \"sk-should-not-persist\",\n    }\n    config.update(overrides)\n    return config\n\n\n# --- config snapshot ---------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_config_snapshot_strips_secret_keys():\n    snapshot = cli_run._manifest_config_snapshot(_config())\n    assert \"openai_api_key\" not in snapshot\n    assert snapshot[\"llm_provider\"] == \"openai\"\n    assert snapshot[\"deep_think_llm\"] == \"gpt-6-sol\"\n\n\ndef test_config_snapshot_keeps_only_scalars():\n    config = _config(nested={\"a\": 1}, some_list=[1, 2])\n    snapshot = cli_run._manifest_config_snapshot(config)\n    assert \"nested\" not in snapshot\n    assert \"some_list\" not in snapshot\n\n\n# --- write_run_manifest ------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_write_run_manifest_writes_under_runs_run_id(tmp_path):\n    path = cli_run.write_run_manifest(\n        config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n        ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n        asset_type=\"stock\",\n        outcome=\"Buy\",\n        usage={\"llm_calls\": 3, \"tool_calls\": 1, \"tokens_in\": 10, \"tokens_out\": 5},\n        duration_seconds=12.0,\n        failure=None,\n        variant=\"v2\",\n        repeat=1,\n        at=FIXED_AT,\n        version=\"0.7.1\",\n    )\n    assert path == tmp_path / \"runs\" / path.parent.name / \"manifest.json\"\n    assert path.parent.name == \"v2-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261121t1200\"\n    manifest = read_manifest(path)\n    assert manifest[\"ticker\"] == \"NVDA\"\n    assert manifest[\"outcome\"] == \"Buy\"\n\n\ndef test_placeholders_for_owner_fields(tmp_path):\n    path = cli_run.write_run_manifest(\n        config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n        ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n        asset_type=\"stock\",\n        outcome=None,\n        usage={\"llm_calls\": 0, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 0, \"tokens_out\": 0},\n        duration_seconds=None,\n        failure=None,\n        variant=\"v2\",\n        repeat=1,\n        at=FIXED_AT,\n        version=\"0.7.1\",\n    )\n    manifest = read_manifest(path)\n    assert manifest[\"stop_reason\"] is None\n    assert manifest[\"prompt_hashes\"] == {}\n    assert manifest[\"evidence_snapshot\"] is None\n\n\ndef test_failed_run_records_failure(tmp_path):\n    path = cli_run.write_run_manifest(\n        config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n        ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n        asset_type=\"stock\",\n        outcome=None,\n        usage={\"llm_calls\": 1, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 5, \"tokens_out\": 0},\n        duration_seconds=3.0,\n        failure=\"boom\",\n        variant=\"v2\",\n        repeat=1,\n        at=FIXED_AT,\n        version=\"0.7.1\",\n    )\n    assert read_manifest(path)[\"failure\"] == \"boom\"\n\n\ndef test_unique_runs_do_not_collide(tmp_path):\n    kwargs = dict(\n        config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n        ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n        asset_type=\"stock\",\n        outcome=\"Buy\",\n        usage={\"llm_calls\": 1, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 1, \"tokens_out\": 0},\n        duration_seconds=1.0,\n        failure=None,\n        variant=\"v2\",\n        version=\"0.7.1\",\n    )\n    first = cli_run.write_run_manifest(repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT, **kwargs)\n    second = cli_run.write_run_manifest(\n        repeat=2, write=lambda **kw: events.append((\"write\", kw.get(\"failure\"))),\n        graph=graph,\n        ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n        asset_type=\"stock\",\n None)) < events.index((\"clear\", None))\n\n\ndef test_manifest_written_on_failure(tmp_path):\n    written = {}\n\n    def write(**kw):\n        written.update(kw)\n        return tmp_path / \"manifest.json\"\n\n    graph = _StubGraph(fail=True)\n\n    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):\n        cli_run._finalize_run_manifest(\n            write=write,\n            graph=graph,\n            ticker=\"NVDA\",\n            trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n            asset_type=\"stock\",\n            portfolio=None,\n            final_state=None,\n            failure=RuntimeError(\"boom\"),\n               "newString": "def _run_directory(config: dict, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where this run writes, with the ticker validated as a path component.\n\n    Every other path that interpolates a ticker checks it first; a value of\n    \"..\" here would place the run outside the results directory.\n    \"\"\"\n    return Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / safe_ticker_component(ticker) / trade_date\n\n\ndef _manifest_config_snapshot(config: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Scalars from ``config`` that are safe to record in a run manifest.\n\n    The recorder already drops secret-pattern keys; keeping only scalar values\n    here also excludes nested objects and lists that are not comparable settings.\n    \"\"\"\n    return {\n        key: value\n        for key, value in config.items()\n        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None\n    }\n\n\ndef write_run_manifest(\n    *,\n    config: dict,\n    ticker: str,\n    trade_date: str,\n    asset_type: str,\n    outcome: str | None,\n    usage: dict,\n    failure: str | None,\n    variant: str,\n    repeat: int,\n    at: datetime,\n    version: str,\n    duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n    started_at: float | None = None,\n    clock=None,\n) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n\n    Fields owned by other members are placeholders until they land: ``stop_reason``\n    (C) is ``None``, ``prompt_hashes`` (B) is ``{}``, ``evidence_snapshot`` (A) is\n    ``None``. ``duration_seconds`` is measured from ``started_at`` and ``clock``\n    (``time.time`` by default) when not supplied; passing both keeps it testable.\n    \"\"\"\n    run_id = build_run_id(variant, ticker, trade_date, repeat, at)\n    if duration_seconds is None and started_at is not None:\n        now = (clock or time.time)()\n        duration_seconds = max(0.0, now - started_at)\n\n    event = RunEvent(\n        run_id=run_id,\n        created_at=at.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(),\n        version=version,\n        ticker=ticker,\n        trade_date=trade_date,\n        asset_type=asset_type,\n        outcome=outcome,\n        config_snapshot=_manifest_config_snapshot(config),\n        prompt_hashes={},\n        evidence_snapshot=None,\n        usage=usage,\n        duration_seconds=duration_seconds,\n        failure=failure,\n        stop_reason=None,\n    )\n    manifest_dir = Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\" / run_id\n    manifest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return write_manifest(event, manifest_dir / \"manifest.json\")\n\n\ndef _finalize_run_manifest(\n    *,\n    write,\n    graph,\n    ticker: str,\n    trade_date: str,\n    asset_type: str,\n    portfolio,\n    final_state,\n    failure: BaseException | None,\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write the manifest, then dispose of (or keep) the checkpoint.\n\n    The manifest is written **before** the checkpoint is cleared, so a crash in\n    teardown never loses the record. A failed run still writes a manifest with\n    ``failure`` set and keeps its checkpoint for resume; the failure is re-raised.\n    \"\"\"\n    outcome = None\n    if final_state is not None:\n        outcome = run_rating(final_state)\n    write(failure=None if failure is None else str(failure), outcome=outcome)\n\n    if failure is not None:\n        raise failure\n\n    if final_state is not None:\n        graph.record_decision(ticker, trade_date, final_state)\n    graph.clear_checkpoint_on_success(ticker, trade_date, asset_type, portfolio)",

a value of\n+    \"..\" here would place the run outside the results directory.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    return Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / safe_ticker_component(ticker) / trade_date\n \n+\n+def _manifest_config_snapshot(config: dict) -> dict:\n+    \"\"\"Scalars from ``config`` that are safe to record in a run manifest.\n+\n+    The recorder already drops secret-pattern keys; keeping only scalar values\n+    here also excludes nested objects and lists that are not comparable settings.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    return {\n+        key: value\n+        for key, value in config.items()\n+        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None\n+    }\n+\n+\n+def write_run_manifest(\n+    *,\n+    config: dict,\n+    ticker: str,\n+    trade_date: str,\n+    asset_type: str,\n+    outcome: str | None,\n+    usage: dict,\n+    failure: str | None,\n+    variant: str,\n+    repeat: int,\n+    at: datetime,\n+    version: str,\n+    duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n+    started_at: float | None = None,\n+    clock=None,\n+) -> Path:\n+    \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n+\n+    Fields owned by other members are placeholders until they land: ``stop_reason``\n+    (C) is ``None``, ``prompt_hashes`` (B) is ``{}``, ``evidence_snapshot`` (A) is\n+    ``None``. ``duration_seconds`` is measured from ``started_at`` and ``clock``\n+    (``time.time`` by default) when not supplied; passing both keeps it testable.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    run_id = build_run_id(variant, ticker, trade_date, repeat, at)\n+    if duration_seconds is None and started_at is not None:\n+        now = (clock or time.time)()\n+        duration_seconds = max(0.0, now - started_at)\n+\n+    event = RunEvent(\n+        run_id=run_id,\n+        created_at=at.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(),\n+        version=version,\n+        ticker=ticker,\n+        trade_date=trade_date,\n+        asset_type=asset_type,\n+        outcome=outcome,\n+        config_snapshot=_manifest_config_snapshot(config),\n+        prompt_hashes={},\n+        evidence_snapshot=None,\n+        usage=usage,\n+        duration_seconds=duration_seconds,\n+        failure=failure,\n+        stop_reason=None,\n+    )\n+    manifest_dir = Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\" / run_id\n+    manifest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    return write_manifest(event, manifest_dir / \"manifest.json\")\n+\n+\n+def _finalize_run_manifest(\n+    *,\n+    write,\n+    graph,\n+    ticker: str,\n+    trade_date: str,\n+    asset_type: str,\n+    portfolio,\n+    final_state,\n+    failure: BaseException | None,\n+) -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Write the manifest, then dispose of (or keep) the checkpoint.\n+\n+    The manifest is written **before** the checkpoint is cleared, so a crash in\n+    teardown never loses the record.               "patch": "Index: src/cli/run.py\n===================================================================\n--- src/cli/run.py\t\n+++ src/cli/run.py\t\n@@ -1,605 +1,630 @@\n \"\"\"Running one analysis from the CLI: build the graph, stream it into the live view, save the report.\"\"\"\n \n import os\n+import re\n import sys\n import time\n import webbrowser\n+from dataclasses import replace\n from datetime import UTC, datetime\n from functools import wraps\n from pathlib import Path\n \n import typer\n from rich.live import Live\n \n from cli.display import (\n     ANALYST_ORDER,\n     AnalystWallTimeTracker,\n     classify_message_type,\n     console,\n     create_layout,\n     display_complete_report,\n     message_buffer,\n     update_analyst_statuses,\n     update_display,\n     update_research_team_status,\n )\n from cli.selections import depth_from_env, get_user_selections, unattended_gaps\n from cli.stats_handler import StatsCallbackHandler\n from tradingagents import __version__\n from tradingagents.agents.rating import is_review, run_rating\n from tradingagents.dataflows.symbols import safe_ticker_component\n from tradingagents.default_config import DEFAULT_CONFIG\n from tradingagents.graph.analyst_execution import (\n     build_analyst_execution_plan,\n )\n from tradingagents.graph.trading_graph import TradingAgentsGraph\n from tradingagents.run_recorder import RunEvent, build_run_id, write_manifest\n \n \n def _run_directory(config: dict, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Where this run writes, with the ticker validated as a path component.\n \n     Every other path that interpolates a ticker checks it first; a value of\n     \"..\" here would place the run outside the results directory.\n     \"\"\"\n     return Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / safe_ticker_component(ticker) / trade_date\n \n \n def _manifest_config_snapshot(config: dict) -> dict:\n     \"\"\"Scalars from ``config`` that are safe to record in a run manifest.\n \n     The recorder already drops secret-pattern keys; keeping only scalar values\n     here also excludes nested objects and lists that are not comparable settings.\n     \"\"\"\n     return {\n         key: value\n         for key, value in config.items()\n         if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None\n     }\n \n \n def write_run_manifest(\n     *,\n     config: dict,\n     ticker: str,\n     trade_date: str,\n     asset_type: str,\n     outcome: str | None,\n     usage: dict,\n     failure: str | None,\n     variant: str,\n     repeat: int,\n     at: datetime,\n     version: str,\n     duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n     started_at: float | None = None,\n     clock=None,\n ) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n \n     Fields owned by other members are placeholders until they land: ``stop_reason``\n     (C) is ``None``, ``prompt_hashes`` (B) is ``{}``, ``evidence_snapshot`` (A) is\n     ``None``. ``duration_seconds`` is measured from ``started_at`` and ``clock``\n     (``time.time`` by default) when not supplied; passing both keeps it testable.\n     \"\"\"\n     run_id = build_run_id(variant, ticker, trade_date, repeat, at)\n     if duration_seconds is None and started_at is not None:\n         now = (clock or time.time)()\n         duration_seconds = max(0.0, now - started_at)\n \n     event = RunEvent(\n         run_id=run_id,\n         created_at=at.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(),\n         version=version,\n         ticker=ticker,\n         trade_date=trade_date,\n         asset_type=asset_type,\n         outcome=outcome,\n         config_snapshot=_manifest_config_snapshot(config),\n         prompt_hashes={},\n         evidence_snapshot=None,\n         usage=usage,\n         duration_seconds=duration_seconds,\n         failure=failure,\n         stop_reason=None,\n     )\n-    manifest_dir = Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\" / run_id\n+    runs_dir = Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\"\n+    run_id = _unique_run_id(runs_dir, run_id)\n+    event = replace(event, run_id=run_id)\n+    manifest_dir = runs_dir / run_id\n     manifest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     return write_manifest(event, manifest_dir / \"manifest.json\")\n \n \n-def _make_manifest_writer(config: dict, selections: dict, stats_handler):\n+def _unique_run_id(runs_dir: Path, run_id: str) -> str:\n+    \"\"\"A run_id whose directory does not exist yet, so a same-minute retry is safe.\n+\n+    ``build_run_id`` has minute resolution, so two runs started in the same minute\n+    (or a retry) produce the same id. Appending ``-<n>`` keeps the id within the\n+    recorder's 64-char pattern and never overwrites an earlier manifest.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    pattern = re.compile(r\"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,62}$\")\n+    candidate = run_id\n+    suffix = 2\n+    while (runs_dir / candidate).exists():\n+        candidate = f\"{run_id}-{suffix}\"\n+        if not pattern.match(candidate):\n+            raise ValueError(f\"no free run_id derived from {run_id!r} within 64 chars\")\n+        suffix += 1\n+    return candidate\n+\n+\n+def _make_manifest_writer(config: dict, selections: dict, stats_handler, started_at=None):\n     \"\"\"Return a ``write(failure=..., outcome=...)`` bound to this run's inputs.\n \n     The run_id variant is ``v0`` (the original path) until variant selection is\n     wired; ``repeat`` is 1 and ``created_at`` is now, both supplied here so the\n-    recorder never reads the clock itself.\n+    recorder never reads the clock itself. ``started_at`` is the run's start\n+    (``time.time()``); forwarding it lets the manifest record a real duration.\n     \"\"\"\n \n     def write(*, failure, outcome):\n         return write_run_manifest(\n             config=config,\n             ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n             trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n             asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n             outcome=outcome,\n             usage=stats_handler.get_stats(),\n             failure=failure,\n             variant=\"v0\",\n             repeat=1,\n             at=datetime.now(UTC),\n             version=__version__,\n+            started_at=started_at,\n         )\n \n     return write\n \n \n def _finalize_run_manifest(\n     *,\n     write,\n     graph,\n     ticker: str,\n     trade_date: str,\n     asset_type: str,\n     portfolio,\n     final_state,\n     failure: BaseException | None,\n ) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Write the manifest, then dispose of (or keep) the checkpoint.\n \n     The manifest is written **before** the checkpoint is cleared, so a crash in\n     teardown never loses the record. A failed run still writes a manifest with\n     ``failure`` set and keeps its checkpoint for resume; the failure is re-raised.\n     \"\"\"\n     outcome = None if final_state is None else run_rating(final_state)\n     write(failure=None if failure is None else str(failure), outcome=outcome)\n \n     if failure is not None:\n         raise failure\n \n     if final_state is not None:\n         graph.record_decision(ticker, trade_date, final_state)\n     graph.clear_checkpoint_on_success(ticker, trade_date, asset_type, portfolio)\n \n \n def _announce_checkpoint_state(graph, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Say whether this run resumed a saved one, where the user can see it.\n \n     The graph logs this, but nothing in the CLI configures logging and the live\n     view owns the screen, so a resume was invisible.\n     \"\"\"\n     if getattr(graph, \"_resuming\", False):\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Resuming the saved run for {ticker} on {trade_date}\"\n         )\n     else:\n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Starting fresh for {ticker} on {trade_date}\")\n \n \n def _build_run_config(selections: dict, checkpoint: bool | None) -> dict:\n     \"\"\"Assemble the run config from interactive selections, honoring env precedence.\n \n     Round counts and checkpoint follow \"explicit env/flag wins\": an env-applied\n     value on DEFAULT_CONFIG is preserved unless the user overrode it on the CLI.\n     \"\"\"\n     config = DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy()\n     # Research depth sets both round counts, but an explicit env override\n     # (TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS / _MAX_RISK_ROUNDS) wins over the\n     # interactive selection — leave the env-applied value in place (#977).\n     rounds = ((\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS\", \"max_debate_rounds\"),\n               (\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_RISK_ROUNDS\", \"max_risk_discuss_rounds\"))\n     depth_was_asked = not depth_from_env()\n     for env_var, key in rounds:\n         if not os.environ.get(env_var):\n             config[key] = selections[\"research_depth\"]\n         elif depth_was_asked:\n             # The depth question appeared (it is skipped only when both are\n             # set), so say which half of the answer the environment overrode.\n             console.print(\n                 f\"[green]✓ {key} from environment:[/green] {config[key]} \"\n                 f\"(set by {env_var}, so the research depth you chose does not apply to it)\"\n             )\n     config[\"quick_think_llm\"] = selections[\"quick_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"deep_think_llm\"] = selections[\"deep_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"backend_url\"] = selections[\"backend_url\"]\n     config[\"llm_provider\"] = selections[\"llm_provider\"].lower()\n     # Provider-specific thinking configuration. Only the main provider's is\n     # asked; a tier on another provider keeps its configured value (#1440).\n     for key in (\"google_thinking_level\", \"openai_reasoning_effort\", \"anthropic_effort\"):\n         if selections.get(key) is not None:\n             config[key] = selections[key]\n     config[\"output_language\"] = selections.get(\"output_language\", \"English\")\n     # --checkpoint/--no-checkpoint overrides only when explicitly given; omitting\n     # the flag preserves TRADINGAGENTS_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED / the default (#976).\n     if checkpoint is not None:\n         config[\"checkpoint_enabled\"] = checkpoint\n     return config\n \n \n def run_analysis(checkpoint: bool | None = None, portfolio=None, flags=None):\n     flags = flags or {}\n     # With no terminal nothing can answer a prompt: name every question still\n     # open before any model is called, rather than stopping at the first one.\n     if not (sys.stdin and sys.stdin.isatty()):\n         gaps = unattended_gaps(flags)\n         if gaps:\n             console.print(\"[red]No terminal to answer the setup questions. Set:[/red]\")\n             for gap in gaps:\n                 console.print(f\"  {gap}\")\n             raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n \n     selections = get_user_selections(flags)\n \n     config = _build_run_config(selections, checkpoint)\n \n     stats_handler = StatsCallbackHandler()\n \n     # Normalize analyst selection to predefined order (selection is a 'set', order is fixed)\n     selected_set = {analyst.value for analyst in selections[\"analysts\"]}\n     selected_analyst_keys = [a for a in ANALYST_ORDER if a in selected_set]\n     analyst_execution_plan = build_analyst_execution_plan(selected_analyst_keys)\n     analyst_wall_time_tracker = AnalystWallTimeTracker(analyst_execution_plan)\n \n     graph = TradingAgentsGraph(\n         selected_analyst_keys,\n         config=config,\n         debug=True,\n         callbacks=[stats_handler],\n     )\n \n     message_buffer.init_for_analysis(selected_analyst_keys)\n \n     # Track start time for elapsed display\n     start_time = time.time()\n \n     results_dir = _run_directory(config, selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"])\n     results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     report_dir = results_dir / \"reports\"\n     report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     log_file = results_dir / \"message_tool.log\"\n     log_file.touch(exist_ok=True)\n \n     def save_message_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n             func(*args, **kwargs)\n             timestamp, message_type, content = obj.messages[-1]\n             content = content.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")  # Replace newlines with spaces\n             with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                 f.write(f\"{timestamp} [{message_type}] {content}\\n\")\n         return wrapper\n \n     def save_tool_call_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n             func(*args, **kwargs)\n             timestamp, tool_name, args = obj.tool_calls[-1]\n             args_str = \", \".join(f\"{k}={v}\" for k, v in args.items())\n             with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                 f.write(f\"{timestamp} [Tool Call] {tool_name}({args_str})\\n\")\n         return wrapper\n \n     def save_report_section_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(section_name, content):\n             func(section_name, content)\n             if section_name in obj.report_sections and obj.report_sections[section_name] is not None:\n                 content = obj.report_sections[section_name]\n                 if content:\n                     file_name = f\"{section_name}.md\"\n                     text = \"\\n\".join(str(item) for item in content) if isinstance(content, list) else content\n                     with open(report_dir / file_name, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                         f.write(text)\n         return wrapper\n \n     message_buffer.add_message = save_message_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_message\")\n     message_buffer.add_tool_call = save_tool_call_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_tool_call\")\n     message_buffer.update_report_section = save_report_section_decorator(message_buffer, \"update_report_section\")\n \n     layout = create_layout()\n \n     # The alternate screen keeps a layout taller than the window from redrawing\n     # by scrolling; the final report prints after this block, on the normal screen.\n     with Live(layout, refresh_per_second=4, screen=True):\n         # Initial display\n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Selected ticker: {selections['ticker']}\")\n         if selections[\"asset_type\"] != \"stock\":\n             message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Detected asset type: {selections['asset_type']}\")\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Analysis date: {selections['analysis_date']}\"\n         )\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\",\n             f\"Selected analysts: {', '.join(analyst.value for analyst in selections['analysts'])}\",\n         )\n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         # The analysts start together.\n         for spec in analyst_execution_plan.specs:\n             message_buffer.update_agent_status(spec.agent_node, \"in_progress\")\n             analyst_wall_time_tracker.mark_started(spec.key)\n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         spinner_text = (\n             f\"Analyzing {selections['ticker']} on {selections['analysis_date']}...\"\n         )\n         update_display(layout, spinner_text, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         # The same initial state propagate() builds, with the resolved\n         # instrument identity; the graph's Memory Log step settles past\n         # decisions and loads their lessons alongside the analysts.\n         init_agent_state = graph.create_run_state(\n             selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"], selections[\"asset_type\"], portfolio\n         )\n         # Pass callbacks to graph config for tool execution tracking\n         # (LLM tracking is handled separately via LLM constructor)\n         args = graph.propagator.get_graph_args(callbacks=[stats_handler])\n \n         # Recompile with a checkpointer and inject the thread_id so --checkpoint\n         # actually saves and resumes on the CLI path (#1249); a no-op when\n         # checkpointing is disabled. Torn down in the finally below.\n         checkpoint_tid = graph.begin_checkpoint(\n             selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"], selections[\"asset_type\"], portfolio\n         )\n         if checkpoint_tid is not None:\n             args.setdefault(\"config\", {}).setdefault(\"configurable\", {})[\"thread_id\"] = checkpoint_tid\n             _announce_checkpoint_state(graph, selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"])\n \n         # Stream the analysis. On resume, feed None so LangGraph continues the\n         # interrupted run instead of re-appending the initial state (#1249); the\n         # try/finally tears the checkpointer down even if the Off Windows this stays an\n # empty tuple, which `except` accepts and never matches (#1138).\n if sys.platform == \"win32\":  # pragma: no cover - platform dependent\n     from prompt_toolkit.output.win32 import NoConsoleScreenBufferError\n \n     _NO_CONSOLE_ERRORS: tuple[type[BaseException], ...] = (NoConsoleScreenBufferError,)\n else:\n     _NO_CONSOLE_ERRORS = ()\n \n app = typer.Typer(\n     name=\"TradingAgents\",\n     help=\"TradingAgents CLI: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework\",\n     add_completion=True,  # Enable shell completion\n )\n \n \n @app.callback(invoke_without_command=True)\n def analyze(\n     ctx: typer.Context,\n     checkpoint: bool | None = typer.Option(\n         None,\n         \"--checkpoint/--no-checkpoint\",\n         help=\"Enable/disable checkpoint-resume (save state after each node so a \"\n         \"crashed run can resume). Omit to honor TRADINGAGENTS_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED.\",\n     ),\n     clear_checkpoints: bool = typer.Option(\n         False,\n         \"--clear-checkpoints\",\n         help=\"Delete all saved checkpoints before running (force fresh start).\",\n     ),\n     portfolio: str = typer.Option(\n         None,\n         \"--portfolio\",\n         help=\"JSON file with current holdings and cash, so the trader, risk and \"\n         \"portfolio agents size against your actual position.\",\n     ),\n     ticker: str = typer.Option(None, \"--ticker\", help=\"Ticker to analyze, e.g. NVDA or 0700.HK; skips the prompt\"),\n     date: str = typer.Option(None, \"--date\", help=\"Analysis date, YYYY-MM-DD; skips the prompt\"),\n     analysts: str = typer.Option(\n         None, \"--analysts\", help=\"Comma-separated analysts, e.g. market,news; skips the prompt\"\n     ),\n     save: bool | None = typer.Option(\n         None, \"--save/--no-save\", help=\"Save the report under results_dir without asking\"\n     ),\n     show: bool | None = typer.Option(\n         None, \"--show/--no-show\", help=\"Show the full report at the end without asking\"\n     ),\n     html: bool | None = typer.Option(\n         None, \"--html/--no-html\",\n         help=\"Save the report as one HTML page too, complete_report.html, without asking (default: yes)\",\n     ),\n+    variant: str = typer.Option(\n+        \"v0\", \"--variant\",\n+        help=\"Architecture variant for the run manifest: v0 (original), v1 (trimmed), v2 (adaptive).\",\n+    ),\n ):\n     \"\"\"Run an analysis. This is what a bare `tradingagents` does.\n \n     Flags answer their questions; with provider, models, depth and language also\n     set through TRADINGAGENTS_* variables, the run asks nothing.\n     \"\"\"\n     if ctx.invoked_subcommand is not None:\n         return\n     if clear_checkpoints:\n         from tradingagents.graph.checkpointer import clear_all_checkpoints\n         n = clear_all_checkpoints(DEFAULT_CONFIG[\"data_cache_dir\"])\n         console.print(f\"[yellow]Cleared {n} checkpoint(s).[/yellow]\")\n+    try:\n+        variant = _validate_variant(variant)\n+    except ValueError as exc:\n+        console.print(f\"[red]{exc}[/red]\")\n+        raise typer.Exit(code=1) from None\n     portfolio_context = None\n     if portfolio:\n         try:\n             portfolio_context = load_portfolio(portfolio)\n         except ValueError as exc:\n             console.print(f\"[red]{exc}[/red]\")\n             raise typer.Exit(code=1) from None\n \n     try:\n         flags = {\"ticker\": ticker, \"date\": date, \"analysts\": analysts, \"save\": save, \"show\": show, \"html\": html}\n-        run_analysis(checkpoint=checkpoint, portfolio=portfolio_context, flags=flags)\n+        run_analysis(checkpoint=checkpoint, portfolio=portfolio_context, flags=flags, variant=variant)\n     except _NO_CONSOLE_ERRORS:\n         # A terminal with no console buffer cannot host the interactive prompts.\n         # Emit one actionable line on stderr instead of a prompt_toolkit\n         # traceback; plain text, since rich may not render here either (#1138).\n         typer.echo(\n             \"Error: no Windows console available. The interactive CLI needs a real \"\n             \"console buffer — run it from Windows Terminal, PowerShell, or cmd.exe \"\n             \"rather than a piped or embedded terminal.\",\n             err=True,\n         )\n         raise typer.Exit(code=1) from None\n \n \n @app.command()\n def backtest(\n     tickers: str = typer.Argument(..., help=\"Comma-separated tickers, e.g. NVDA,AAPL\"),\n     start: str = typer.Option(..., \"--start\", help=\"First analysis date, YYYY-MM-DD\"),\n     end: str = typer.Option(..., \"--end\", help=\"Last analysis date, YYYY-MM-DD\"),\n     every: int = typer.Option(7, \"--every\", help=\"Days between analysis dates\"),\n     analysts: str = typer.Option(\n         None, \"--analysts\", help=\"Comma-separated analysts to run: market, sentiment, news, fundamentals; without a\n         # choice, every analyst the asset type allows runs.\n         chosen = (parse_analysts(analysts, kind) if analysts\n                   else filter_analysts_for_asset_type(list(AnalystType), kind))\n     except ValueError as exc:\n         console.print(f\"[red]{exc}[/red]\")\n         raise typer.Exit(code=1) from None\n \n     names = [t.strip() for t in tickers.split(\",\") if t.strip()]\n     if not names:\n         console.print(\"[red]No ticker to analyze; pass them comma-separated, e.g. NVDA,AAPL[/red]\")\n         raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n \n     def show_progress(done, total, ticker, date):\n         console.print(f\"[dim][{done}/{total}] {ticker} {date}[/dim]\")\n \n     kwargs = {\"asset_type\": kind.value, \"portfolio\": book, \"run_id\": run_id, \"progress\": show_progress,\n               \"selected_analysts\": [a.value for a in chosen]}\n \n     try:\n         result = run_backtest(names, dates, DEFAULT_CONFIG, **kwargs)\n     except Exception as exc:  # a missing key or an unknown analyst is a setup error\n         console.print(f\"[red]{exc}[/red]\")\n         raise typer.Exit(code=1) from None\n     console.print(summarize(result).render())\n     console.print(f\"\\nRan {result.cells_run} cells, skipped {result.skipped}. Log: {result.log_path}\")\n     console.print(f\"Continue or settle this sweep: --run-id {result.run_id}\")\n     for ticker, date, reason in result.failures:\n         console.print(f\"[yellow]failed:[/yellow] {ticker} {date}: {reason}\")\n     for ticker, reason in result.settlement_failures:\n         console.print(f\"[yellow]unsettled:[/yellow] {ticker}: {reason}\")\n \n \n # The plans `login` and `logout` take: the providers signed in to, not keyed.\n Plan = StrEnum(\"Plan\", {name: name for name in SIGNED_IN_PROVIDERS})\n \n \n @app.command()\n def login(plan: Annotated[Plan, typer.Argument(help=\"The plan to sign in with\")]):\n     \"\"\"Sign in with your ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan, for the chatgpt provider.\"\"\"\n     from tradingagents.llm_clients import chatgpt_auth\n \n     try:\n         # One unwrapped line, so the sign-in address can be copied whole.\n         email = chatgpt_auth.sign_in(\n             say=lambda line: console.print(line, soft_wrap=True, markup=False, highlight=False))\n     except chatgpt_auth.ChatGPTAuthError as exc:\n         console.print(f\"[red]{escape(str(exc))}[/red]\")\n         raise typer.Exit(code=1) from None\n     console.print(f\"[green]Signed in to ChatGPT as {escape(email)}.[/green]\")\n \n \n @app.command()\n def logout(plan: Annotated[Plan, typer.Argument(help=\"The plan to sign out of\")]):\n     \"\"\"Sign out of your ChatGPT plan: revoke this machine's access and forget it.\"\"\"\n     from tradingagents.llm_clients import chatgpt_auth\n \n     outcome = chatgpt_auth.sign_out()\n     if outcome == \"revoked\":\n         console.print(\"Signed out of ChatGPT.\")\n     elif outcome == \"forgotten\":\n         console.print(\"[yellow]Signed out here, but OpenAI could not be reached to revoke the sign-in; \"\n                       \"it stays valid at OpenAI until it expires.[/yellow]\")\n     else:\n         console.print(\"Not signed in to ChatGPT.\")\n \n \n if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n     app()\n",

              "patch": "Index: src/cli/run.py\n===================================================================\n--- src/cli/run.py\t\n+++ src/cli/run.py\t\n@@ -1,630 +1,649 @@\n \"\"\"Running one analysis from the CLI: build the graph, stream it into the live view, save the report.\"\"\"\n \n import os\n import re\n import sys\n import time\n import webbrowser\n from dataclasses import replace\n from datetime import UTC, datetime\n from functools import wraps\n from pathlib import Path\n \n import typer\n from rich.live import Live\n \n from cli.display import (\n     ANALYST_ORDER,\n     AnalystWallTimeTracker,\n     classify_message_type,\n     console,\n     create_layout,\n     display_complete_report,\n     message_buffer,\n     update_analyst_statuses,\n     update_display,\n     update_research_team_status,\n )\n from cli.selections import depth_from_env, get_user_selections, unattended_gaps\n from cli.stats_handler import StatsCallbackHandler\n from tradingagents import __version__\n from tradingagents.agents.rating import is_review, run_rating\n from tradingagents.dataflows.symbols import safe_ticker_component\n from tradingagents.default_config import DEFAULT_CONFIG\n from tradingagents.graph.analyst_execution import (\n     build_analyst_execution_plan,\n )\n from tradingagents.graph.trading_graph import TradingAgentsGraph\n from tradingagents.run_recorder import RunEvent, build_run_id, write_manifest\n \n+_VALID_VARIANTS = (\"v0\", \"v1\", \"v2\")\n \n+\n+def _validate_variant(value: str) -> str:\n+    \"\"\"Accept only a known, lowercase architecture variant slug (``v0``/``v1``/``v2``).\n+\n+    The value becomes the first segment of the manifest ``run_id`` and a directory\n+    name under the results root, so an unknown or unsafe value is rejected rather\n+    than interpolated.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if value not in _VALID_VARIANTS:\n+        raise ValueError(\n+            f\"invalid variant {value!r}; expected one of {', '.join(_VALID_VARIANTS)}\"\n+        )\n+    return value\n+\n+\n+\n def _run_directory(config: dict, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Where this run writes, with the ticker validated as a path component.\n \n     Every other path that interpolates a ticker checks it first; a value of\n     \"..\" here would place the run outside the results directory.\n     \"\"\"\n     return Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / safe_ticker_component(ticker) / trade_date\n \n \n def _manifest_config_snapshot(config: dict) -> dict:\n     \"\"\"Scalars from ``config`` that are safe to record in a run manifest.\n \n     The recorder already drops secret-pattern keys; keeping only scalar values\n     here also excludes nested objects and lists that are not comparable settings.\n     \"\"\"\n     return {\n         key: value\n         for key, value in config.items()\n         if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None\n     }\n \n \n def write_run_manifest(\n     *,\n     config: dict,\n     ticker: str,\n     trade_date: str,\n     asset_type: str,\n     outcome: str | None,\n     usage: dict,\n     failure: str | None,\n     variant: str,\n     repeat: int,\n     at: datetime,\n     version: str,\n     duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n     started_at: float | None = None,\n     clock=None,\n ) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n \n     Fields owned by other members are placeholders until they land: ``stop_reason``\n     (C) is ``None``, ``prompt_hashes`` (B) is ``{}``, ``evidence_snapshot`` (A) is\n     ``None``. ``duration_seconds`` is measured from ``started_at`` and ``clock``\n     (``time.time`` by default) when not supplied; passing both keeps it testable.\n     \"\"\"\n     run_id = build_run_id(variant, ticker, trade_date, repeat, at)\n     if duration_seconds is None and started_at is not None:\n         now = (clock or time.time)()\n         duration_seconds = max(0.0, now - started_at)\n \n     event = RunEvent(\n         run_id=run_id,\n         created_at=at.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(),\n         version=version,\n         ticker=ticker,\n         trade_date=trade_date,\n         asset_type=asset_type,\n         outcome=outcome,\n         config_snapshot=_manifest_config_snapshot(config),\n         prompt_hashes={},\n         evidence_snapshot=None,\n         usage=usage,\n         duration_seconds=duration_seconds,\n         failure=failure,\n         stop_reason=None,\n     )\n     runs_dir = Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\"\n     run_id = _unique_run_id(runs_dir, run_id)\n     event = replace(event, run_id=run_id)\n     manifest_dir = runs_dir / run_id\n     manifest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     return write_manifest(event, manifest_dir / \"manifest.json\")\n \n \n def _unique_run_id(runs_dir: Path, run_id: str) -> str:\n     \"\"\"A run_id whose directory does not exist yet, so a same-minute retry is safe.\n \n     ``build_run_id`` has minute resolution, so two runs started in the same minute\n     (or a retry) produce the same id. Research depth sets both round counts, but an explicit env override\n     # (TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS / _MAX_RISK_ROUNDS) wins over the\n     # interactive selection — leave the env-applied value in place (#977).\n     rounds = ((\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS\", \"max_debate_rounds\"),\n               (\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_RISK_ROUNDS\", \"max_risk_discuss_rounds\"))\n     depth_was_asked = not depth_from_env()\n     for env_var, key in rounds:\n         if not os.environ.get(env_var):\n             config[key] = selections[\"research_depth\"]\n         elif depth_was_asked:\n             #               "content": "\"\"\"Offline tests for the ``--variant`` option on the analyze command.\n\nThe variant selects the architecture under test (v0 original, v1 trimmed, v2\nadaptive).               "newString": "def _make_manifest_writer(config: dict, selections: dict, stats_handler, started_at=None, variant=\"v0\"):\n    \"\"\"Return a ``write(failure=..., outcome=...)`` bound to this run's inputs.\n\n    ``variant`` selects the architecture under test and becomes the first segment\n    of the manifest ``run_id``; ``repeat`` is 1 and ``created_at`` is now, both\n    supplied here so the recorder never reads the clock itself. ``started_at`` is\n    the run's start (``time.time()``); forwarding it lets the manifest record a\n    real duration.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def write(*, failure, outcome):\n        return write_run_manifest(\n            config=config,\n            ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n            trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n            asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n            outcome=outcome,\n            usage=stats_handler.get_stats(),\n            failure=failure,\n            variant=variant,\n            repeat=1,\n            at=datetime.now(UTC),\n            version=__version__,\n            started_at=started_at,\n        )\n\n    return write",
