The depth question appeared (it is skipped only when both are\n             # set), so say which half of the answer the environment overrode.\n             console.print(\n                 f\"[green]✓ {key} from environment:[/green] {config[key]} \"\n                 f\"(set by {env_var}, so the research depth you chose does not apply to it)\"\n             )\n     config[\"quick_think_llm\"] = selections[\"quick_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"deep_think_llm\"] = selections[\"deep_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"backend_url\"] = selections[\"backend_url\"]\n     config[\"llm_provider\"] = selections[\"llm_provider\"].lower()\n     # Provider-specific thinking configuration. Only the main provider's is\n     # asked; a tier on another provider keeps its configured value (#1440).\n     for key in (\"google_thinking_level\", \"openai_reasoning_effort\", \"anthropic_effort\"):\n         if selections.get(key) is not None:\n             config[key] = selections[key]\n     config[\"output_language\"] = selections.get(\"output_language\", \"English\")\n     # --checkpoint/--no-checkpoint overrides only when explicitly given; omitting\n     # the flag preserves TRADINGAGENTS_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED / the default (#976).\n     if checkpoint is not None:\n         config[\"checkpoint_enabled\"] = checkpoint\n     return config\n \n \n def _reject_unavailable_variant(variant: str, config: dict | None = None) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Refuse v1/v2 until C's ``workflow_variant`` key is wired into the graph.\n \n     v0 is always allowed. A non-v0 variant is allowed only when ``config`` actually\n     carries ``workflow_variant`` (C's enable switch); otherwise this raises\n     ``typer.Exit`` before any model call, so a v0-compatible run is never labelled\n     v1/v2.\n     \"\"\"\n     if variant == \"v0\":\n         return\n     if (config if config is not None else DEFAULT_CONFIG).get(\"workflow_variant\"):\n         return\n     console.print(\n         f\"[red]Variant {variant!r} is not available yet: the workflow only \"\n         f\"implements v0. Run with --variant v0.[/red]\"\n     )\n     raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n \n \n def run_analysis(checkpoint: bool | None = None, portfolio=None, flags=None, variant=\"v0\"):\n     flags = flags or {}\n     variant = _validate_variant(variant)\n     # v1/v2 are not implemented in the workflow yet (C's `workflow_variant` key is\n     # not wired into the graph). Refuse them before any setup or model call.\n     _reject_unavailable_variant(variant)\n     # With no terminal nothing can answer a prompt: name every question still\n     # open before any model is called, rather than stopping at the first one.\n     if not (sys.stdin and sys.stdin.isatty()):\n         gaps = unattended_gaps(flags)\n         if gaps:\n             console.print(\"[red]No terminal to answer the setup questions. Set:[/red]\")\n             for gap in gaps:\n                 console.print(f\"  {gap}\")\n             raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n \n     selections = get_user_selections(flags)\n \n     config = _build_run_config(selections, checkpoint)\n \n     stats_handler = StatsCallbackHandler()\n \n     # Normalize analyst selection to predefined order (selection is a 'set', order is fixed)\n     selected_set = {analyst.value for analyst in selections[\"analysts\"]}\n     selected_analyst_keys = [a for a in ANALYST_ORDER if a in selected_set]\n     analyst_execution_plan = build_analyst_execution_plan(selected_analyst_keys)\n     analyst_wall_time_tracker = AnalystWallTimeTracker(analyst_execution_plan)\n \n     graph = TradingAgentsGraph(\n         selected_analyst_keys,\n         config=config,\n         debug=True,\n         callbacks=[stats_handler],\n     )\n \n     message_buffer.init_for_analysis(selected_analyst_keys)\n \n     # Track start time for elapsed display\n     start_time = time.time()\n \n     results_dir = _run_directory(config, selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"])\n     results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     report_dir = results_dir / \"reports\"\n     report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     log_file = results_dir / \"message_tool.log\"\n     log_file.touch(exist_ok=True)\n \n     def save_message_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n             func(*args, **kwargs)\n             timestamp, message_type, content = obj.messages[-1]\n             content = content.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")  # Pass callbacks to graph config for tool execution tracking\n         # (LLM tracking is handled separately via LLM constructor)\n         args = graph.propagator.get_graph_args(callbacks=[stats_handler])\n \n         # On resume, feed None so LangGraph continues the\n         # interrupted run instead of re-appending the initial state (#1249); the\n         # try/finally tears the checkpointer down even if the message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Portfolio Manager\", \"completed\")\n \n                 update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n                 trace.append(chunk)\n \n             # Streamed chunks are per-node deltas, not full state. The manifest is written first,\n             # inside _finalize_run_manifest, so teardown can never lose the record.\n             manifest_write = _make_manifest_writer(config, selections, stats_handler, started_at=start_time, variant=variant)\n             _finalize_run_manifest(\n                 write=manifest_write,\n                 graph=graph,\n                 ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n                 trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n                 asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n                 portfolio=portfolio,\n                 final_state=final_state,\n                 failure=None,\n             )\n         except BaseException as failure:\n             # A failure mid-run still leaves a manifest; the checkpoint is kept for\n             # resume and the failure is re-raised after the finally below.\n             manifest_write = _make_manifest_writer(config, selections, stats_handler, started_at=start_time, variant=variant)\n             _finalize_run_manifest(\n                 write=manifest_write,\n                 graph=graph,\n                 ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n                 trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n                 asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n                 portfolio=portfolio,\n                 final_state=None,\n                 failure=failure,\n             )\n         finally:\n             # Always restore the plain uncheckpointed graph, even on failure.\n             graph.end_checkpoint()\n \n         for agent in message_buffer.agent_status:\n             message_buffer.update_agent_status(agent, \"completed\")\n \n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Completed analysis for {selections['analysis_date']}\"\n         )\n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", analyst_wall_time_tracker.format_summary())\n \n         for section in message_buffer.report_sections:\n             if section in final_state:\n                 message_buffer.update_report_section(section, final_state[section])\n \n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n     # Post-analysis prompts (outside Live context for clean interaction)\n     console.print(\"\\n[bold cyan]Analysis Complete![/bold cyan]\\n\")\n \n     # A decision nobody can read is not a position. Say so here rather than\n     # leaving the run to look like a normal result.\n     if is_review(run_rating(final_state)):\n         console.print(\n             \"[yellow]No rating could be read from the final decision, so this run \"\n             \"is recorded for review rather than as a position. Re-run, or read the \"\n             \"decision text below and judge it yourself.[/yellow]\\n\"\n         )\n     console.print(f\"[dim]{analyst_wall_time_tracker.format_summary()}[/dim]\")\n \n     _offer_reports(final_state, graph, selections[\"ticker\"],\n                    save=flags.get(\"save\"), show=flags.get(\"show\"), html=flags.get(\"html\"))\n \n \n def _yes(question: str) -> bool:\n     return typer.prompt(question, default=\"Y\").strip().upper() in (\"Y\", \"YES\", \"\")\n \n \n def _graphical_browser():\n     \"\"\"A browser that opens a page in its own window on this machine, or None.\n \n     Over SSH the page sits on the remote machine, and a terminal browser (lynx,\n     w3m, elinks) would take over the terminal, so neither is offered.\n     \"\"\"\n     if os.environ.get(\"SSH_CONNECTION\") or os.environ.get(\"SSH_TTY\"):\n         return None\n     try:\n         browser = webbrowser.get()\n     except webbrowser.Error:\n         return None\n     if type(browser) is webbrowser.GenericBrowser or isinstance(browser, webbrowser.Elinks):\n         return None\n     return browser\n \n \n def _open_page(page: Path) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Offer to open the saved page in a browser window, and say where it is if opening fails.\"\"\"\n     browser = _graphical_browser()\n     if browser is None or not _yes(\"Open it in your browser?\"):\n         return\n     try:\n         opened = browser.open(page.as_uri())\n     except (webbrowser.Error, OSError):\n         opened = False\n     if not opened:\n         console.print(f\"  [dim]Could not open a browser; the page is at:[/dim] {page}\")\n \n \n def _offer_reports(final_state, graph, ticker, save=None, show=None, html=None):\n     \"\"\"Save the report tree and show it; ``save``/``show``/``html`` answer the questions when given.\n \n     A saved report includes the HTML page unless ``html`` is False. Someone\n     answering the save question at the prompt is also asked about the page and\n     offered to open it; a run whose flags answer the save question asks neither.\n     \"\"\"\n     asked = save is None\n     if asked:\n         save = typer.prompt(\"Save report?\", default=\"Y\").strip().upper() in (\"Y\", \"YES\", \"\")\n     if save:\n         # Under results_dir, not the working directory: in Docker the working\n         # directory is inside the container and the report goes with it, while\n         # results_dir is the mounted volume the rest of the run already writes to.\n         save_path = graph.default_report_path(ticker)\n         if asked:   # someone at the prompt may pick another folder\n             save_path = Path(typer.prompt(\n                 \"Save path (press Enter for default)\", default=str(save_path)\n             ).strip())\n         if html is None:\n             html = _yes(\"Also save it as an HTML page?\") if asked else True\n         saved = False\n         try:\n             report_file = graph.save_reports(final_state, ticker, save_path, html=html)\n             saved = True\n             console.print(f\"\\n[green]✓ Report saved to:[/green] {save_path.resolve()}\")\n             console.print(f\"  [dim]Complete report:[/dim] {report_file.name}\")\n         except Exception as e:\n             console.print(f\"[red]Error saving report: {e}[/red]\")\n         if saved and html:\n             page = (save_path / \"complete_report.html\").resolve()\n             console.print(f\"  [dim]HTML report:[/dim] {page.name}\")\n             if asked:\n                 _open_page(page)\n \n     if show is None:\n         show = typer.prompt(\"\\nDisplay full report on screen?\", default=\"Y\").strip().upper() in (\"Y\", \"YES\", \"\")\n     if show:\n         display_complete_report(final_state)\n",

              "newString": "def compare_manifests(manifests: list[dict], evidence_modes: list[str | None] | None = None) -> Comparison:\n    \"\"\"Compare already-loaded manifests; raise ``IncomparableRunsError`` if invalid.\n\n    ``evidence_modes`` aligns with ``manifests`` (E4 ``evidence-mode.json``): the mode\n    is a control that must match across every run, so strict and report_reference\n    runs are never compared together. When omitted, every mode is ``None`` (no\n    sidecar), which is itself required to be uniform.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not manifests:\n        raise IncomparableRunsError(\"no manifests supplied\")\n    modes = list(evidence_modes) if evidence_modes is not None else [None] * len(manifests)\n    if len(modes) != len(manifests):\n        raise IncomparableRunsError(\"evidence_modes must align with manifests\")\n    if len(set(modes)) > 1:\n        raise IncomparableRunsError(\n            \"runs are not comparable; evidence_mode differs (strict vs report_reference \"\n            \"are never compared together): \" + \", \".join(repr(m) for m in modes)\n        )\n    shared_mode = modes[0]\n\n    baseline_guard = _guard_of(manifests[0])\n    baseline_guard[\"evidence_mode\"] = shared_mode\n    for manifest in manifests[1:]:\n        _check_comparable(_guard_of(manifest), baseline_guard)",

              "newString": "def _evidence_mode_of(manifest_path: Path) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Read the E4 ``evidence-mode.json`` beside a manifest; ``None`` when absent.\n\n    A missing sidecar means the run predates E4 or recorded no mode; it compares\n    as ``None`` and so is only comparable with other sidecar-less runs.\n    \"\"\"\n    sidecar = Path(manifest_path).parent / \"evidence-mode.json\"\n    if not sidecar.exists():\n        return None\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(sidecar.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:\n        raise IncomparableRunsError(f\"cannot read evidence-mode {str(sidecar)!r}: {exc}\") from exc\n    return data.get(\"evidence_mode\")\n\n\ndef compare_manifest_files(paths: list[str | Path]) -> Comparison:\n    manifests = []\n    modes = []\n    for path in paths:\n        try:\n            manifests.append(read_manifest(path))\n        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:\n            # read_manifest raises ValueError for a bad/unsupported/short manifest\n            # and OSError (e.g. FileNotFoundError) for an unreadable path.\n            raise IncomparableRunsError(f\"cannot read manifest {str(path)!r}: {exc}\") from exc\n        modes.append(_evidence_mode_of(Path(path)))\n    return compare_manifests(manifests, evidence_modes=modes)",
              "oldString": "def compare_manifest_files(paths: list[str | Path]) -> Comparison:\n    manifests = []\n    for path in paths:\n        try:\n            manifests.append(read_manifest(path))\n        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:\n            # read_manifest raises ValueError for a bad/unsupported/short manifest\n            # and OSError (e.g. FileNotFoundError) for an unreadable path.\n            raise IncomparableRunsError(f\"cannot read manifest {str(path)!r}: {exc}\") from exc\n    return compare_manifests(manifests)"

              "file": "src/cli/run.py",
              "patch": "Index: src/cli/run.py\n===================================================================\n--- src/cli/run.py\t\n+++ src/cli/run.py\t\n@@ -1,721 +1,721 @@\n \"\"\"Running one analysis from the CLI: build the graph, stream it into the live view, save the report.\"\"\"\n \n import json\n import os\n import re\n import sys\n import time\n import webbrowser\n from dataclasses import replace\n from datetime import UTC, datetime\n from functools import wraps\n from pathlib import Path\n \n import typer\n from rich.live import Live\n \n from cli.display import (\n     ANALYST_ORDER,\n     AnalystWallTimeTracker,\n     classify_message_type,\n     console,\n     create_layout,\n     display_complete_report,\n     message_buffer,\n     update_analyst_statuses,\n     update_display,\n     update_research_team_status,\n )\n from cli.selections import depth_from_env, get_user_selections, unattended_gaps\n from cli.stats_handler import StatsCallbackHandler\n from tradingagents import __version__\n from tradingagents.agents.rating import is_review, run_rating\n from tradingagents.dataflows.symbols import safe_ticker_component\n from tradingagents.default_config import DEFAULT_CONFIG\n from tradingagents.graph.analyst_execution import (\n     build_analyst_execution_plan,\n )\n from tradingagents.graph.trading_graph import TradingAgentsGraph\n from tradingagents.run_recorder import RunEvent, build_run_id, write_manifest\n \n _VALID_VARIANTS = (\"v0\", \"v1\", \"v2\")\n \n \n def _validate_variant(value: str) -> str:\n     \"\"\"Accept only a known, lowercase architecture variant slug (``v0``/``v1``/``v2``).\n \n     The value becomes the first segment of the manifest ``run_id`` and a directory\n     name under the results root, so an unknown or unsafe value is rejected rather\n     than interpolated.\n     \"\"\"\n     if value not in _VALID_VARIANTS:\n         raise ValueError(\n             f\"invalid variant {value!r}; expected one of {', '.join(_VALID_VARIANTS)}\"\n         )\n     return value\n \n \n \n def _run_directory(config: dict, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Where this run writes, with the ticker validated as a path component.\n \n     Every other path that interpolates a ticker checks it first; a value of\n     \"..\" here would place the run outside the results directory.\n     \"\"\"\n     return Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / safe_ticker_component(ticker) / trade_date\n \n \n def _manifest_config_snapshot(config: dict) -> dict:\n     \"\"\"Scalars from ``config`` that are safe to record in a run manifest.\n \n     The recorder already drops secret-pattern keys; keeping only scalar values\n     here also excludes nested objects and lists that are not comparable settings.\n     ``results_dir`` is a machine-local output path, not a comparable setting, so it\n     is left out of the manifest.\n     \"\"\"\n     return {\n         key: value\n         for key, value in config.items()\n         if key != \"results_dir\"\n         and (isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None)\n     }\n \n \n def write_run_manifest(\n     *,\n     config: dict,\n     ticker: str,\n     trade_date: str,\n     asset_type: str,\n     outcome: str | None,\n     usage: dict,\n     failure: str | None,\n     variant: str,\n     repeat: int,\n     at: datetime,\n     version: str,\n     duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n     started_at: float | None = None,\n     clock=None,\n     stop_reason: str | None = None,\n-    evidence_mode: str = \"report_reference\",\n+    evidence_mode: str = \"strict\",\n ) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n \n     ``stop_reason`` is read from the run's final state by the caller (C owns the\n     value domain); it is ``None`` when the graph did not reach a terminal state.\n     ``prompt_hashes`` (B) is ``{}`` and ``evidence_snapshot`` (A) is ``None`` until\n     those members' contracts land. ``duration_seconds`` is measured from\n     ``started_at`` and ``clock`` (``time.time`` by default) when not supplied;\n     passing both keeps it testable.\n \n     A per-run ``evidence-mode.json`` sidecar (E4) is written next to the manifest\n     recording the evidence mode and the facts the run observed. It does not change\n     the RunEvent v1 15 fields.\n     \"\"\"\n     run_id = build_run_id(variant, ticker, trade_date, repeat, at)\n     if duration_seconds is None and started_at is not None:\n         now = (clock or time.time)()\n         duration_seconds = max(0.0, now - started_at)\n \n     event = RunEvent(\n         run_id=run_id,\n         created_at=at.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(),\n         version=version,\n         ticker=ticker,\n         trade_date=trade_date,\n         asset_type=asset_type,\n         outcome=outcome,\n         config_snapshot=_manifest_config_snapshot(config),\n         prompt_hashes={},\n         evidence_snapshot=None,\n         usage=usage,\n         duration_seconds=duration_seconds,\n         failure=failure,\n         stop_reason=stop_reason,\n     )\n     runs_dir = Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\"\n     run_id = _unique_run_id(runs_dir, run_id)\n     event = replace(event, run_id=run_id)\n     manifest_dir = runs_dir / run_id\n     manifest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     path = write_manifest(event, manifest_dir / \"manifest.json\")\n     write_evidence_mode(manifest_dir / \"evidence-mode.json\", run_id, evidence_mode)\n     return path\n \n \n _EVIDENCE_MODES = (\"strict\", \"report_reference\")\n \n \n def write_evidence_mode(path, run_id: str, evidence_mode: str) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Write the E4 ``evidence-mode.json`` sidecar recording this run's mode.\n \n     E records facts only; the authoritative action and the mode approval belong to\n     D/C, so those fields are ``None`` here unless a caller later fills them in.\n     \"\"\"\n     if evidence_mode not in _EVIDENCE_MODES:\n         raise ValueError(\n             f\"invalid evidence_mode {evidence_mode!r}; expected one of {', '.join(_EVIDENCE_MODES)}\"\n         )\n     sidecar = {\n         \"schema_version\": 1,\n         \"run_id\": run_id,\n         \"evidence_mode\": evidence_mode,\n         \"scenario\": None,\n         \"policy_version\": None,\n         \"unknown_time_fields\": [],\n         \"limitations\": [],\n         \"authoritative_action\": None,\n         \"authoritative_reason\": None,\n         \"decided_by\": None,\n         \"snapshot_ref\": {\"snapshot_id\": None, \"artifact_key\": None},\n     }\n     path = Path(path)\n     path.write_text(json.dumps(sidecar, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n     return path\n \n \n def _unique_run_id(runs_dir: Path, run_id: str) -> str:\n     \"\"\"A run_id whose directory does not exist yet, so a same-minute retry is safe.\n \n     ``build_run_id`` has minute resolution, so two runs started in the same minute\n     (or a retry) produce the same id. Appending ``-<n>`` keeps the id within the\n     recorder's 64-char pattern and never overwrites an earlier manifest.\n     \"\"\"\n     pattern = re.compile(r\"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,62}$\")\n     candidate = run_id\n     suffix = 2\n     while (runs_dir / candidate).exists():\n         candidate = f\"{run_id}-{suffix}\"\n         if not pattern.match(candidate):\n             raise ValueError(f\"no free run_id derived from {run_id!r} within 64 chars\")\n         suffix += 1\n     return candidate\n \n \n def _make_manifest_writer(config: dict, selections: dict, stats_handler, started_at=None, variant=\"v0\"):\n     \"\"\"Return a ``write(failure=..., outcome=...)`` bound to this run's inputs.\n \n     ``variant`` selects the architecture under test and becomes the first segment\n     of the manifest ``run_id``; ``repeat`` is 1 and ``created_at`` is now, both\n     supplied here so the recorder never reads the clock itself. ``started_at`` is\n     the run's start (``time.time()``); forwarding it lets the manifest record a\n     real duration.\n     \"\"\"\n \n     def write(*, failure, outcome, stop_reason=None):\n         return write_run_manifest(\n             config=config,\n             ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n             trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n             asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n             outcome=outcome,\n             usage=stats_handler.get_stats(),\n             failure=failure,\n             variant=variant,\n             repeat=1,\n             at=datetime.now(UTC),\n             version=__version__,\n             started_at=started_at,\n             stop_reason=stop_reason,\n-            evidence_mode=config.get(\"evidence_mode\", \"report_reference\"),\n+            evidence_mode=config.get(\"evidence_mode\", \"strict\"),\n         )\n \n     return write\n \n \n def _finalize_run_manifest(\n     *,\n     write,\n     graph,\n     ticker: str,\n     trade_date: str,\n     asset_type: str,\n     portfolio,\n     final_state,\n     failure: BaseException | None,\n ) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Write the manifest, then dispose of (or keep) the checkpoint.\n \n     The manifest is written **before** the checkpoint is cleared, so a crash in\n     teardown never loses the record. A failed run still writes a manifest with\n     ``failure`` set and keeps its checkpoint for resume; the failure is re-raised.\n     ``stop_reason`` is read from ``final_state`` (C's field) with a ``None``\n     fallback when the run did not reach a terminal state.\n     \"\"\"\n     outcome = None if final_state is None else run_rating(final_state)\n     stop_reason = (final_state or {}).get(\"stop_reason\") if failure is None else None\n     write(failure=None if failure is None else str(failure), outcome=outcome, stop_reason=stop_reason)\n \n     if failure is not None:\n         raise failure\n \n     if final_state is not None:\n         graph.record_decision(ticker, trade_date, final_state)\n     graph.clear_checkpoint_on_success(ticker, trade_date, asset_type, portfolio)\n \n \n def _announce_checkpoint_state(graph, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Say whether this run resumed a saved one, where the user can see it.\n \n     The graph logs this, but nothing in the CLI configures logging and the live\n     view owns the screen, so a resume was invisible.\n     \"\"\"\n     if getattr(graph, \"_resuming\", False):\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Resuming the saved run for {ticker} on {trade_date}\"\n         )\n     else:\n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Starting fresh for {ticker} on {trade_date}\")\n \n \n def _build_run_config(selections: dict, checkpoint: bool | None) -> dict:\n     \"\"\"Assemble the run config from interactive selections, honoring env precedence.\n \n     Round counts and checkpoint follow \"explicit env/flag wins\": an env-applied\n     value on DEFAULT_CONFIG is preserved unless the user overrode it on the CLI.\n     \"\"\"\n     config = DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy()\n     # Research depth sets both round counts, but an explicit env override\n     # (TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS / _MAX_RISK_ROUNDS) wins over the\n     # interactive selection — leave the env-applied value in place (#977).\n     rounds = ((\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS\", \"max_debate_rounds\"),\n               (\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_RISK_ROUNDS\", \"max_risk_discuss_rounds\"))\n     depth_was_asked = not depth_from_env()\n     for env_var, key in rounds:\n         if not os.environ.get(env_var):\n             config[key] = selections[\"research_depth\"]\n         elif depth_was_asked:\n             # The depth question appeared (it is skipped only when both are\n             # set), so say which half of the answer the environment overrode.\n             console.print(\n                 f\"[green]✓ {key} from environment:[/green] {config[key]} \"\n                 f\"(set by {env_var}, so the research depth you chose does not apply to it)\"\n             )\n     config[\"quick_think_llm\"] = selections[\"quick_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"deep_think_llm\"] = selections[\"deep_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"backend_url\"] = selections[\"backend_url\"]\n     config[\"llm_provider\"] = selections[\"llm_provider\"].lower()\n     # Provider-specific thinking configuration. Only the main provider's is\n     # asked; a tier on another provider keeps its configured value (#1440).\n     for key in (\"google_thinking_level\", \"openai_reasoning_effort\", \"anthropic_effort\"):\n         if selections.get(key) is not None:\n             config[key] = selections[key]\n     config[\"output_language\"] = selections.get(\"output_language\", \"English\")\n     # --checkpoint/--no-checkpoint overrides only when explicitly given; omitting\n     # the flag preserves TRADINGAGENTS_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED / the default (#976).\n     if checkpoint is not None:\n         config[\"checkpoint_enabled\"] = checkpoint\n     return config\n \n \n def _reject_unavailable_variant(variant: str, config: dict | None = None) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Refuse v1/v2 until C's ``workflow_variant`` key is wired into the graph.\n \n     v0 is always allowed. A non-v0 variant is allowed only when ``config`` actually\n     carries ``workflow_variant`` (C's enable switch); otherwise this raises\n     ``typer.Exit`` before any model call, so a v0-compatible run is never labelled\n     v1/v2.\n     \"\"\"\n     if variant == \"v0\":\n         return\n     if (config if config is not None else DEFAULT_CONFIG).get(\"workflow_variant\"):\n         return\n     console.print(\n         f\"[red]Variant {variant!r} is not available yet: the workflow only \"\n         f\"implements v0. Run with --variant v0.[/red]\"\n     )\n     raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n \n \n def run_analysis(checkpoint: bool | None = None, portfolio=None, flags=None, variant=\"v0\"):\n     flags = flags or {}\n     variant = _validate_variant(variant)\n     # v1/v2 are not implemented in the workflow yet (C's `workflow_variant` key is\n     # not wired into the graph). Refuse them before any setup or model call.\n     _reject_unavailable_variant(variant)\n     # With no terminal nothing can answer a prompt: name every question still\n     # open before any model is called, rather than stopping at the first one.\n     if not (sys.stdin and sys.stdin.isatty()):\n         gaps = unattended_gaps(flags)\n         if gaps:\n             console.print(\"[red]No terminal to answer the setup questions. Set:[/red]\")\n             for gap in gaps:\n                 console.print(f\"  {gap}\")\n             raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n \n     selections = get_user_selections(flags)\n \n     config = _build_run_config(selections, checkpoint)\n \n     stats_handler = StatsCallbackHandler()\n \n     # Normalize analyst selection to predefined order (selection is a 'set', order is fixed)\n     selected_set = {analyst.value for analyst in selections[\"analysts\"]}\n     selected_analyst_keys = [a for a in ANALYST_ORDER if a in selected_set]\n     analyst_execution_plan = build_analyst_execution_plan(selected_analyst_keys)\n     analyst_wall_time_tracker = AnalystWallTimeTracker(analyst_execution_plan)\n \n     graph = TradingAgentsGraph(\n         selected_analyst_keys,\n         config=config,\n         debug=True,\n         callbacks=[stats_handler],\n     )\n \n     message_buffer.init_for_analysis(selected_analyst_keys)\n \n     # Track start time for elapsed display\n     start_time = time.time()\n \n     results_dir = _run_directory(config, selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"])\n     results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     report_dir = results_dir / \"reports\"\n     report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     log_file = results_dir / \"message_tool.log\"\n     log_file.touch(exist_ok=True)\n \n     def save_message_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n             func(*args, **kwargs)\n             timestamp, message_type, content = obj.messages[-1]\n             content = content.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")  # Replace newlines with spaces\n             with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                 f.write(f\"{timestamp} [{message_type}] {content}\\n\")\n         return wrapper\n \n     def save_tool_call_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n             func(*args, **kwargs)\n             timestamp, tool_name, args = obj.tool_calls[-1]\n             args_str = \", \".join(f\"{k}={v}\" for k, v in args.items())\n             with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                 f.write(f\"{timestamp} [Tool Call] {tool_name}({args_str})\\n\")\n         return wrapper\n \n     def save_report_section_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(section_name, content):\n             func(section_name, content)\n             if section_name in obj.report_sections and obj.report_sections[section_name] is not None:\n                 content = obj.report_sections[section_name]\n                 if content:\n                     file_name = f\"{section_name}.md\"\n                     text = \"\\n\".join(str(item) for item in content) if isinstance(content, list) else content\n                     with open(report_dir / file_name, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                         f.write(text)\n         return wrapper\n \n     message_buffer.add_message = save_message_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_message\")\n     message_buffer.add_tool_call = save_tool_call_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_tool_call\")\n     message_buffer.update_report_section = save_report_section_decorator(message_buffer, \"update_report_section\")\n \n     layout = create_layout()\n \n     # The alternate screen keeps a layout taller than the window from redrawing\n     # by scrolling; the final report prints after this block, on the normal screen.\n     with Live(layout, refresh_per_second=4, screen=True):\n         # Initial display\n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Selected ticker: {selections['ticker']}\")\n         if selections[\"asset_type\"] != \"stock\":\n             message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Detected asset type: {selections['asset_type']}\")\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Analysis date: {selections['analysis_date']}\"\n         )\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\",\n             f\"Selected analysts: {', '.join(analyst.value for analyst in selections['analysts'])}\",\n         )\n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         # The analysts start together.\n         for spec in analyst_execution_plan.specs:\n             message_buffer.update_agent_status(spec.agent_node, \"in_progress\")\n             analyst_wall_time_tracker.mark_started(spec.key)\n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         spinner_text = (\n             f\"Analyzing {selections['ticker']} on {selections['analysis_date']}...\"\n         )\n         update_display(layout, spinner_text, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n         # The same initial state propagate() builds, with the resolved\n         # instrument identity; the graph's Memory Log step settles past\n         # decisions and loads their lessons alongside the analysts.\n         init_agent_state = graph.create_run_state(\n             selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"], selections[\"asset_type\"], portfolio\n         )\n         # Pass callbacks to graph config for tool execution tracking\n         # (LLM tracking is handled separately via LLM constructor)\n         args = graph.propagator.get_graph_args(callbacks=[stats_handler])\n \n         # Recompile with a checkpointer and inject the thread_id so --checkpoint\n         # actually saves and resumes on the CLI path (#1249); a no-op when\n         # checkpointing is disabled. Torn down in the finally below.\n         checkpoint_tid = graph.begin_checkpoint(\n             selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"], selections[\"asset_type\"], portfolio\n         )\n         if checkpoint_tid is not None:\n             args.setdefault(\"config\", {}).setdefault(\"configurable\", {})[\"thread_id\"] = checkpoint_tid\n             _announce_checkpoint_state(graph, selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"])\n \n         # Stream the analysis. On resume, feed None so LangGraph continues the\n         # interrupted run instead of re-appending the initial state (#1249); the\n         # try/finally tears the checkpointer down even if the stream raises.\n         trace = []\n         try:\n             for messages, chunk in graph.stream_run(graph.checkpoint_input(init_agent_state), **args):\n                 for message in messages:\n                     msg_id = getattr(message, \"id\", None)\n                     if msg_id is not None:\n                         if msg_id in message_buffer._processed_message_ids:\n                             continue\n                         message_buffer._processed_message_ids.add(msg_id)\n \n                     msg_type, content = classify_message_type(message)\n                     if content and content.strip():\n                         message_buffer.add_message(msg_type, content)\n \n                     if hasattr(message, \"tool_calls\") and message.tool_calls:\n                         for tool_call in message.tool_calls:\n                             if isinstance(tool_call, dict):\n                                 message_buffer.add_tool_call(tool_call[\"name\"], tool_call[\"args\"])\n                             else:\n                                 message_buffer.add_tool_call(tool_call.name, tool_call.args)\n \n                 if chunk is None:   # a step inside an analyst's graph: messages only\n                     update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n                     continue\n \n                 update_analyst_statuses(\n                     message_buffer,\n                     chunk,\n                     wall_time_tracker=analyst_wall_time_tracker,\n                 )\n \n                 # Research Team - Handle Investment Debate State\n                 if chunk.get(\"investment_debate_state\"):\n                     debate_state = chunk[\"investment_debate_state\"]\n                     bull_hist = debate_state.get(\"bull_history\", \"\").strip()\n                     bear_hist = debate_state.get(\"bear_history\", \"\").strip()\n                     judge = (chunk.get(\"investment_plan\") or \"\").strip()\n \n                     # Only update status when there's actual content\n                     if bull_hist or bear_hist:\n                         update_research_team_status(\"in_progress\")\n                     if bull_hist:\n                         message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"investment_plan\", f\"### Bull Researcher Analysis\\n{bull_hist}\"\n                         )\n                     if bear_hist:\n                         message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"investment_plan\", f\"### Bear Researcher Analysis\\n{bear_hist}\"\n                         )\n                     if judge:\n                         message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"investment_plan\", f\"### Research Manager Decision\\n{judge}\"\n                         )\n                         update_research_team_status(\"completed\")\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Trader\", \"in_progress\")\n \n                 # Trading Team\n                 if chunk.get(\"trader_investment_plan\"):\n                     message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                         \"trader_investment_plan\", chunk[\"trader_investment_plan\"]\n                     )\n                     if message_buffer.agent_status.get(\"Trader\") != \"completed\":\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Trader\", \"completed\")\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Aggressive Analyst\", \"in_progress\")\n \n                 # Risk Management Team - Handle Risk Debate State\n                 if chunk.get(\"risk_debate_state\"):\n                     risk_state = chunk[\"risk_debate_state\"]\n                     agg_hist = risk_state.get(\"aggressive_history\", \"\").strip()\n                     con_hist = risk_state.get(\"conservative_history\", \"\").strip()\n                     neu_hist = risk_state.get(\"neutral_history\", \"\").strip()\n                     judge = (chunk.get(\"final_trade_decision\") or \"\").strip()\n \n                     if agg_hist:\n                         if message_buffer.agent_status.get(\"Aggressive Analyst\") != \"completed\":\n                             message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Aggressive Analyst\", \"in_progress\")\n                         message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"final_trade_decision\", f\"### Aggressive Analyst Analysis\\n{agg_hist}\"\n                         )\n                     if con_hist:\n                         if message_buffer.agent_status.get(\"Conservative Analyst\") != \"completed\":\n                             message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Conservative Analyst\", \"in_progress\")\n                         message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"final_trade_decision\", f\"### Conservative Analyst Analysis\\n{con_hist}\"\n                         )\n                     if neu_hist:\n                         if message_buffer.agent_status.get(\"Neutral Analyst\") != \"completed\":\n                             message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Neutral Analyst\", \"in_progress\")\n                         message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"final_trade_decision\", f\"### Neutral Analyst Analysis\\n{neu_hist}\"\n                         )\n                     if judge and message_buffer.agent_status.get(\"Portfolio Manager\") != \"completed\":\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Portfolio Manager\", \"in_progress\")\n                         message_buffer.update_report_section(\n                             \"final_trade_decision\", f\"### Portfolio Manager Decision\\n{judge}\"\n                         )\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Aggressive Analyst\", \"completed\")\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Conservative Analyst\", \"completed\")\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Neutral Analyst\", \"completed\")\n                         message_buffer.update_agent_status(\"Portfolio Manager\", \"completed\")\n \n                 update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n                 trace.append(chunk)\n \n             # Streamed chunks are per-node deltas, not full state. Merge them\n             # so every report field populated across the run is present.\n             final_state = {}\n             for chunk in trace:\n                 final_state.update(chunk)\n \n             # Clean run: write the manifest, log the decision, then drop this run's\n             # checkpoint so a later run starts fresh. The manifest is written first,\n             # inside _finalize_run_manifest, so teardown can never lose the record.\n             manifest_write = _make_manifest_writer(config, selections, stats_handler, started_at=start_time, variant=variant)\n             _finalize_run_manifest(\n                 write=manifest_write,\n                 graph=graph,\n                 ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n                 trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n                 asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n                 portfolio=portfolio,\n                 final_state=final_state,\n                 failure=None,\n             )\n         except BaseException as failure:\n             # A failure mid-run still leaves a manifest; the checkpoint is kept for\n             # resume and the failure is re-raised after the finally below.\n             manifest_write = _make_manifest_writer(config, selections, stats_handler, started_at=start_time, variant=variant)\n             _finalize_run_manifest(\n                 write=manifest_write,\n                 graph=graph,\n                 ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n                 trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n                 asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n                 portfolio=portfolio,\n                 final_state=None,\n                 failure=failure,\n             )\n         finally:\n             # Always restore the plain uncheckpointed graph, even on failure.\n             graph.end_checkpoint()\n \n         for agent in message_buffer.agent_status:\n             message_buffer.update_agent_status(agent, \"completed\")\n \n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Completed analysis for {selections['analysis_date']}\"\n         )\n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", analyst_wall_time_tracker.format_summary())\n \n         for section in message_buffer.report_sections:\n             if section in final_state:\n                 message_buffer.update_report_section(section, final_state[section])\n \n         update_display(layout, stats_handler=stats_handler, start_time=start_time)\n \n     # Post-analysis prompts (outside Live context for clean interaction)\n     console.print(\"\\n[bold cyan]Analysis Complete![/bold cyan]\\n\")\n \n     # A decision nobody can read is not a position. Say so here rather than\n     # leaving the run to look like a normal result.\n     if is_review(run_rating(final_state)):\n         console.print(\n             \"[yellow]No rating could be read from the final decision, so this run \"\n             \"is recorded for review rather than as a position. Re-run, or read the \"\n             \"decision text below and judge it yourself.[/yellow]\\n\"\n         )\n     console.print(f\"[dim]{analyst_wall_time_tracker.format_summary()}[/dim]\")\n \n     _offer_reports(final_state, graph, selections[\"ticker\"],\n                    save=flags.get(\"save\"), show=flags.get(\"show\"), html=flags.get(\"html\"))\n \n \n def _yes(question: str) -> bool:\n     return typer.prompt(question, default=\"Y\").strip().upper() in (\"Y\", \"YES\", \"\")\n \n \n def _graphical_browser():\n     \"\"\"A browser that opens a page in its own window on this machine, or None.\n \n     Over SSH the page sits on the remote machine, and a terminal browser (lynx,\n     w3m, elinks) would take over the terminal, so neither is offered.\n     \"\"\"\n     if os.environ.get(\"SSH_CONNECTION\") or os.environ.get(\"SSH_TTY\"):\n         return None\n     try:\n         browser = webbrowser.get()\n     except webbrowser.Error:\n         return None\n     if type(browser) is webbrowser.GenericBrowser or isinstance(browser, webbrowser.Elinks):\n         return None\n     return browser\n \n \n def _open_page(page: Path) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Offer to open the saved page in a browser window, and say where it is if opening fails.\"\"\"\n     browser = _graphical_browser()\n     if browser is None or not _yes(\"Open it in your browser?\"):\n         return\n     try:\n         opened = browser.open(page.as_uri())\n     except (webbrowser.Error, OSError):\n         opened = False\n     if not opened:\n         console.print(f\"  [dim]Could not open a browser; the page is at:[/dim] {page}\")\n \n \n def _offer_reports(final_state, graph, ticker, save=None, show=None, html=None):\n     \"\"\"Save the report tree and show it; ``save``/``show``/``html`` answer the questions when given.\n \n     A saved report includes the HTML page unless ``html`` is False. Someone\n     answering the save question at the prompt is also asked about the page and\n     offered to open it; a run whose flags answer the save question asks neither.\n     \"\"\"\n     asked = save is None\n     if asked:\n         save = typer.prompt(\"Save report?\", default=\"Y\").strip().upper() in (\"Y\", \"YES\", \"\")\n     if save:\n         # Under results_dir, not the working directory: in Docker the working\n         # directory is inside the container and the report goes with it, while\n         # results_dir is the mounted volume the rest of the run already writes to.\n         save_path = graph.default_report_path(ticker)\n         if asked:   # someone at the prompt may pick another folder\n             save_path = Path(typer.prompt(\n                 \"Save path (press Enter for default)\", default=str(save_path)\n             ).strip())\n         if html is None:\n             html = _yes(\"Also save it as an HTML page?\") if asked else True\n         saved = False\n         try:\n             report_file = graph.save_reports(final_state, ticker, save_path, html=html)\n             saved = True\n             console.print(f\"\\n[green]✓ Report saved to:[/green] {save_path.resolve()}\")\n             console.print(f\"  [dim]Complete report:[/dim] {report_file.name}\")\n         except Exception as e:\n             console.print(f\"[red]Error saving report: {e}[/red]\")\n         if saved and html:\n             page = (save_path / \"complete_report.html\").resolve()\n             console.print(f\"  [dim]HTML report:[/dim] {page.name}\")\n             if asked:\n                 _open_page(page)\n \n     if show is None:\n         show = typer.prompt(\"\\nDisplay full report on screen?\", default=\"Y\").strip().upper() in (\"Y\", \"YES\", \"\")\n     if show:\n         display_complete_report(final_state)\n",

              "patch": "Index: src/tradingagents/resume.py\n===================================================================\n--- src/tradingagents/resume.py\t\n+++ src/tradingagents/resume.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,307 @@\n+\"\"\"Run resume / attempts / checkpoint locator (E3).\n+\n+Contract: ``docs/handoffs/E-interfaces-v1.md`` §E3. The pieces here are E-owned and\n+depend on no other member for their format; a real end-to-end resume needs C's\n+``checkpoint_thread_id(..., run_key=run_id)`` and state binding, so ``thread_id`` is\n+injected by the caller rather than computed here.\n+\n+Layout under ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/``:\n+\n+- ``attempts.jsonl`` — one JSON line per attempt (recoverable failures live only here;\n+  the manifest slot stays free).\n+- ``checkpoint.json`` — the locator: run identity, checkpoint location, and the\n+  evidence snapshot pointer.\n+- ``manifest.json`` — written once on terminal success (by ``run_recorder``); its\n+  presence is what makes a later ``resolve_run`` return ``already_recorded``.\n+\n+Three-step semantics: a first failure appends an attempt (no manifest) → resuming the\n+same ``run_id`` succeeds, writes the one manifest, and clears the checkpoint → a\n+further request returns ``already_recorded``.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import json\n+import os\n+from collections.abc import Callable\n+from dataclasses import dataclass\n+from pathlib import Path\n+from typing import Any\n+\n+SCHEMA_VERSION = 1\n+\n+# Typed resume failure codes (docs/handoffs/E-interfaces-v1.md §E3).\n+RESUME_ERROR_CODES = (\n+    \"locator_missing\",\n+    \"locator_invalid\",\n+    \"checkpoint_not_found\",\n+    \"checkpoint_unreadable\",\n+    \"checkpoint_corrupt\",\n+    \"checkpoint_signature_mismatch\",\n+    \"snapshot_missing\",\n+    \"snapshot_unreadable\",\n+    \"snapshot_corrupt\",\n+    \"snapshot_id_mismatch\",\n+    \"already_recorded\",\n+)\n+\n+\n+class ResumeError(Exception):\n+    \"\"\"A resume could not proceed; ``code`` names the typed reason.\"\"\"\n+\n+    def __init__(self, code: str, detail: str | None = None) -> None:\n+        if code not in RESUME_ERROR_CODES:\n+            raise ValueError(f\"unknown resume error code {code!r}\")\n+        self.code = code\n+        self.detail = detail\n+        super().__init__(f\"{code}: {detail}\" if detail else code)\n+\n+\n+@dataclass(frozen=True)\n+class ResumeRef:\n+    \"\"\"What a resumed run needs: where its checkpoint and evidence snapshot are.\"\"\"\n+\n+    db: str\n+    thread_id: str\n+    step: int | None\n+    snapshot_id: str | None\n+    artifact_key: str | None\n+    source_run_id: str | None\n+    captured_at: str | None\n+\n+\n+def run_dir(config: dict, run_id: str) -> Path:\n+    return Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\" / run_id\n+\n+\n+def attempts_path(config: dict, run_id: str) -> Path:\n+    return run_dir(config, run_id) / \"attempts.jsonl\"\n+\n+\n+def checkpoint_path(config: dict, run_id: str) -> Path:\n+    return run_dir(config, run_id) / \"checkpoint.json\"\n+\n+\n+def manifest_path(config: dict, run_id: str) -> Path:\n+    return run_dir(config, run_id) / \"manifest.json\"\n+\n+\n+# --- attempts ----------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def append_attempt(\n+    config: dict,\n+    run_id: str,\n+    *,\n+    at: str,\n+    stage: str,\n+    status: str,\n+    reason_code: str,\n+    detail: str | None = None,\n+) -> Path:\n+    \"\"\"Append one attempt line; the manifest slot is not touched.\"\"\"\n+    path = attempts_path(config, run_id)\n+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    record = {\n+        \"schema_version\": SCHEMA_VERSION,\n+        \"run_id\": run_id,\n+        \"at\": at,\n+        \"stage\": stage,\n+        \"status\": status,\n+        \"reason_code\": reason_code,\n+        \"detail\": detail,\n+    }\n+    with open(path, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as handle:\n+        handle.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n+    return path\n+\n+\n+def read_attempts(config: dict, run_id: str) -> list[dict]:\n+    path = attempts_path(config, run_id)\n+    if not path.exists():\n+        return []\n+    lines = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines()\n+    return [json.loads(line) for line in lines if line.strip()]\n+\n+\n+# --- checkpoint --------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def write_checkpoint(\n+    config: dict,\n+    run_id: str,\n+    *,\n+    ticker: str,\n+    trade_date: str,\n+    asset_type: str,\n+    created_at: str,\n+    status: str,\n+    checkpoint: dict,\n+    evidence_snapshot: dict,\n+) -> Path:\n+    \"\"\"Write ``checkpoint.json`` atomically (temp file + ``os.replace``).\"\"\"\n+    path = checkpoint_path(config, run_id)\n+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    locator = {\n+        \"schema_version\": SCHEMA_VERSION,\n+        \"run_id\": run_id,\n+        \"ticker\": ticker,\n+        \"trade_date\": trade_date,\n+        \"asset_type\": asset_type,\n+        \"created_at\": created_at,\n+        \"status\": status,\n+        \"checkpoint\": {\n+            \"backend\": checkpoint.get(\"backend\"),\n+            \"db_relpath\": checkpoint.get(\"db_relpath\"),\n+            \"thread_id\": checkpoint.get(\"thread_id\"),\n+            \"step\": checkpoint.get(\"step\"),\n+        },\n+        \"evidence_snapshot\": {\n+            \"snapshot_id\": evidence_snapshot.get(\"snapshot_id\"),\n+            \"artifact_key\": evidence_snapshot.get(\"artifact_key\"),\n+            \"store\": evidence_snapshot.get(\"store\"),\n+            \"source_run_id\": evidence_snapshot.get(\"source_run_id\"),\n+            \"captured_at\": evidence_snapshot.get(\"captured_at\"),\n+        },\n+    }\n+    tmp = path.with_suffix(\".json.tmp\")\n+    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(locator, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    os.replace(tmp, path)\n+    return path\n+\n+\n+def _read_checkpoint_file(path: Path) -> dict:\n+    if not path.exists():\n+        raise ResumeError(\"locator_missing\")\n+    try:\n+        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n+    except OSError as exc:\n+        raise ResumeError(\"checkpoint_unreadable\", str(exc)) from exc\n+    except ValueError as exc:\n+        raise ResumeError(\"checkpoint_corrupt\", str(exc)) from exc\n+    if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get(\"schema_version\") != SCHEMA_VERSION:\n+        raise ResumeError(\"locator_invalid\")\n+    for key in (\"run_id\", \"ticker\", \"trade_date\", \"asset_type\", \"checkpoint\", \"evidence_snapshot\"):\n+        if key not in data:\n+            raise ResumeError(\"locator_invalid\", f\"missing {key!r}\")\n+    return data\n+\n+\n+def resolve_run(\n+    run_id: str,\n+    config: dict,\n+    *,\n+    expected_ticker: str | None = None,\n+    expected_trade_date: str | None = None,\n+    expected_asset_type: str | None = None,\n+    expected_snapshot_id: str | None = None,\n+    backend_root: str | Path | None = None,\n+    verify_snapshot: bool = False,\n+) -> ResumeRef:\n+    \"\"\"Resolve a run's checkpoint and evidence snapshot, or raise ``ResumeError``.\n+\n+    ``already_recorded`` is checked first: a terminal manifest for this ``run_id``\n+    means the run already completed and must not run again. Identity fields inside\n+    the locator must match the run_id and any caller-supplied expectations, else\n+    ``checkpoint_signature_mismatch``. ``thread_id`` is injected in the locator, not\n+    computed here. The snapshot artifact is verified only when ``verify_snapshot`` is\n+    set (a caller about to resume wants proof the snapshot is still readable).\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if manifest_path(config, run_id).exists():\n+        raise ResumeError(\"already_recorded\")\n+\n+    data = _read_checkpoint_file(checkpoint_path(config, run_id))\n+\n+    if data.get(\"run_id\") != run_id:\n+        raise ResumeError(\"checkpoint_signature_mismatch\", \"run_id\")\n+\n+    # Identity expectations default to the config's resolved instrument, so a\n+    # locator for a different ticker/date/asset is rejected out of the box.\n+    checks = (\n+        (\"ticker\", expected_ticker if expected_ticker is not None else config.get(\"ticker\")),\n+        (\n+            \"trade_date\",\n+            expected_trade_date if expected_trade_date is not None else config.get(\"trade_date\"),\n+        ),\n+        (\n+            \"asset_type\",\n+            expected_asset_type if expected_asset_type is not None else config.get(\"asset_type\"),\n+        ),\n+    )\n+    for field, expected in checks:\n+        if expected is not None and data.get(field) != expected:\n+            raise ResumeError(\"checkpoint_signature_mismatch\", field)\n+\n+    checkpoint = data.get(\"checkpoint\") or {}\n+    snapshot = data.get(\"evidence_snapshot\") or {}\n+    thread_id = checkpoint.get(\"thread_id\")\n+    if not thread_id:\n+        raise ResumeError(\"locator_invalid\", \"checkpoint.thread_id\")\n+\n+    snapshot_id = snapshot.get(\"snapshot_id\")\n+    if expected_snapshot_id is not None and snapshot_id != expected_snapshot_id:\n+        raise ResumeError(\"snapshot_id_mismatch\", snapshot_id)\n+\n+    artifact_key = snapshot.get(\"artifact_key\")\n+    store = snapshot.get(\"store\")\n+    if verify_snapshot and snapshot_id is not None and artifact_key is not None:\n+        _verify_snapshot_artifact(config, store, artifact_key, backend_root)\n+\n+    db = _resolve_db_path(config, data, checkpoint)\n+\n+    return ResumeRef(\n+        db=str(db),\n+        thread_id=str(thread_id),\n+        step=checkpoint.get(\"step\"),\n+        snapshot_id=snapshot_id,\n+        artifact_key=artifact_key,\n+        source_run_id=snapshot.get(\"source_run_id\"),\n+        captured_at=snapshot.get(\"captured_at\"),\n+    )\n+\n+\n+def _resolve_db_path(config: dict, data: dict, checkpoint: dict) -> Path:\n+    db_relpath = checkpoint.get(\"db_relpath\")\n+    if not db_relpath:\n+        # Default to the run directory; the caller may still inject the real path.\n+        return run_dir(config, data.get(\"run_id\")) / \"checkpoints.db\"\n+    db_path = Path(db_relpath)\n+    if db_path.is_absolute():\n+        return db_path\n+    return run_dir(config, data.get(\"run_id\")) / db_path\n+\n+\n+def _verify_snapshot_artifact(\n+    config: dict, store: str | None, artifact_key: str, backend_root: str | Path | None\n+) -> None:\n+    root = Path(backend_root) if backend_root is not None else Path(config[\"results_dir\"])\n+    base = root / store if store else root\n+    artifact = base / artifact_key\n+    if not artifact.exists():\n+        raise ResumeError(\"snapshot_missing\", str(artifact))\n+    try:\n+        json.loads(artifact.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n+    except OSError as exc:\n+        raise ResumeError(\"snapshot_unreadable\", str(exc)) from exc\n+    except ValueError as exc:\n+        raise ResumeError(\"snapshot_corrupt\", str(exc)) from exc\n+\n+\n+# --- three-step success path -------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def write_manifest_then_clear(\n+    config: dict, run_id: str, *, write_manifest: Callable[[], Any]\n+) -> Path:\n+    \"\"\"Write the one manifest, then clear the checkpoint; keep it if the write fails.\n+\n+    ``write_manifest`` is injected so the manifest shape stays owned by\n+    ``run_recorder``. If it raises, the checkpoint is left in place for a retry and\n+    the error propagates; only after a successful write is the checkpoint removed.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    run_dir(config, run_id).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    result = write_manifest()\n+    cp = checkpoint_path(config, run_id)\n+    if cp.exists():\n+        cp.unlink()\n+    return result\n",

A\n+  recoverable failure writes only here; the manifest slot stays free.\n+- ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/checkpoint.json`` — the locator:\n+  ``{schema_version, run_id, ticker, trade_date, config) -> ResumeRef`` with typed ``ResumeError.code``.\n+\n+Three-step semantics: first failure appends an attempt (manifest unclaimed) → resuming\n+the same id succeeds, writes the one manifest, and clears the checkpoint → a further\n+request returns ``already_recorded`` (identity+terminal match only).\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import json\n+from pathlib import write_checkpoint,\n+    write_manifest_then_clear,\n+)\n+\n+RUN_ID = \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261122t1200\"\n+AT = \"2026-11-22T12:00:00+00:00\"\n+\n+\n+def _config(tmp_path) -> dict:\n+    return {\n+        \"results_dir\": str(tmp_path),\n+        \"ticker\": \"NVDA\",\n+        \"trade_date\": \"2026-11-20\",\n+        \"asset_type\": \"stock\",\n+    }\n+\n+\n+def _checkpoint_kwargs(**overrides):\n+    kwargs = {\n+        \"backend\": \"sqlite\",\n+        \"db_relpath\": \"checkpoints.db\",\n+        \"thread_id\": \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261122t1200\",\n+        \"step\": 7,\n+    }\n+    kwargs.update(overrides)\n+    return kwargs\n+\n+\n+def _snapshot_kwargs(**overrides):\n+    kwargs = {\n+        \"snapshot_id\": \"snap-abc\",\n+        \"artifact_key\": \"v1/deadbeef.json\",\n+        \"store\": \"evidence\",\n+        \"source_run_id\": RUN_ID,\n+        \"captured_at\": AT,\n+    }\n+    kwargs.update(overrides)\n+    return kwargs\n+\n+\n+def _write_checkpoint(tmp_path, *, run_id=RUN_ID, ticker=\"NVDA\", trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n+                      asset_type=\"stock\", checkpoint=None, snapshot=None):\n+    return write_checkpoint(\n+        _config(tmp_path),\n+        run_id,\n+        ticker=ticker,\n+        trade_date=trade_date,\n+        asset_type=asset_type,\n+        created_at=AT,\n+        status=\"incomplete\",\n+        checkpoint=checkpoint if checkpoint is not None else _checkpoint_kwargs(),\n+        evidence_snapshot=snapshot if snapshot is not None else _snapshot_kwargs(),\n+    )\n+\n+\n+# --- attempts.jsonl ----------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def test_first_failure_appends_attempt_and_manifest_slot_free(tmp_path):\n+    append_attempt(\n+        _config(tmp_path),\n+        RUN_ID,\n+        at=AT,\n+        stage=\"graph\",\n+        status=\"failed\",\n+        reason_code=\"checkpoint_unreadable\",\n+        detail=\"boom\",\n+    )\n+    attempts_file = Path(tmp_path) / \"runs\" / RUN_ID / \"attempts.jsonl\"\n+    assert attempts_file.exists()\n+    line = json.loads(attempts_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines()[0])\n+    assert line == {\n+        \"schema_version\": 1,\n+        \"run_id\": RUN_ID,\n+        \"at\": AT,\n+        \"stage\": \"graph\",\n+        \"status\": \"failed\",\n+        \"reason_code\": \"checkpoint_unreadable\",\n+        \"detail\": \"boom\",\n+    }\n+    assert not (Path(tmp_path) / \"runs\" / RUN_ID / \"manifest.json\").exists()\n+\n+\n+def test_attempts_append_is_additive(tmp_path):\n+    for stage in (\"first\", \"second\"):\n+        append_attempt(\n+            _config(tmp_path), RUN_ID, at=AT, stage=stage, status=\"failed\", reason_code=\"x\"\n+        )\n+    lines = read_attempts(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID)\n+    assert [line[\"stage\"] for line in lines] == [\"first\", \"second\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_detail_defaults_to_none(tmp_path):\n+    append_attempt(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID, at=AT, stage=\"s\", status=\"failed\", reason_code=\"r\")\n+    assert read_attempts(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID)[0][\"detail\"] is None\n+\n+\n+# --- checkpoint.json read/write ---------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def test_write_checkpoint_roundtrip(tmp_path):\n+    path = _write_checkpoint(tmp_path)\n+    assert path == checkpoint_path(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID)\n+    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n+    assert data[\"schema_version\"] == 1\n+    assert data[\"run_id\"] == RUN_ID\n+    assert data[\"checkpoint\"][\"thread_id\"] == RUN_ID\n+    assert data[\"evidence_snapshot\"][\"snapshot_id\"] == \"snap-abc\"\n+\n+\n+# --- resolve_run -------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def test_resolve_run_returns_resumeref(tmp_path):\n+    _write_checkpoint(tmp_path)\n+    ref = resolve_run(RUN_ID, \"v1/deadbeef.json\"\n+    assert ref.source_run_id == RUN_ID\n+\n+\n+def test_resolve_run_locator_missing(tmp_path):\n+    with pytest.raises(ResumeError) as exc:\n+        resolve_run(RUN_ID, _config(tmp_path))\n+    assert exc.value.code == \"locator_missing\"\n+\n+\n+def test_snapshot_published_but_locator_missing(tmp_path):\n+    # The snapshot artifact exists on disk, but checkpoint.json (the locator) does not.\n+    snap = Path(tmp_path) / \"evidence\" / \"v1\" / \"deadbeef.json\"\n+    snap.parent.mkdir(parents=True)\n+    snap.write_text(\"{}\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    with pytest.raises(ResumeError) as exc:\n+        resolve_run(RUN_ID, _config(tmp_path))\n+    assert exc.value.code == \"locator_missing\"\n+    assert snap.exists()\n+\n+\n+def test_resolve_run_signature_mismatch(tmp_path):\n+    _write_checkpoint(tmp_path, ticker=\"AMD\")\n+    with pytest.raises(ResumeError) as exc:\n+        resolve_run(RUN_ID, _config(tmp_path))  # config expects NVDA\n+    assert exc.value.code == \"checkpoint_signature_mismatch\"\n+\n+\n+def test_resolve_run_corrupt_checkpoint(tmp_path):\n+    path = checkpoint_path(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID)\n+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)\n+    path.write_text(\"{not json\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    with pytest.raises(ResumeError) as exc:\n+        resolve_run(RUN_ID, _config(tmp_path))\n+    assert exc.value.code == \"checkpoint_corrupt\"\n+\n+\n+def test_resolve_run_snapshot_id_mismatch(tmp_path):\n+    _write_checkpoint(tmp_path, snapshot=_snapshot_kwargs(snapshot_id=\"different\"))\n+    # A caller that pins the expected snapshot id must get a mismatch code.\n+    with pytest.raises(ResumeError) as exc:\n+        resolve_run(RUN_ID, _config(tmp_path), expected_snapshot_id=\"snap-abc\")\n+    assert exc.value.code == \"snapshot_id_mismatch\"\n+\n+\n+def test_resolve_run_already_recorded(tmp_path):\n+    _write_checkpoint(tmp_path)\n+    # A completed manifest for this run already exists.\n+    manifest = checkpoint_path(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID).parent / \"manifest.json\"\n+    manifest.write_text(json.dumps({\"schema_version\": 1, \"run_id\": RUN_ID}), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    with pytest.raises(ResumeError) as exc:\n+        resolve_run(RUN_ID, _config(tmp_path))\n+    assert exc.value.code == \"already_recorded\"\n+\n+\n+# --- three-step: resume success clears checkpoint ----------------------------\n+\n+\n+def test_resume_success_writes_manifest_and_clears_checkpoint(tmp_path):\n+    config = _config(tmp_path)\n+\n+    def write_manifest():\n+        (checkpoint_path(config, RUN_ID).parent / test_manifest_write_failure_keeps_checkpoint(tmp_path):\n+    config = _config(tmp_path)\n+    _write_checkpoint(tmp_path)\n+\n+    def failing_write():\n+        raise OSError(\"disk full\")\n+\n+    with pytest.raises(OSError):\n+        write_manifest_then_clear(config, RUN_ID, write_manifest=failing_write)\n+    # Checkpoint kept so a retry can resume; manifest never appeared.\n+    assert               "content": "\"\"\"Offline tests for E3: attempts.jsonl, checkpoint.json, resolve_run (E3).\n\nContract (docs/handoffs/E-interfaces-v1.md §E3):\n\n- ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/attempts.jsonl`` — one JSON line per attempt,\n  ``{schema_version, run_id, at, stage, status, reason_code, detail}``. A\n  recoverable failure writes only here; the manifest slot stays free.\n- ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/checkpoint.json`` — the locator:\n  ``{schema_version, run_id, ticker, trade_date, asset_type, created_at, status,\n  checkpoint:{backend,db_relpath,thread_id,step},\n  evidence_snapshot:{snapshot_id,artifact_key,store,source_run_id,captured_at}}``.\n- ``resolve_run(run_id, config) -> ResumeRef`` with typed ``ResumeError.code``.\n\nThree-step semantics: first failure appends an attempt (manifest unclaimed) → resuming\nthe same id succeeds, writes the one manifest, and clears the checkpoint → a further\nrequest returns ``already_recorded`` (identity+terminal match only).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom tradingagents.resume import (\n    ResumeError,\n    ResumeRef,\n    append_attempt,\n    checkpoint_path,\n    read_attempts,\n    resolve_run,\n    write_checkpoint,\n    write_manifest_then_clear,\n)\n\nRUN_ID = \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261122t1200\"\nAT = \"2026-11-22T12:00:00+00:00\"\n\n\ndef _config(tmp_path) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"results_dir\": str(tmp_path),\n        \"ticker\": \"NVDA\",\n        \"trade_date\": \"2026-11-20\",\n        \"asset_type\": \"stock\",\n    }\n\n\ndef _checkpoint_kwargs(**overrides):\n    kwargs = {\n        \"backend\": \"sqlite\",\n        \"db_relpath\": \"checkpoints.db\",\n        \"thread_id\": \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261122t1200\",\n        \"step\": 7,\n    }\n    kwargs.update(overrides)\n    return kwargs\n\n\ndef _snapshot_kwargs(**overrides):\n    kwargs = {\n        \"snapshot_id\": \"snap-abc\",\n        \"artifact_key\": \"v1/deadbeef.json\",\n        \"store\": \"evidence\",\n        \"source_run_id\": RUN_ID,\n        \"captured_at\": AT,\n    }\n    kwargs.update(overrides)\n    return kwargs\n\n\ndef _write_checkpoint(tmp_path, *, run_id=RUN_ID, ticker=\"NVDA\", trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n                      asset_type=\"stock\", checkpoint=None, snapshot=None):\n    return write_checkpoint(\n        _config(tmp_path),\n        run_id,\n        ticker=ticker,\n        trade_date=trade_date,\n        asset_type=asset_type,\n        created_at=AT,\n        status=\"incomplete\",\n        checkpoint=checkpoint if checkpoint is not None else _checkpoint_kwargs(),\n        evidence_snapshot=snapshot if snapshot is not None else _snapshot_kwargs(),\n    )\n\n\n# --- attempts.jsonl ----------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_first_failure_appends_attempt_and_manifest_slot_free(tmp_path):\n    append_attempt(\n        _config(tmp_path),\n        RUN_ID,\n        at=AT,\n        stage=\"graph\",\n        status=\"failed\",\n        reason_code=\"checkpoint_unreadable\",\n        detail=\"boom\",\n    )\n    attempts_file = Path(tmp_path) / \"runs\" / RUN_ID / \"attempts.jsonl\"\n    assert attempts_file.exists()\n    line = json.loads(attempts_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines()[0])\n    assert line == {\n        \"schema_version\": 1,\n        \"run_id\": RUN_ID,\n        \"at\": AT,\n        \"stage\": \"graph\",\n        \"status\": \"failed\",\n        \"reason_code\": \"checkpoint_unreadable\",\n        \"detail\": \"boom\",\n    }\n    assert not (Path(tmp_path) / \"runs\" / RUN_ID / \"manifest.json\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_attempts_append_is_additive(tmp_path):\n    for stage in (\"first\", \"second\"):\n        append_attempt(\n            _config(tmp_path), RUN_ID, at=AT, stage=stage, status=\"failed\", reason_code=\"x\"\n        )\n    lines = read_attempts(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID)\n    assert [line[\"stage\"] for line in lines] == [\"first\", \"second\"]\n\n\ndef test_detail_defaults_to_none(tmp_path):\n    append_attempt(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID, at=AT, stage=\"s\", status=\"failed\", reason_code=\"r\")\n    assert read_attempts(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID)[0][\"detail\"] is None\n\n\n# --- checkpoint.json read/write ---------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_write_checkpoint_roundtrip(tmp_path):\n    path = _write_checkpoint(tmp_path)\n    assert path == checkpoint_path(_config(tmp_path), RUN_ID\n    assert data[\"evidence_snapshot\"][\"snapshot_id\"] == \"snap-abc\"\n\n\n# --- resolve_run -------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_resolve_run_returns_resumeref(tmp_path):\n    _write_checkpoint(tmp_path)\n    ref = resolve_run(RUN_ID, _config(tmp_path))\n    assert isinstance(ref, ResumeRef)\n    assert ref.thread_id ==
