                "text": "\"\"\"Research Manager: turns the bull/bear debate into a structured investment plan for the trader.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom tradingagents.agents.context import get_instrument_context_from_state, get_language_instruction\nfrom tradingagents.agents.prompt_receipts import legacy_prompt_observer\nfrom tradingagents.agents.schemas import ResearchPlan, render_research_plan\nfrom tradingagents.agents.structured import (\n    NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS,\n    bind_structured,\n    invoke_structured_or_freetext,\n)\n\n\ndef create_research_manager(llm, *, on_prompt=None):\n    template = \"\"\"As the Research Manager and debate facilitator, your role is to critically evaluate this round of debate and deliver a clear, actionable investment plan for the trader.\n\n{instrument_context}\n\n---\n\n**Rating Scale** (use exactly one):\n- **Buy**: Strong conviction in the bull thesis; recommend taking or growing the position\n- **Overweight**: Constructive view; recommend gradually increasing exposure\n- **Hold**: Balanced view; recommend maintaining the current position\n- **Underweight**: Cautious view; recommend trimming exposure\n- **Sell**: Strong conviction in the bear thesis; recommend exiting or avoiding the position\n\nThe debate always contains conflicting arguments; deciding which side is stronger is the job, so conflict alone is not a reason to Hold. Commit to the side with the stronger case, sized by how decisively it wins. Choose Hold only when the evidence is still balanced after that weighing, or too thin to support a call; do not manufacture a direction to appear decisive. Weigh the bull and bear cases on their merits, independent of which side spoke first or last.\n\n---\n\n**Debate History:**\n{history}\n\n## Output\n\nWrite these sections, in this order, starting with the recommendation on its own line:\n\n- **Recommendation**: exactly one of Buy / Overweight / Hold / Underweight / Sell\n- **Rationale**: which arguments decided it\n- **Strategic Actions**: concrete steps for the trader, sized against a standard allocation\n\n\"\"\" + NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS\n    structured_llm = bind_structured(llm, ResearchPlan, \"Research Manager\")\n\n    def research_manager_node(state) -> dict:\n        instrument_context = get_instrument_context_from_state(state)\n        history = state[\"investment_debate_state\"].get(\"history\", \"\")\n\n        investment_debate_state = state[\"investment_debate_state\"]\n\n        prompt = template.format(\n            instrument_context=instrument_context, history=history\n        ) + get_language_instruction()\n\n        investment_plan = invoke_structured_or_freetext(\n            structured_llm,\n            llm,\n            prompt,\n            render_research_plan,\n            \"Research Manager\",\n            before_send=legacy_prompt_observer(on_prompt, \"research_manager\", template, state),\n        )\n\n        new_investment_debate_state = {\n            \"history\": investment_debate_state.get(\"history\", \"\"),\n            \"bear_history\": investment_debate_state.get(\"bear_history\", \"\"),\n            \"bull_history\": investment_debate_state.get(\"bull_history\", \"\"),\n            \"current_response\": investment_plan,\n            \"count\": investment_debate_state[\"count\"],\n        }\n\n        return {\n            \"investment_debate_state\": new_investment_debate_state,\n            \"investment_plan\": investment_plan,\n        }\n\n    return research_manager_node",

            "output": "<path>/Users/erkangxue/CScourse/5351小组作业/TradingAgents-Coursework/docs/architecture/adr/006-workflow-variant-selector.md</path>\n<type>file</type>\n<content>\n1: # 006-workflow-variant-selector.md\n2: \n3: **ADR-006 | Main candidate | English revision for D review | Pending adoption; this document does not authorize source changes**\n4: \n5: Historical review baseline: `main@ab30058506b62fc14d403395b7cbb36122c0d343`. This candidate follows C-v1-workflow-variant-adr-addendum.md (v0.1). D-to-C-integration-governance-replies.md approved the original decision text and assigned ADR-006; the main candidate changed only the delivery target and acceptance boundaries. `ADR-001` in C-v1-fixed-pruning-plan-v0.2.md is a historical draft reference and remains unchanged. At that baseline, the only ADR present was `005-deterministic-guard.md`; this ADR had not been adopted.\n6: \n7: ## Decision\n8: \n9: The fixed-pruning experiment compares two Bull/Bear pairs with one on the same commit, with all other settings held constant. It does not change global defaults. `TradingAgentsGraph` adds the keyword-only parameter `workflow_variant: str | None = None`. The base configuration is still selected with `config or DEFAULT_CONFIG`: a nonempty caller configuration takes precedence; an omitted or empty configuration uses `DEFAULT_CONFIG`. No configuration merge is added.\n10: \n11: | Selector | Effective research debate depth | Configuration and behavior |\n12: | --- | --- | --- |\n13: | Omitted or `None` | Use the configured depth; the built-in default is one pair | Preserve the legacy path, run-settings keys, and checkpoint signature. |\n14: | `workflow_variant=\"v0\"` | Two rounds, one Bull/Bear pair per round | Shallow-copy the base configuration and override only `max_debate_rounds`. |\n15: | `workflow_variant=\"v1\"` | One round, one Bull/Bear pair | Shallow-copy the base configuration and override only `max_debate_rounds`. |\n16: \n17: An explicit preset overrides the configured research depth without modifying the caller's configuration, `DEFAULT_CONFIG`, or `max_risk_discuss_rounds`. Existing routing, the Aggressive → Conservative → Neutral risk sequence, and the Portfolio Manager remain unchanged. Reject `\"v2\"` with `ValueError` because it is not available. Reject other invalid values, including `\"v3\"`, `\"V1\"`, the empty string, and integers, with `ValueError` for an invalid selector. Validate before calling the global `set_config`, creating directories or artifacts, constructing clients, or calling models.\n18: \n19: - `run_settings()` exposes the effective `max_debate_rounds` and `max_risk_discuss_rounds`. Only explicit presets add `workflow_variant`. The existing `full_states_log_<trade_date>.json` stores the same values under `run_settings`. Existing report entry points are unchanged.\n20: - `_run_signature()` uses the effective configuration. Omission or `None` preserves the original signature. Explicit presets append `workflow_variant=v0` or `workflow_variant=v1`, distinguishing an explicit preset from a legacy call even for the same ticker, date, and depth. Explicit signatures are stable for identical effective inputs. SQLite storage and resume behavior are unchanged.\n21: - **Experimental control.** Explicit `v0` is the two-round control for explicit `v1` on the same commit. `baseline-v0` is the frozen Git tag used for regression (pointing to `b5d2f6714e98724506262cca7d38d62f4613d91b`); it is neither this preset nor an alias for omitting the selector.\n22: \n23: This decision covers only the programmatic selector and its offline verification. It does not change the CLI, manifest, Guard, V2 routing, checkpoint storage, or report writers. A CLI label is not evidence of the depth actually executed.\n24: \n25: ## Historical evidence and review-baseline verification\n26: \n27: 1. **Red tests first.** The appendix in C-v1-fixed-pruning-delivery-review.md records an independent run on `f4957b20fadef9809bc314be0be1a8fc0782ad08`: 2 passed and 9 failed. All nine failures were due to the constructor not accepting `workflow_variant`.\n28: 2. **Local prototype and reruns.** The focused suite passed all 11 cases. The offline regression had 1,513 passes, 1 skip (missing `langchain_aws`), 1 deselection, and 100 passing subtests. `git diff --check` passed. Later, the operands of one equality assertion were swapped solely for Ruff; the assertion's behavior was unchanged. Ruff and all 11 focused tests passed on rerun.\n29: 3. **Independent technical review followed the prototype.** In D-to-C-alignment-and-v1-review.md (2026-11-22, Part B), D gave the existing prototype a technical `APPROVE` and delivery `APPROVE WITH EVIDENCE`. D did not run the candidate. This review was not pre-implementation approval for the prototype and does not replace the formal delivery record.\n30: 4. **Integration reproduction.** C-v1-integration-verification.md records 11 focused passes for the original candidate on `integration@0531db16a75f936c836255a5ce44986119334701`. The offline regression had 1,713 passes, 1 skip (missing `langchain_aws`), 1 deselection, 100 passing subtests, and 24 warnings. Ruff passed for the candidate files; the 69 existing repository-wide diagnostics were unchanged. The later receipt review used a different integration baseline and an adapted patch; it was not acceptance on `main`.\n31: 5. **Original main review check.** At the historical main review baseline above, the original source patch from the appendix passed `git apply --check --index --whitespace=error-all`. No `/`, no `..`, ≤ 64 chars. |\n| 3 | `created_at` | `str` (ISO-8601) | required | caller | E | Not `datetime.now()` internally. |\n| 4 | `version` | `str` | required | caller (`tradingagents.__version__`) | E | Package version that produced the run. |\n| 5 | `ticker` | `str` (non-empty) | required | caller | E | `company_of_interest` for the run. |\n| 6 | `trade_date` | `str` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) | required | caller | E | Analysis date. |\n| 7 | `asset_type` | `str` | required | caller | E | e.g. `stock`, `crypto`. |\n| 8 | `outcome` | `str` or `null` | required (may be null) | caller | E | Final rating string, or `null` if the run produced none. |\n| 9 | `config_snapshot` | `object` (str→scalar) | required | caller | E | Run settings minus secret-pattern keys (rule above). |\n| 10 | `prompt_hashes` | `object` (str→str) | required (may be `{}`) | caller | B | Prompt name → hash. Shape/owner: B. Not validated here. |\n| 11 | `evidence_snapshot` | `object` or `null` | required (may be null) | caller | A | Evidence snapshot id/pointer. Shape/owner: A. Not validated here. |\n| 12 | `usage` | `object` | required | caller | E | `{llm_calls:int, tool_calls:int, tokens_in:int, tokens_out:int}`. |\n| 13 | `duration_seconds` | `number` (>= 0) or `null` | required (may be null) | caller | E | Wall time measured by the caller, passed in. |\n| 14 | `failure` | `str` or `null` | required (may be null) | caller | E | Failure summary if the run failed. |\n| 15 | `stop_reason` | `str` or `null` | required (may be null) | caller | **C** | Opaque here. Value domain owned by C's `execution_policy`; **not validated in this slice.** |\n\nAll 15 keys are present on every manifest (nullable ones set to `null`). Required\n`str` fields reject empty strings. Missing required keys, or an unsupported\n`schema_version`, are rejected on write and on read.\n\n## Run identity (`run_id`)\n\nFormat is recommended, not enforced by the recorder; the recorder validates only the\ncharset and the no-overwrite rule.\n\n| Segment | Example | Meaning |\n|---|---|---|\n| `variant` | `v2` | Architecture variant: `v0` original, `v1` trimmed, `v2` adaptive |\n| `ticker` | `nvda` | Lower-case symbol |\n| `trade_date` | `2026-11-20` | Analysis date — **not** the date the run happened |\n| `r<repeat>` | `r1` | 1-based repetition index for identical inputs |\n| `runstamp` | `20261121t1200` | Run time, UTC, `YYYYMMDDtHHMM` |\n\nRules:\n\n- Charset `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,62}$` — lower case only, no `/`, no `..`, ≤ 64 chars.\n  This is what makes the id safe to use as a directory name under the results root.\n- Uniqueness is enforced by the recorder: `write_manifest` raises if the target file\n  already exists and never overwrites.\n- `build_run_id(variant, ticker, trade_date, repeat, at)` is a pure helper that formats\n  the id. `at` is a parameter, so the recorder still never reads the clock.\n\nWhy both the repeat index and the runstamp exist: the repeat index is a *design*\ndimension (repeated runs of identical inputs, e.g. three samples for variance), while\nthe runstamp is the *physical* fact of when the run happened. Two runs of the same\nvariant/ticker/date after a code change differ only by `runstamp`; without it they\nwould collide and one result would be silently lost.\n\n## What this contract deliberately does not define\n\n- No `stop_reason` enum (C owns it — see C §6.5 and `execution_policy.py`, planned).\n- No prompt-hash algorithm (B owns prompt versioning, `prompts/prompt_v1.x.yaml`).\n- No evidence snapshot schema (A owns `evidence.py` and `evidence.md`).\n- No CLI/graph/stats integration (later steps depend on C's `AgentState` and stop enum).\n- No CI gate.           "text": "Analysis complete. Here is the plan.\n\n---\n\n# Execution Plan — Connect `on_prompt` to manifest `prompt_hashes`\n\n## 1. Traceability\n\n- **Requirements/contracts**: `docs/contracts/run-event.md` field 10 (`prompt_hashes` str→str, owner B); `docs/evaluation/protocol.md` (prompt_hashes is a guard, empty refused); E-to-B outreach docs (`E-to-B-prompt_hashes-接入说明.md`, `E-to-B-prompt-receipts-reply.md`).\n- **Invariant**: run comparison gate — three roles `bull`/`bear`/`research_manager` present, non-empty, equal across runs; malformed ⟹ refuse fail-closed.\n- **ADR**: ADR-006 (v0/v1 selector — both variants use the same `setup.py` node factories, so *which roles emit* is identical; only debate depth differs). This change is E-scoped to `cli/run.py`.\n- **Approval gate**: AGENTS.md/Prompt.md require PLAN + TEST + SCOPE approval in `docs/approvals/` before implementation. No approval record exists yet for this task ⟹ this plan is the approval request.\n\n## 2. What I checked: who emits hashes on each path\n\n`on_prompt` is forwarded identically to all three producers via the **shared** `GraphSetup` (`setup.py:134-136`) used by **both** v0 and v1 (the selector only overrides `max_debate_rounds`; ADR-006). So:\n- **v0 path**: `bull_researcher`, `bear_researcher`, `research_manager` each call `legacy_prompt_observer(...)` → emit a receipt per `llm.invoke` (bull/bear per round, manager once, plus manager retries). ✅ all three.\n- **v1 path**: same three producers, fewer rounds. ✅ all three.\n\n**⚠️ Blocking mismatch I must report (do not invent/reuse):** the producer writes the template digest under the key `\"b.\" + role` → `{\"b.bull\": digest}`, **not** the plain `bull`/`bear`/`research_manager` keys the manifest contract requires (`E-to-B-prompt_hashes-接入说明.md:8-16`, `D-to-team-pr22…:31`). So the receipts *do* exist for all three roles on both paths, but their *key names differ* from the contract.\n\nMy plan reconciles this **inside `cli/run.py` only** (no producer edits): the sink normalizes `\"b.<role>\"` → `<role>` when aggregating into the manifest, and keeps the raw `\"b.<role>\"` receipts in the sidecar. This is faithful (same digest, relabelled key) — it does **not** invent or reuse a hash. If you instead want the producers to emit plain keys (a B-file change, out of my scope), reject this plan and I'll stop.\n\n## 3. Interface contract (cli/run.py only)\n\n- New sink closure `_collect_prompt_receipts()` → object with `sink(receipt)` and `raw` list. The sink:\n  - appends every receipt to `raw` (for the sidecar);\n  - normalizes each `prompt_hashes` entry key `b.<role>` → `<role>`; records the digest **only** for `bull`/`bear`/`research_manager`.\n  - Detects: (a) a required role never seen, (b) empty/None digest, (c) a role whose hashes disagree across rounds. In those cases raises `ValueError` (fail-closed) at finalize time — it never writes a partial/guessed manifest.\n- `write_run_manifest(...)` gains `prompt_hashes: dict | None = None` and `prompt_receipts: list | None = None`; passes `prompt_hashes or {}` to `RunEvent`, and writes the raw receipts to a sidecar `prompt-receipts.jsonl` next to the manifest.\n- `_make_manifest_writer(...)` threads the collector through so both the success and failure finalize paths use it.\n- `run_analysis` creates the collector and passes its `sink` into `_build_graph` → `TradingAgentsGraph(..., on_prompt=sink)`. `_build_graph` gains an `on_prompt=None` kwarg forwarded (avoid passing when `None` to preserve legacy behavior).\n- **Error semantics**: on invalid collection, finalize raises before `write_manifest`; the run already has its failure path.               "content": "\"\"\"Offline tests for wiring B's ``on_prompt`` receipts into the run manifest.\n\nThe graph/producer side (``agents/prompt_receipts.py``) emits one receipt per\nmodel send, tagging the static-template digest under the key ``b.<role>``. The\nmanifest contract (``docs/contracts/run-event.md`` field 10) wants plain role\nkeys ``bull`` / ``bear`` / ``research_manager``. The CLI is the sole manifest\nwriter, so it collects the receipts, normalizes ``b.<role>`` -> ``<role>`` (same\ndigest, relabelled key), keeps the raw receipts in a sidecar for audit, and\nrefuses to write a manifest when a required role is missing, a hash is empty, or\na role's hashes disagree.\n\nContract refs: ``docs/contracts/run-event.md`` field 10; ``docs/evaluation/protocol.md``\n(``prompt_hashes`` is a guard, empty refused); ``docs/handoffs/E-to-B-prompt_hashes-接入说明.md``.\nInvariant (comparison gate): the three roles ``bull`` / ``bear`` / ``research_manager``\nmust be present and non-empty; malformed input fails closed (refuse, never guess).\n\nNo network, no model: receipts are synthetic; manifests are written to ``tmp_path``.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"scripts\"))\n\nimport compare_runs  # noqa: E402\n\nimport cli.run as cli_run  # noqa: E402\nfrom tradingagents.run_recorder import RunEvent, read_manifest, write_manifest  # noqa: E402\n\nFIXED_AT = datetime(2026, 11, 21, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)\n\nREQUIRED_ROLES = (\"bull\", \"bear\", \"research_manager\")\n\n# Static-template digests, one per role (distinct, non-empty).\nTEMPLATE_DIGESTS = {\n    \"bull\": \"a\" * 64,\n    \"bear\": \"b\" * 64,\n    \"research_manager\": \"c\" * 64,\n}\n\n\ndef _receipt(role, digest=None, *, round_index=0, run_id=\"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\"):\n    \"\"\"A receipt shaped exactly like ``legacy_prompt_observer`` emits it.\"\"\"\n    digest = TEMPLATE_DIGESTS[role] if digest is None else digest\n    return {\n        \"role\": role,\n        \"run_id\": run_id,\n        \"round_index\": round_index,\n        \"prompt_hashes\": {\"b.\" + role: digest},\n        \"input_sha256\": \"0\" * 64,\n    }\n\n\ndef _v0_receipts():\n    \"\"\"v0-shaped stream: two debate rounds + one manager.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        _receipt(\"bull\", round_index=0),\n        _receipt(\"bear\", round_index=0),\n        _receipt(\"bull\", round_index=1),\n        _receipt(\"bear\", round_index=1),\n        _receipt(\"research_manager\"),\n    ]\n\n\ndef _v1_receipts():\n    \"\"\"v1-shaped stream: one debate round + one manager.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        _receipt(\"bull\", round_index=0),\n        _receipt(\"bear\", round_index=0),\n        _receipt(\"research_manager\"),\n    ]\n\n\ndef _config(**overrides) -> dict:\n    config = {\n        \"results_dir\": \"/tmp/results\",\n        \"llm_provider\": \"openai\",\n        \"quick_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-luna\",\n        \"deep_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-sol\",\n        \"output_language\": \"English\",\n    }\n    config.update(overrides)\n    return config\n\n\ndef _write(config=None, **overrides):\n    \"\"\"Call ``write_run_manifest`` with sensible defaults; return the path.\"\"\"\n    kwargs = {\n        \"config\": config or _config(),\n        \"ticker\": \"NVDA\",\n        \"trade_date\": \"2026-11-20\",\n        \"asset_type\": \"stock\",\n        \"outcome\": \"Buy\",\n        \"usage\": {\"llm_calls\": 5, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 10, \"tokens_out\": 5},\n        \"duration_seconds\": 1.0,\n        \"failure\": None,\n        \"variant\": \"v0\",\n        \"repeat\": 1,\n        \"at\": FIXED_AT,\n        \"version\": \"0.7.1\",\n    }\n    kwargs.update(overrides)\n    return cli_run.write_run_manifest(**kwargs)\n\n\n# --- collector: normalization + validation -----------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_collector_normalizes_b_prefixed_keys_to_plain_roles():\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in _v0_receipts():\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    assert collector.prompt_hashes() == dict(TEMPLATE_DIGESTS)\n\n\ndef test_collector_keeps_raw_receipts_with_b_prefix():\n    receipts = _v0_receipts()\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in receipts:\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    raw = collector.raw_receipts()\n    assert raw == receipts\n    # Raw receipts keep B's original \"b.<role>\" key for audit.\n    assert all(list(r[\"prompt_hashes\"]) == [\"b.\" + r[\"role\"]] for r in raw)\n\n\ndef test_collector_accepts_v1_single_round():\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in _v1_receipts():\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    assert collector.prompt_hashes() == dict(TEMPLATE_DIGESTS)\n\n\ndef test_collector_rejects_missing_role():\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in (_receipt(\"bull\"), _receipt(\"bear\")):\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"research_manager\"):\n        collector.prompt_hashes()\n\n\ndef test_collector_rejects_empty_hash():\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"bull\", digest=\"\"))\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"bear\"))\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"research_manager\"))\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        collector.prompt_hashes()\n\n\ndef test_collector_rejects_none_hash():\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"bull\", digest=None) | {\"prompt_hashes\": {\"b.bull\": None}})\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"bear\"))\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"research_manager\"))\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        collector.prompt_hashes()\n\n\ndef test_collector_rejects_disagreeing_hashes_for_same_role():\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"bull\", round_index=0, digest=\"a\" * 64))\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"bull\", round_index=1, digest=\"d\" * 64))\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"bear\"))\n    collector.sink(_receipt(\"research_manager\"))\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"bull\"):\n        collector.prompt_hashes()\n\n\ndef test_collector_repeated_identical_hashes_are_fine():\n    # The same template across two rounds is the normal case: identical digests\n    # for one role must NOT be treated as a disagreement.\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in _v0_receipts():\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    assert collector.prompt_hashes()[\"bull\"] == TEMPLATE_DIGESTS[\"bull\"]\n\n\n# --- write_run_manifest: manifest + sidecar ----------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_normal_run_writes_three_hashes_into_manifest(tmp_path):\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in _v0_receipts():\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    path = _write(\n        config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n        prompt_hashes=collector.prompt_hashes(),\n        prompt_receipts=collector.raw_receipts(),\n    )\n    manifest = read_manifest(path)\n    assert set(manifest[\"prompt_hashes\"]) == set(REQUIRED_ROLES)\n    assert all(manifest[\"prompt_hashes\"][role] for role in REQUIRED_ROLES)\n    assert manifest[\"prompt_hashes\"] == dict(TEMPLATE_DIGESTS)\n\n\ndef test_normal_run_writes_raw_receipts_sidecar(tmp_path):\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in _v0_receipts():\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    path = _write(\n        config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n        prompt_hashes=collector.prompt_hashes(),\n        prompt_receipts=collector.raw_receipts(),\n    )\n    sidecar = path.parent / \"prompt-receipts.jsonl\"\n    assert sidecar.exists()\n    lines = [json.loads(line) for line in sidecar.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines()]\n    assert len(lines) == len(_v0_receipts())\n    assert all(list(row[\"prompt_hashes\"]) == [\"b.\" + row[\"role\"]] for row in lines)\n\n\ndef test_missing_role_receipts_never_reach_manifest(tmp_path):\n    # Finalize refuses: no manifest is written when a required role is absent.\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in (_receipt(\"bull\"), _receipt(\"bear\")):\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"research_manager\"):\n        hashes = collector.prompt_hashes()\n        _write(\n            config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n            prompt_hashes=hashes,\n            prompt_receipts=collector.raw_receipts(),\n        )\n    assert not (tmp_path / \"runs\").exists()\n\n\n# --- done criterion: v0 and v1 manifests are comparable ----------------------\n\n\ndef _run_event(run_id: str, prompt_hashes: dict) -> RunEvent:\n    return RunEvent(\n        run_id=run_id,\n        created_at=\"2026-11-21T12:00:00+00:00\",\n        version=\"0.7.1\",\n        ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n        asset_type=\"stock\",\n        outcome=\"Buy\",\n        config_snapshot=dict(_config()),\n        prompt_hashes=prompt_hashes,\n        evidence_snapshot=None,\n        usage={\"llm_calls\": 5, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 10, \"tokens_out\": 5},\n        duration_seconds=1.0,\n        failure=None,\n        stop_reason=\"completed\",\n    )\n\n\ndef test_v0_and_v1_manifests_are_comparable(tmp_path):\n    v0_collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in _v0_receipts():\n        v0_collector.sink(receipt)\n    v1_collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in _v1_receipts():\n        v1_collector.sink(receipt)\n\n    v0_hashes = v0_collector.prompt_hashes()\n    v1_hashes = v1_collector.prompt_hashes()\n    # Same static templates -> identical guards across variants.\n    assert v0_hashes == v1_hashes == dict(TEMPLATE_DIGESTS)\n\n    v0_manifest = _run_event(\"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261121t1200\", v0_hashes)\n    v1_manifest = _run_event(\"v1-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-20261121t1300\", v1_hashes)\n    # compare_runs accepts the pair (does not raise IncomparableRunsError).\n    comparison = compare_runs.compare_manifests([v0_manifest, v1_manifest])\n    assert comparison.guard[\"prompt_hashes\"] == dict(TEMPLATE_DIGESTS)\n    assert {row[\"variant\"] for row in comparison.variants} == {\"v0\", \"v1\"}\n\n\ndef test_manifest_written_and_readable_via_recorder(tmp_path):\n    # End-to-end through the real recorder: the three hashes survive on disk.\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in _v1_receipts():\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    path = _write(\n        config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n        variant=\"v1\",\n        prompt_hashes=collector.prompt_hashes(),\n        prompt_receipts=collector.raw_receipts(),\n    )\n    manifest = read_manifest(path)\n    assert path.parent.name.startswith(\"v1-\")\n    assert manifest[\"prompt_hashes\"] == dict(TEMPLATE_DIGESTS)\n"

              "oldString": "    clock=None,\n    stop_reason: str | None = None,\n    evidence_mode: str = \"strict\",\n) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n\n    ``stop_reason`` is read from the run's final state by the caller (C owns the\n    value domain); it is ``None`` when the graph did not reach a terminal state.\n    ``prompt_hashes`` (B) is ``{}`` and ``evidence_snapshot`` (A) is ``None`` until\n    those members' contracts land. ``duration_seconds`` is measured from\n    ``started_at`` and ``clock`` (``time.time`` by default) when not supplied;\n    passing both keeps it testable.",

              "newString": "def _make_manifest_writer(config: dict, selections: dict, stats_handler, started_at=None, variant=\"v0\", prompt_receipts=None):\n    \"\"\"Return a ``write(failure=..., outcome=...)`` bound to this run's inputs.\n\n    ``variant`` selects the architecture under test and becomes the first segment\n    of the manifest ``run_id``; ``repeat`` is 1 and ``created_at`` is now, both\n    supplied here so the recorder never reads the clock itself. ``started_at`` is\n    the run's start (``time.time()``); forwarding it lets the manifest record a\n    real duration. ``prompt_receipts`` is the collector (or ``None`` when no\n    receipts were gathered); its aggregated hashes and raw receipts are written\n    into the manifest and the sidecar.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def write(*, failure, outcome, stop_reason=None):\n        prompt_hashes = None\n        raw_receipts = None\n        if prompt_receipts is not None:\n            prompt_hashes = prompt_receipts.prompt_hashes()\n            raw_receipts = prompt_receipts.raw_receipts()\n        return write_run_manifest(\n            config=config,\n            ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n            trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n            asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n            outcome=outcome,\n            usage=stats_handler.get_stats(),\n            failure=failure,\n            variant=variant,\n            repeat=1,\n            at=datetime.now(UTC),\n            version=__version__,\n            started_at=started_at,\n            stop_reason=stop_reason,\n            evidence_mode=config.get(\"evidence_mode\", \"strict\"),\n            prompt_hashes=prompt_hashes,\n            prompt_receipts=raw_receipts,\n        )\n\n    return write",

              "patch": "Index: src/cli/run.py\n===================================================================\n--- src/cli/run.py\t\n+++ src/cli/run.py\t\n@@ -1,910 +1,914 @@\n \"\"\"Running one analysis from the CLI: build the graph, stream it into the live view, save the report.\"\"\"\n \n import inspect\n import json\n import os\n import re\n import sys\n import time\n import webbrowser\n from dataclasses import replace\n from datetime import UTC, datetime\n from functools import wraps\n from pathlib import Path\n \n import typer\n from rich.live import Live\n \n from cli.display import (\n     ANALYST_ORDER,\n     AnalystWallTimeTracker,\n     classify_message_type,\n     console,\n     create_layout,\n     display_complete_report,\n     message_buffer,\n     update_analyst_statuses,\n     update_display,\n     update_research_team_status,\n )\n from cli.selections import depth_from_env, get_user_selections, unattended_gaps\n from cli.stats_handler import StatsCallbackHandler\n from tradingagents import __version__\n from tradingagents.agents.rating import is_review, run_rating\n from tradingagents.dataflows.symbols import safe_ticker_component\n from tradingagents.default_config import DEFAULT_CONFIG\n from tradingagents.graph.analyst_execution import (\n     build_analyst_execution_plan,\n )\n from tradingagents.graph.trading_graph import TradingAgentsGraph\n from tradingagents.run_recorder import RunEvent, build_run_id, write_manifest\n \n _VALID_VARIANTS = (\"v0\", \"v1\", \"v2\")\n \n \n def _validate_variant(value: str) -> str:\n     \"\"\"Accept only a known, lowercase architecture variant slug (``v0``/``v1``/``v2``).\n \n     The value becomes the first segment of the manifest ``run_id`` and a directory\n     name under the results root, so an unknown or unsafe value is rejected rather\n     than interpolated.\n     \"\"\"\n     if value not in _VALID_VARIANTS:\n         raise ValueError(\n             f\"invalid variant {value!r}; expected one of {', '.join(_VALID_VARIANTS)}\"\n         )\n     return value\n \n \n \n # The roles whose static-prompt digests gate a run comparison. A manifest must\n # carry all three, non-empty, for compare_runs.py to accept the run.\n REQUIRED_PROMPT_ROLES = (\"bull\", \"bear\", \"research_manager\")\n # B's producers tag each template digest under ``b.<role>``; the manifest wants\n # the plain role key. Same digest, relabelled.\n _PROMPT_HASH_PREFIX = \"b.\"\n \n \n class _PromptReceiptCollector:\n     \"\"\"Collect B's ``on_prompt`` receipts and aggregate the three role digests.\n \n     The sink is ``sink``: each receipt is kept verbatim in ``raw_receipts()`` for\n     the sidecar (audit trail, original ``b.<role>`` keys) while its template\n     digest is recorded under the plain ``<role>`` key. ``prompt_hashes()`` fails\n     closed: a missing required role, an empty/None digest, or one role whose\n     digests disagree across rounds raises ``ValueError`` rather than writing a\n     partial or guessed manifest.\n     \"\"\"\n \n     def __init__(self):\n         self._raw: list[dict] = []\n         self._digests: dict[str, set[str]] = {}\n \n     def sink(self, receipt: dict) -> None:\n         self._raw.append(receipt)\n         for key, digest in (receipt.get(\"prompt_hashes\") or {}).items():\n             role = key[len(_PROMPT_HASH_PREFIX):] if key.startswith(_PROMPT_HASH_PREFIX) else key\n             if role not in REQUIRED_PROMPT_ROLES:\n                 continue\n             self._digests.setdefault(role, set()).add(digest)\n \n     def raw_receipts(self) -> list[dict]:\n         return list(self._raw)\n \n     def prompt_hashes(self) -> dict:\n+        if not self._raw:\n+            # No receipts at all: a legacy or fake-graph run never attaches the sink.\n+            # Default to empty (compare_runs refuses it) rather than failing the write.\n+            return {}\n         missing = [role for role in REQUIRED_PROMPT_ROLES if role not in self._digests]\n         if missing:\n             raise ValueError(\n                 \"cannot write prompt_hashes: no receipt for required role(s) \"\n                 + \", \".join(missing)\n             )\n         result: dict[str, str] = {}\n         for role in REQUIRED_PROMPT_ROLES:\n             digests = self._digests[role]\n             if any(not digest for digest in digests):\n                 raise ValueError(\n                     f\"cannot write prompt_hashes: role {role!r} has an empty hash\"\n                 )\n             if len(digests) > 1:\n                 raise ValueError(\n                     f\"cannot write prompt_hashes: role {role!r} has disagreeing \"\n                     f\"hashes across receipts ({len(digests)} distinct)\"\n                 )\n             result[role] = next(iter(digests))\n         return result\n \n \n def _collect_prompt_receipts() -> _PromptReceiptCollector:\n     return _PromptReceiptCollector()\n \n \n def _run_directory(config: dict, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Where this run writes, with the ticker validated as a path component.\n \n     Every other path that interpolates a ticker checks it first; a value of\n     \"..\" here would place the run outside the results directory.\n     \"\"\"\n     return Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / safe_ticker_component(ticker) / trade_date\n \n \n def _manifest_config_snapshot(config: dict) -> dict:\n     \"\"\"Scalars from ``config`` that are safe to record in a run manifest.\n \n     The recorder already drops secret-pattern keys; keeping only scalar values\n     here also excludes nested objects and lists that are not comparable settings.\n     ``results_dir`` is a machine-local output path, not a comparable setting, so it\n     is left out of the manifest.\n     \"\"\"\n     return {\n         key: value\n         for key, value in config.items()\n         if key != \"results_dir\"\n         and (isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None)\n     }\n \n \n def write_run_manifest(\n     *,\n     config: dict,\n     ticker: str,\n     trade_date: str,\n     asset_type: str,\n     outcome: str | None,\n     usage: dict,\n     failure: str | None,\n     variant: str,\n     repeat: int,\n     at: datetime,\n     version: str,\n     duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n     started_at: float | None = None,\n     clock=None,\n     stop_reason: str | None = None,\n     evidence_mode: str = \"strict\",\n     prompt_hashes: dict | None = None,\n     prompt_receipts: list | None = None,\n ) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n \n     ``stop_reason`` is read from the run's final state by the caller (C owns the\n     value domain); it is ``None`` when the graph did not reach a terminal state.\n     ``prompt_hashes`` (B) holds the three role template digests collected from\n     ``on_prompt`` and lands in the manifest; ``prompt_receipts`` (the raw receipts)\n     are written to a ``prompt-receipts.jsonl`` sidecar beside the manifest for\n     audit. Both default to empty when no receipts were collected (e.g. legacy\n     runs). ``evidence_snapshot`` (A) is ``None`` until that contract lands.\n     ``duration_seconds`` is measured from ``started_at`` and ``clock``\n     (``time.time`` by default) when not supplied; passing both keeps it testable.\n \n     A per-run ``evidence-mode.json`` sidecar (E4) is written next to the manifest\n     recording the evidence mode and the facts the run observed. It does not change\n     the RunEvent v1 15 fields.\n     \"\"\"\n     run_id = build_run_id(variant, ticker, trade_date, repeat, at)\n     if duration_seconds is None and started_at is not None:\n         now = (clock or time.time)()\n         duration_seconds = max(0.0, now - started_at)\n \n     event = RunEvent(\n         run_id=run_id,\n         created_at=at.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(),\n         version=version,\n         ticker=ticker,\n         trade_date=trade_date,\n         asset_type=asset_type,\n         outcome=outcome,\n         config_snapshot=_manifest_config_snapshot(config),\n         prompt_hashes=prompt_hashes or {},\n         evidence_snapshot=None,\n         usage=usage,\n         duration_seconds=duration_seconds,\n         failure=failure,\n         stop_reason=stop_reason,\n     )\n     runs_dir = Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\"\n     run_id = _unique_run_id(runs_dir, run_id)\n     event = replace(event, run_id=run_id)\n     manifest_dir = runs_dir / run_id\n     manifest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     path = write_manifest(event, manifest_dir / \"manifest.json\")\n     write_evidence_mode(manifest_dir / \"evidence-mode.json\", run_id, evidence_mode)\n     write_prompt_receipts(manifest_dir / \"prompt-receipts.jsonl\", prompt_receipts)\n     return path\n \n \n def write_prompt_receipts(path, prompt_receipts: list | None) -> Path | None:\n     \"\"\"Write the raw ``on_prompt`` receipts as a JSONL sidecar (audit trail).\n \n     The manifest records only the three aggregated role digests; the per-send\n     receipts (``role`` / ``run_id`` / ``round_index`` / ``b.<role>`` digest /\n     ``input_sha256``) are kept here verbatim so the audit trailing does not lose\n     B's original keys. Nothing is written when no receipts were collected.\n     \"\"\"\n     if not prompt_receipts:\n         return None\n     path = Path(path)\n     lines = [\n         json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) for receipt in prompt_receipts\n     ]\n     path.write_text(\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n     return path\n \n \n _EVIDENCE_MODES = (\"strict\", \"report_reference\")\n \n \n def write_evidence_mode(path, run_id: str, evidence_mode: str) -> Path:\n     \"\"\"Write the E4 ``evidence-mode.json`` sidecar recording this run's mode.\n \n     E records facts only; the authoritative action and the mode approval belong to\n     D/C, so those fields are ``None`` here unless a caller later fills them in.\n     \"\"\"\n     if evidence_mode not in _EVIDENCE_MODES:\n         raise ValueError(\n             f\"invalid evidence_mode {evidence_mode!r}; expected one of {', '.join(_EVIDENCE_MODES)}\"\n         )\n     sidecar = {\n         \"schema_version\": 1,\n         \"run_id\": run_id,\n         \"evidence_mode\": evidence_mode,\n         \"scenario\": None,\n         \"policy_version\": None,\n         \"unknown_time_fields\": [],\n         \"limitations\": [],\n         \"authoritative_action\": None,\n         \"authoritative_reason\": None,\n         \"decided_by\": None,\n         \"snapshot_ref\": {\"snapshot_id\": None, \"artifact_key\": None},\n     }\n     path = Path(path)\n     path.write_text(json.dumps(sidecar, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n     return path\n \n \n def _unique_run_id(runs_dir: Path, run_id: str) -> str:\n     \"\"\"A run_id whose directory does not exist yet, so a same-minute retry is safe.\n \n     ``build_run_id`` has minute resolution, so two runs started in the same minute\n     (or a retry) produce the same id. Appending ``-<n>`` keeps the id within the\n     recorder's 64-char pattern and never overwrites an earlier manifest.\n     \"\"\"\n     pattern = re.compile(r\"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,62}$\")\n     candidate = run_id\n     suffix = 2\n     while (runs_dir / candidate).exists():\n         candidate = f\"{run_id}-{suffix}\"\n         if not pattern.match(candidate):\n             raise ValueError(f\"no free run_id derived from {run_id!r} within 64 chars\")\n         suffix += 1\n     return candidate\n \n \n def _make_manifest_writer(config: dict, selections: dict, stats_handler, started_at=None, variant=\"v0\", prompt_receipts=None):\n     \"\"\"Return a ``write(failure=..., outcome=...)`` bound to this run's inputs.\n \n     ``variant`` selects the architecture under test and becomes the first segment\n     of the manifest ``run_id``; ``repeat`` is 1 and ``created_at`` is now, both\n     supplied here so the recorder never reads the clock itself. ``started_at`` is\n     the run's start (``time.time()``); forwarding it lets the manifest record a\n     real duration. ``prompt_receipts`` is the collector (or ``None`` when no\n     receipts were gathered); its aggregated hashes and raw receipts are written\n     into the manifest and the sidecar.\n     \"\"\"\n \n     def write(*, failure, outcome, stop_reason=None):\n         prompt_hashes = None\n         raw_receipts = None\n         if prompt_receipts is not None:\n             prompt_hashes = prompt_receipts.prompt_hashes()\n             raw_receipts = prompt_receipts.raw_receipts()\n         return write_run_manifest(\n             config=config,\n             ticker=selections[\"ticker\"],\n             trade_date=selections[\"analysis_date\"],\n             asset_type=selections[\"asset_type\"],\n             outcome=outcome,\n             usage=stats_handler.get_stats(),\n             failure=failure,\n             variant=variant,\n             repeat=1,\n             at=datetime.now(UTC),\n             version=__version__,\n             started_at=started_at,\n             stop_reason=stop_reason,\n             evidence_mode=config.get(\"evidence_mode\", \"strict\"),\n             prompt_hashes=prompt_hashes,\n             prompt_receipts=raw_receipts,\n         )\n \n     return write\n \n \n def _finalize_run_manifest(\n     *,\n     write,\n     graph,\n     ticker: str,\n     trade_date: str,\n     asset_type: str,\n     portfolio,\n     final_state,\n     failure: BaseException | None,\n ) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Write the manifest, then dispose of (or keep) the checkpoint.\n \n     The manifest is written **before** the checkpoint is cleared, so a crash in\n     teardown never loses the record. A failed run still writes a manifest with\n     ``failure`` set and keeps its checkpoint for resume; the failure is re-raised.\n     ``stop_reason`` is read from ``final_state`` (C's field) with a ``None``\n     fallback when the run did not reach a terminal state.\n     \"\"\"\n     outcome = None if final_state is None else run_rating(final_state)\n     stop_reason = (final_state or {}).get(\"stop_reason\") if failure is None else None\n     write(failure=None if failure is None else str(failure), outcome=outcome, stop_reason=stop_reason)\n \n     if failure is not None:\n         raise failure\n \n     if final_state is not None:\n         graph.record_decision(ticker, trade_date, final_state)\n     graph.clear_checkpoint_on_success(ticker, trade_date, asset_type, portfolio)\n \n \n def _announce_checkpoint_state(graph, ticker: str, trade_date: str) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Say whether this run resumed a saved one, where the user can see it.\n \n     The graph logs this, but nothing in the CLI configures logging and the live\n     view owns the screen, so a resume was invisible.\n     \"\"\"\n     if getattr(graph, \"_resuming\", False):\n         message_buffer.add_message(\n             \"System\", f\"Resuming the saved run for {ticker} on {trade_date}\"\n         )\n     else:\n         message_buffer.add_message(\"System\", f\"Starting fresh for {ticker} on {trade_date}\")\n \n \n def _build_run_config(selections: dict, checkpoint: bool | None) -> dict:\n     \"\"\"Assemble the run config from interactive selections, honoring env precedence.\n \n     Round counts and checkpoint follow \"explicit env/flag wins\": an env-applied\n     value on DEFAULT_CONFIG is preserved unless the user overrode it on the CLI.\n     \"\"\"\n     config = DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy()\n     # Research depth sets both round counts, but an explicit env override\n     # (TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS / _MAX_RISK_ROUNDS) wins over the\n     # interactive selection — leave the env-applied value in place (#977).\n     rounds = ((\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS\", \"max_debate_rounds\"),\n               (\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_RISK_ROUNDS\", \"max_risk_discuss_rounds\"))\n     depth_was_asked = not depth_from_env()\n     for env_var, key in rounds:\n         if not os.environ.get(env_var):\n             config[key] = selections[\"research_depth\"]\n         elif depth_was_asked:\n             # The depth question appeared (it is skipped only when both are\n             # set), so say which half of the answer the environment overrode.\n             console.print(\n                 f\"[green]✓ {key} from environment:[/green] {config[key]} \"\n                 f\"(set by {env_var}, so the research depth you chose does not apply to it)\"\n             )\n     config[\"quick_think_llm\"] = selections[\"quick_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"deep_think_llm\"] = selections[\"deep_think_llm\"]\n     config[\"backend_url\"] = selections[\"backend_url\"]\n     config[\"llm_provider\"] = selections[\"llm_provider\"].lower()\n     # Provider-specific thinking configuration. Only the main provider's is\n     # asked; a tier on another provider keeps its configured value (#1440).\n     for key in (\"google_thinking_level\", \"openai_reasoning_effort\", \"anthropic_effort\"):\n         if selections.get(key) is not None:\n             config[key] = selections[key]\n     config[\"output_language\"] = selections.get(\"output_language\", \"English\")\n     # --checkpoint/--no-checkpoint overrides only when explicitly given; omitting\n     # the flag preserves TRADINGAGENTS_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED / the default (#976).\n     if checkpoint is not None:\n         config[\"checkpoint_enabled\"] = checkpoint\n     return config\n \n \n def _graph_accepts_workflow_variant(graph_cls) -> bool:\n     \"\"\"Whether ``graph_cls.__init__`` has an explicit ``workflow_variant`` parameter.\n \n     Only an explicit, named parameter counts. A bare ``**kwargs`` catch-all is *not*\n     treated as support: a legacy graph that swallows unknown kwargs would otherwise be\n     handed v1 and silently ignore it, mislabelling a v0-compatible run. A graph class\n     that cannot introspect returns ``False`` rather than guessing.\n     \"\"\"\n     try:\n         params = inspect.signature(graph_cls.__init__).parameters\n     except (TypeError, ValueError):\n         return False\n     return \"workflow_variant\" in params\n \n \n def _reject_unavailable_variant(variant: str | None, graph_cls=None) -> None:\n     \"\"\"Refuse a variant that the workflow cannot run, before any model call.\n \n     ``None`` means the flag was omitted: that is the legacy run and is always\n     allowed. v0 is always allowed. v2 is not delivered yet and is refused\n     regardless of the graph. v1 is allowed only when ``graph_cls`` accepts\n     ``workflow_variant``; otherwise it is refused (a v0-compatible run must not be\n     mislabelled v1).\n     \"\"\"\n     if variant is None or variant == \"v0\":\n         return\n     if variant == \"v2\":\n         console.print(\n             \"[red]Variant 'v2' is not available yet: the adaptive workflow is not \"\n             \"delivered. Use --variant v0 (or v1 if the graph supports it).[/red]\"\n         )\n         raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n     if graph_cls is None or not _graph_accepts_workflow_variant(graph_cls):\n         console.print(\n             f\"[red]Variant {variant!r} is not available: this graph does not accept \"\n             \"workflow_variant. Run with --variant v0.[/red]\"\n         )\n         raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n \n \n def _build_graph(graph_cls, selected_analyst_keys, config, callbacks, *, workflow_variant, on_prompt=None):\n     \"\"\"Construct the graph, forwarding ``workflow_variant``/``on_prompt`` when accepted.\n \n     ``on_prompt`` is B's receipt sink; it is forwarded only when supplied so a\n     legacy run keeps the inert default (``None``) and the graph stays unchanged.\n     \"\"\"\n     kwargs = {\"config\": config, \"debug\": True, \"callbacks\": callbacks}\n     if _graph_accepts_workflow_variant(graph_cls):\n         kwargs[\"workflow_variant\"] = workflow_variant\n     if on_prompt is not None:\n         kwargs[\"on_prompt\"] = on_prompt\n     return graph_cls(selected_analyst_keys, **kwargs)\n \n \n def _effective_manifest_variant(graph, requested: str) -> str:\n     \"\"\"The variant the graph actually enabled, from ``run_settings()``, else requested.\"\"\"\n     run_settings = getattr(graph, \"run_settings\", None)\n     if not callable(run_settings):\n         return requested\n     try:\n         settings = run_settings()\n     except (TypeError, ValueError):\n         return requested\n     if not isinstance(settings, dict):\n         return requested\n     return settings.get(\"workflow_variant\") or requested\n \n \n # Settings the graph reports that describe what actually ran. The CLI config is the\n # requested configuration; the manifest must record these effective values instead.\n _EFFECTIVE_SETTING_KEYS = (\"max_debate_rounds\", \"max_risk_discuss_rounds\")\n \n \n def _effective_config(config: dict, graph, workflow_variant: str = \"v0\") -> dict:\n     \"\"\"Overlay the graph's effective settings onto ``config`` for the manifest.\n \n     A variant preset (or any graph-side adjustment) changes the rounds actually run.\n     The manifest's ``config_snapshot`` must reflect that, not the requested config.\n     Keys the graph does not report are left as configured.\n \n     ``workflow_variant`` is the effective variant already computed for the run_id's\n     first segment (``manifest_variant``), recorded here too so the snapshot and the\n     run_id always agree. It is set even when the graph reports nothing.\n     \"\"\"\n     effective = dict(config)\n     effective[\"workflow_variant\"] = workflow_variant\n     run_settings = getattr(graph, \"run_settings\", None)\n     if not callable(run_settings):\n         return effective\n     try:\n         settings = run_settings()\n     except (TypeError, ValueError):\n         return effective\n     if not isinstance(settings, dict):\n         return effective\n     for key in _EFFECTIVE_SETTING_KEYS:\n         if settings.get(key) is not None:\n             effective[key] = settings[key]\n     return effective\n \n \n def run_analysis(checkpoint: bool | None = None, portfolio=None, flags=None, variant=None):\n     flags = flags or {}\n     # ``None`` = the flag was omitted: the legacy run (configured rounds, no preset).\n     if variant is not None:\n         variant = _validate_variant(variant)\n     # Refuse a variant the graph cannot run before any setup or model call: v2 is\n     # not delivered, and v1 needs a graph that accepts workflow_variant.\n     _reject_unavailable_variant(variant, TradingAgentsGraph)\n     # With no terminal nothing can answer a prompt: name every question still\n     # open before any model is called, rather than stopping at the first one.\n     if not (sys.stdin and sys.stdin.isatty()):\n         gaps = unattended_gaps(flags)\n         if gaps:\n             console.print(\"[red]No terminal to answer the setup questions. Set:[/red]\")\n             for gap in gaps:\n                 console.print(f\"  {gap}\")\n             raise typer.Exit(code=1)\n \n     selections = get_user_selections(flags)\n \n     config = _build_run_config(selections, checkpoint)\n \n     stats_handler = StatsCallbackHandler()\n \n     # Normalize analyst selection to predefined order (selection is a 'set', order is fixed)\n     selected_set = {analyst.value for analyst in selections[\"analysts\"]}\n     selected_analyst_keys = [a for a in ANALYST_ORDER if a in selected_set]\n     analyst_execution_plan = build_analyst_execution_plan(selected_analyst_keys)\n     analyst_wall_time_tracker = AnalystWallTimeTracker(analyst_execution_plan)\n \n     # Collect B's on_prompt receipts so the three role template digests reach the\n     # manifest and the raw receipts reach the sidecar (compare_runs guard).\n     prompt_receipts = _collect_prompt_receipts()\n \n     graph = _build_graph(\n         TradingAgentsGraph,\n         selected_analyst_keys,\n         config,\n         [stats_handler],\n         workflow_variant=variant,\n         on_prompt=prompt_receipts.sink,\n     )\n     # The variant the graph actually enabled drives the manifest identity, and the\n     # graph's effective rounds drive the manifest config snapshot for the writers.\n     manifest_variant = _effective_manifest_variant(graph, variant or \"v0\")\n     effective_config = _effective_config(config, graph, manifest_variant)\n \n     message_buffer.init_for_analysis(selected_analyst_keys)\n \n     # Track start time for elapsed display\n     start_time = time.time()\n \n     results_dir = _run_directory(config, selections[\"ticker\"], selections[\"analysis_date\"])\n     results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     report_dir = results_dir / \"reports\"\n     report_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n     log_file = results_dir / \"message_tool.log\"\n     log_file.touch(exist_ok=True)\n \n     def save_message_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n             func(*args, **kwargs)\n             timestamp, message_type, content = obj.messages[-1]\n             content = content.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")  # Replace newlines with spaces\n             with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                 f.write(f\"{timestamp} [{message_type}] {content}\\n\")\n         return wrapper\n \n     def save_tool_call_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n             func(*args, **kwargs)\n             timestamp, tool_name, args = obj.tool_calls[-1]\n             args_str = \", \".join(f\"{k}={v}\" for k, v in args.items())\n             with open(log_file, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                 f.write(f\"{timestamp} [Tool Call] {tool_name}({args_str})\\n\")\n         return wrapper\n \n     def save_report_section_decorator(obj, func_name):\n         func = getattr(obj, func_name)\n \n         @wraps(func)\n         def wrapper(section_name, content):\n             func(section_name, content)\n             if section_name in obj.report_sections and obj.report_sections[section_name] is not None:\n                 content = obj.report_sections[section_name]\n                 if content:\n                     file_name = f\"{section_name}.md\"\n                     text = \"\\n\".join(str(item) for item in content) if isinstance(content, list) else content\n                     with open(report_dir / file_name, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                         f.write(text)\n         return wrapper\n \n     message_buffer.add_message = save_message_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_message\")\n     message_buffer.add_tool_call = save_tool_call_decorator(message_buffer, \"add_tool_call\")\n     message_buffer.update_report_section = save_report_section_decorator(message_buffer, \"update_report_section\")\n \n     layout = create_layout()\n \n     # The alternate screen keeps a layout taller than the window from redrawing\n     # by scrolling; the final report prints after this block, on the normal screen.\n     with Live(layout, refresh_per_second=4, screen=True):\n         # Someone\n     answering the save question at the prompt is also asked about the page and\n     offered to open it; a run whose flags answer the save question asks neither.\n     \"\"\"\n     asked = save is None\n     if asked:\n         save = typer.prompt(\"Save report?\", default=\"Y\").strip().upper() in (\"Y\", \"YES\", \"\")\n     if save:\n         # Under results_dir, not the working directory: in Docker the working\n         # directory is inside the container and the report goes with it, while\n         # results_dir is the mounted volume the rest of the run already writes to.\n         save_path = graph.default_report_path(ticker)\n         if asked:   # someone at the prompt may pick another folder\n             save_path = Path(typer.prompt(\n                 \"Save path (press Enter for default)\", default=str(save_path)\n             ).strip())\n         if html is None:\n             html = _yes(\"Also save it as an HTML page?\") if asked else True\n         saved = False\n         try:\n             report_file = graph.save_reports(final_state, ticker, save_path, html=html)\n             saved = True\n             console.print(f\"\\n[green]✓ Report saved to:[/green] {save_path.resolve()}\")\n             console.print(f\"  [dim]Complete report:[/dim] {report_file.name}\")\n         except Exception as e:\n             console.print(f\"[red]Error saving report: {e}[/red]\")\n         if saved and html:\n             page = (save_path / \"complete_report.html\").resolve()\n             console.print(f\"  [dim]HTML report:[/dim] {page.name}\")\n             if asked:\n                 _open_page(page)\n \n     if show is None:\n         show = typer.prompt(\"\\nDisplay full report on screen?\", default=\"Y\").strip().upper() in (\"Y\", \"YES\", \"\")\n     if show:\n         display_complete_report(final_state)\n",

to write a manifest when a required role is missing, a hash is empty, or\n a role's hashes disagree.\n \n Contract refs: ``docs/contracts/run-event.md`` field 10; ``docs/evaluation/protocol.md``\n                 "text": "    assert all(manifest[\"prompt_hashes\"][role] for role in REQUIRED_ROLES)\n    assert manifest[\"prompt_hashes\"] == dict(TEMPLATE_DIGESTS)\n\n\ndef test_normal_run_writes_raw_receipts_sidecar(tmp_path):\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in _v0_receipts():\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    path = _write(\n        config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n        prompt_hashes=collector.prompt_hashes(),\n        prompt_receipts=collector.raw_receipts(),\n    )\n    sidecar = path.parent / \"prompt-receipts.jsonl\"\n    assert sidecar.exists()\n    lines = [json.loads(line) for line in sidecar.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines()]\n    assert len(lines) == len(_v0_receipts())\n    assert all(list(row[\"prompt_hashes\"]) == [\"b.\" + row[\"role\"]] for row in lines)\n\n\ndef test_missing_role_receipts_never_reach_manifest(tmp_path):\n    # Finalize refuses: no manifest is written when a required role is absent.\n    collector = cli_run._collect_prompt_receipts()\n    for receipt in (_receipt(\"bull\"), _receipt(\"bear\")):\n        collector.sink(receipt)\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"research_manager\"):\n        hashes = collector.prompt_hashes()\n        _write(\n            config=_config(results_dir=str(tmp_path)),\n            prompt_hashes=hashes,",

          "text": "The fake graph's `create_run_state` accepts `**k`? No — it's `(self, ticker, trade_date, asset_type=\"stock\", portfolio=None)`, no `**kwargs`. So passing `source_run_id=` unconditionally would break this test. I must introspect `create_run_state` and only pass `source_run_id` when its signature accepts it. The `_graph_accepts_workflow_variant` pattern proves this is the house style.\n\nI now have everything. Here's the plan.\n\n---\n\n# Execution Plan — E's fresh V0/V1 evidence integration\n\n## Traceability\n- `docs/contracts/evidence.md` / `src/tradingagents/evidence.py` (A-EV-08): canonical artifact key `v1/<64hex>.json`, `sha256:<64hex>` identity. `evidence_store` only prepares E's destination; A's `save_snapshot` publishes.\n- `docs/contracts/run-event.md` field 11 `evidence_snapshot` (object|null, A-owned, opaque to recorder).\n- E4 evidence-mode sidecar (`docs/handoffs/E-interfaces-v1.md`, `test_evidence_mode.py`): `snapshot_ref = {snapshot_id, artifact_key}`.\n- Invariant: no file outside run dir is ever written; fail-closed on path escape. AGENTS.md: E owns `src/cli/`, `run_recorder`, `evidence` adjacency; no graph/agents edits. No commit/push/PR.\n\n## Interface contract\n1. **`reserve_run_id(*, config, variant, ticker, trade_date, repeat, at) -> str`** (new, cli/run.py): computes `build_run_id`, validates `RUN_ID_PATTERN`, then atomically reserves the directory via the existing `_unique_run_id` + `mkdir` retry loop, returning the reserved (possibly `-<n>` suffixed) id. `write_run_manifest`'s inline reservation is **removed and delegated** to this function (no duplication).\n2. **`write_run_manifest(..., run_id=None)`**: when `run_id` supplied → validate against `RUN_ID_PATTERN`, reuse as-is, no `_unique_run_id`, **no second mkdir** (the dir already exists from reservation; `mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`). When absent → legacy inline reservation path preserved. `_make_manifest_writer(..., run_id=None)` forwards it. The failure `except` branch reuses the **same** writer object/reserved id (built once outside the try, or a single writer passed to both paths) — no second writer, original exception preserved. `write_manifest` remains the sole terminal writer.\n3. **`src/tradingagents/evidence_store.py`** (new): `evidence_destination(config, run_id, artifact_key) -> Path`. Root `Path(results_dir)/\"runs\"/run_id/\"evidence\"`. Validates `artifact_key` against the canonical `v1/<64hex>.json` grammar (reject absolute, `..`, backslash, non-canonical), joins under root, resolves and asserts the result is contained in root (reject symlink/`..` escapes), creates parents. No `local-fs` component. Imports only stdlib + optionally `evidence` regex constant; **must not import `cli.run`**.\n4. **Evidence reference forwarding** (cli/run.py): `write_run_manifest` gains `evidence_snapshot: dict | None = None` (replaces hardcoded `None`); `_finalize_run_manifest` reads `final_state.get(\"evidence_snapshot\")` (success path) and passes it (failure path stays `None`); `write_evidence_mode` gains optional `snapshot_ref` and fills `snapshot_id`/`artifact_key` (unchanged values; null stays null).\n5. **`create_run_state` source_run_id**: call `graph.create_run_state(..., source_run_id=reserved_id)` **only when** the method's signature accepts `source_run_id` (introspection helper like `_graph_accepts_workflow_variant`); otherwise call legacy form (keeps fake graphs/graph unchanged).\n\n## Scope boundaries\n- **Editable**: `src/cli/run.py`, new `src/tradingagents/evidence_store.py`, `test/offline/`.\n- **Read-only/frozen**: `graph/`, `agents/`, `scripts/compare_runs.py`, `default_config.py`, CI. No `.env`. No commit/push/PR.\n\n## Testing strategy (offline, no model, no network)\nNew file(s) under `test/offline/`:\n- **Collision IDs distinct**: two `reserve_run_id` with same inputs → distinct ids; dirs reserved.\n- **Writer reuses supplied run_id**: `write_run_manifest(run_id=X)` writes under `runs/X/`, no `-2` suffix.\n- **Failure path reuses same reservation**: stub graph that raises → manifest written at the reserved id, failure recorded, original exception re-raised, no second directory.\n- **Containment** (`evidence_store`): accepts canonical key → path under `<results>/runs/<id>/evidence/v1/<hex>.json`; rejects absolute, `..`, backslash, wrong version, symlink escape (symlinked evidence dir pointing outside → refused).\n- **Reference forwarding**: populated `final_state[\"evidence_snapshot\"]` → manifest field + `evidence-mode.json.snapshot_ref` populated; `None` → both null (legitimate null preserved).\n- **`source_run_id` forwarding**: fake graph whose `create_run_state` accepts `source_run_id` receives it; one that doesn't is called without it (legacy).\n- Keep `test_cli_run_manifest.py`, `test_cli_prompt_hashes.py`, `test_evidence_mode.py` green.\n\n## Steps (each independently verifiable)\n1. Add `reserve_run_id`; refactor `write_run_manifest` to delegate to it when `run_id` absent; add `run_id` param + reuse path.\n2. Add `_make_manifest_writer(run_id=...)`; build writer once in `run_analysis`, reuse across success/failure.\n3. Call `reserve_run_id` in `run_analysis` before `create_run_state`; pass reserved id to writer and (introspected) `source_run_id`.\n4. Add `evidence_store.py`.\n5. Add `evidence_snapshot` + `snapshot_ref` forwarding.\n6. Write tests (red first), implement to green.\n7. Run EXACTLY: `python -m pytest -q tests test/offline` and `python -m ruff check src tests test scripts`. Both must be clean. Report exact counts.\n\n## Done criteria\nBoth commands clean; collision/reuse/failure-reuse/containment/forwarding tests pass; existing CLI/manifest/prompt-hash/evidence-mode tests green. No files outside scope touched.\n\n---\n\nOne decision to flag: the real `TradingAgentsGraph.create_run_state` does **not** currently accept `source_run_id`, and I may not edit `graph/`.               "file": "src/tradingagents/evidence_store.py",
              "patch": "Index: src/tradingagents/evidence_store.py\n===================================================================\n--- src/tradingagents/evidence_store.py\t\n+++ src/tradingagents/evidence_store.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@\n+\"\"\"E-owned evidence destination preparation (no publication).\n+\n+Role A owns evidence *publication* (``evidence.save_snapshot`` writes the\n+snapshot). This module only answers one E-side question: given a run and A's\n+canonical artifact key, *where* under that run's directory does the artifact\n+belong? The answer is ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/evidence/<artifact_key>``.\n+\n+The canonical key grammar is ``v1/<64 lowercase hex>.json`` (see\n+``evidence._ARTIFACT_KEY`` / ``artifact_key_for``). Anything else -- an absolute\n+path, a ``..`` segment, a backslash, a different version, an upper-case or wrong\n+length digest -- is rejected rather than interpreted. The joined path is then\n+resolved and asserted to stay inside the evidence root, so a symlinked\n+``evidence``/version directory cannot redirect the write outside the run.\n+\n+This module deliberately imports neither ``cli.run`` nor the graph: it is\n+importable by the graph as a plain path helper.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import re\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+# The one canonical artifact-key grammar (v1 schema). Mirrors\n+# ``evidence._ARTIFACT_KEY`` without importing the heavy evidence module.\n+_ARTIFACT_KEY = re.compile(r\"v1/[0-9a-f]{64}\\.json\\Z\")\n+\n+# A run id is used as a single directory component; reject separators and the\n+# traversal token so the root cannot be escaped before the key is even joined.\n+_RUN_ID_FORBIDDEN = (\"/\", \"\\\\\", \"..\")\n+\n+\n+def _validate_run_id(run_id: str) -> str:\n+    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id:\n+        raise ValueError(\"run_id must be a non-empty string\")\n+    if any(token in run_id for token in _RUN_ID_FORBIDDEN):\n+        raise ValueError(f\"unsafe run_id {run_id!r} for an evidence path component\")\n+    return run_id\n+\n+\n+def _validate_artifact_key(artifact_key: str) -> str:\n+    if not isinstance(artifact_key, str) or not _ARTIFACT_KEY.fullmatch(artifact_key):\n+        raise ValueError(\n+            f\"invalid artifact_key {artifact_key!r}; expected 'v1/<64 hex>.json'\"\n+        )\n+    return artifact_key\n+\n+\n+def evidence_destination(config: dict, run_id: str, artifact_key: str) -> Path:\n+    \"\"\"Return (and create) the on-disk path for ``artifact_key`` in this run.\n+\n+    Path: ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/evidence/<artifact_key>``. The parent\n+    directories are created. ``local-fs`` is nowhere in the path: it is a\n+    conceptual backend name, not a filesystem component. The final path is\n+    resolved and must remain inside the evidence root, so an absolute key, a\n+    ``..`` segment, or a symlinked directory that points outside is refused with\n+    ``ValueError`` instead of being followed.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    run_id = _validate_run_id(run_id)\n+    artifact_key = _validate_artifact_key(artifact_key)\n+\n+    root = (Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\" / run_id / \"evidence\").resolve()\n+    destination = (root / artifact_key).resolve()\n+\n+    # Containment: the resolved destination must sit strictly inside the root.\n+    try:\n+        destination.relative_to(root)\n+    except ValueError as exc:\n+        raise ValueError(\n+            f\"artifact_key {artifact_key!r} escapes the evidence root\"\n+        ) from exc\n+    if destination == root:\n+        raise ValueError(f\"artifact_key {artifact_key!r} resolves to the evidence root\")\n+\n+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    return destination\n",

              "deletions": 0,
              "status": "added"
            },

The evidence reference (``evidence_snapshot``) flows from the graph's final\n+   state into the manifest and the ``evidence-mode.json`` ``snapshot_ref``;\n+   a legitimate ``None`` stays ``None``.\n+\n+No model, no network, no ``.env``.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+import json\n+import sys\n+from datetime import UTC, datetime\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+import pytest\n+\n+sys.path.insert(0,             "input": {
              "content": "\"\"\"Offline tests for E's fresh V0/V1 evidence integration.\n\nCovers four E-owned changes in ``cli/run.py`` and the new\n``tradingagents/evidence_store.py``:\n\n1. ``reserve_run_id`` reserves a collision-safe run directory up front; the\n   manifest writer reuses that exact id (no re-reservation, no second mkdir).\n2. ``write_run_manifest`` / ``_make_manifest_writer`` accept an optional\n   ``run_id``; a supplied id is validated and reused as-is.\n3. ``evidence_destination`` places A's canonical artifact key under\n   ``<results>/runs/<run_id>/evidence/`` and refuses absolute / ``..`` / symlink\n   escapes.\n4. The evidence reference (``evidence_snapshot``) flows from the graph's final\n   state into the manifest and the ``evidence-mode.json`` ``snapshot_ref``;\n   a legitimate ``None`` stays ``None``.\n\nNo model, no network, no ``.env``.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"scripts\"))\n\nimport cli.run as cli_run  # noqa: E402\nfrom tradingagents import evidence_store  # noqa: E402\nfrom tradingagents.run_recorder import read_manifest  # noqa: E402\n\nFIXED_AT = datetime(2026, 11, 22, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)\nDIGEST = \"0123456789abcdef\" * 4\nARTIFACT_KEY = \"v1/\" + DIGEST + \".json\"\nSNAPSHOT_ID = \"sha256:\" + DIGEST\n\n\ndef _config(tmp_path):\n    return {\n        \"results_dir\": str(tmp_path),\n        \"llm_provider\": \"openai\",\n        \"quick_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-luna\",\n        \"deep_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-sol\",\n        \"output_language\": \"English\",\n    }\n\n\n# --- 1. reserve_run_id: collision-safe, distinct ids ------------------------\n\n\ndef test_reserve_run_id_returns_distinct_ids_for_same_inputs(tmp_path):\n    config = _config(tmp_path)\n    kwargs = dict(\n        config=config, variant=\"v0\", ticker=\"NVDA\", trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n        repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n    )\n    first = cli_run.reserve_run_id(**kwargs)\n    second = cli_run.reserve_run_id(**kwargs)\n    assert first != second\n    assert (tmp_path / \"runs\" / first).is_dir()\n    assert (tmp_path / \"runs\" / second).is_dir()\n\n\ndef test_reserve_run_id_creates_directory(tmp_path):\n    run_id = cli_run.reserve_run_id(\n        config=_config(tmp_path), variant=\"v1\", ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\", repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n    )\n    assert run_id.startswith(\"v1-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-\")\n    assert (tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id).is_dir()\n\n\n# --- 2. writer reuses supplied run_id ---------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _write(tmp_path, **overrides):\n    kwargs = dict(\n        config=_config(tmp_path), ticker=\"NVDA\", trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n        asset_type=\"stock\", outcome=\"Buy\",\n        usage={\"llm_calls\": 1, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 1, \"tokens_out\": 0},\n        duration_seconds=1.0, failure=None, variant=\"v0\", repeat=1,\n        at=FIXED_AT, version=\"0.7.1\",\n    )\n    kwargs.update(overrides)\n    return cli_run.write_run_manifest(**kwargs)\n\n\ndef test_writer_reuses_supplied_run_id(tmp_path):\n    run_id = cli_run.reserve_run_id(\n        config=_config(tmp_path), variant=\"v0\", ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\", repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n    )\n    path = _write(tmp_path, run_id=run_id)\n    # Same id, no \"-2\" suffix; manifest lives under the reserved directory.\n    assert path.parent.name == run_id\n    assert read_manifest(path)[\"run_id\"] == run_id\n\n\ndef test_writer_rejects_invalid_supplied_run_id(tmp_path):\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        _write(tmp_path, run_id=\"Bad/ID\")\n\n\ndef test_writer_without_run_id_keeps_legacy_reservation(tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path)\n    assert path.parent.name.startswith(\"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-\")\n\n\n# --- 2b. failure path reuses the SAME reservation ---------------------------\n\n\nclass _RaisingGraph:\n    def __init__(self, evidence=None):\n        self.evidence = evidence\n        self.recorded = False\n        self.cleared = False\n\n    def record_decision(self, *a, **k):\n        self.recorded = True\n\n    def clear_checkpoint_on_success(self, *a, **k):\n        self.cleared = True\n\n\ndef test_failure_path_reuses_same_reservation(tmp_path):\n    run_id = cli_run.reserve_run_id(\n        config=_config(tmp_path), variant=\"v0\", ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\", repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n    )\n\n    class _Stats:\n        def get_stats(self):\n            return {\"llm_calls\": 0, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 0, \"tokens_out\": 0}\n\n    selections = {\"ticker\": \"NVDA\", \"analysis_date\": \"2026-11-20\", \"asset_type\": \"stock\"}\n    write = cli_run._make_manifest_writer(\n        _config(tmp_path), selections, _Stats(), started_at=0.0, variant=\"v0\", run_id=run_id,\n    )\n    graph = _RaisingGraph()\n    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=\"boom\"):\n        cli_run._finalize_run_manifest(\n            write=write, graph=graph, ticker=\"NVDA\", trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n            asset_type=\"stock\", portfolio=None, final_state=None,\n            failure=RuntimeError(\"boom\"),\n        )\n    manifest_path = tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id / \"manifest.json\"\n    assert manifest_path.is_file()\n    assert read_manifest(manifest_path)[\"failure\"] == \"boom\"\n    # No second directory was created beside the reservation.\n    assert not (tmp_path / \"runs\" / f\"{run_id}-2\").exists()\n\n\n# --- 3. evidence_store containment -------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_evidence_destination_places_canonical_key_under_run(tmp_path):\n    config = _config(tmp_path)\n    dest = evidence_store.evidence_destination(config, \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\", ARTIFACT_KEY)\n    expected_root = tmp_path / \"runs\" / \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\" / \"evidence\"\n    assert dest == expected_root / \"v1\" / (DIGEST + \".json\")\n    assert dest.parent.is_dir()\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad_key\", [\n    \"/etc/passwd\",\n    \"../escape.json\",\n    \"v1/../\" + DIGEST + \".json\",\n    \"v1\\\\\" + DIGEST + \".json\",\n    \"v2/\" + DIGEST + \".json\",\n    \"v1/\" + DIGEST.upper() + \".json\",\n    \"v1/\" + \"a\" * 63 + \".json\",\n    \"\",\n], ids=[\"absolute\", \"dotdot\", \"traversal\", \"backslash\", \"wrong-version\",\n        \"uppercase-hex\", \"short\", \"empty\"])\ndef test_evidence_destination_rejects_non_canonical_keys(tmp_path, bad_key):\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\", bad_key)\n\n\ndef test_evidence_destination_rejects_symlink_escape(tmp_path):\n    run_id = \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\"\n    evidence_root = tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id / \"evidence\"\n    evidence_root.mkdir(parents=True)\n    outside = tmp_path / \"outside\"\n    outside.mkdir()\n    # Make evidence/v1 a symlink pointing outside the run directory.\n    (evidence_root / \"v1\").symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), run_id, ARTIFACT_KEY)\n\n\ndef test_evidence_store_does_not_import_cli_run():\n    source = Path(evidence_store.__file__).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    assert \"import cli.run\" not in source\n    assert \"from cli.run\" not in source\n\n\n# --- 4. evidence reference forwarding ---------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_populated_evidence_reference_forwarded_to_manifest_and_sidecar(tmp_path):\n    run_id = cli_run.reserve_run_id(\n        config=_config(tmp_path), variant=\"v0\", ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\", repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n    )\n    reference = {\"snapshot_id\": SNAPSHOT_ID, \"artifact_key\": ARTIFACT_KEY}\n\n    class _Stats:\n        def get_stats(self):\n            return {\"llm_calls\": 0, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 0, \"tokens_out\": 0}\n\n    selections = {\"ticker\": \"NVDA\", \"analysis_date\": \"2026-11-20\", \"asset_type\": \"stock\"}\n    write = cli_run._make_manifest_writer(\n        _config(tmp_path), selections, _Stats(), started_at=0.0, variant=\"v0\", run_id=run_id,\n    )\n    graph = _RaisingGraph()\n    cli_run._finalize_run_manifest(\n        write=write, graph=graph, ticker=\"NVDA\", trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n        asset_type=\"stock\", portfolio=None,\n        final_state={\"evidence_snapshot\": reference, \"final_rating\": \"Buy\"},\n        failure=None,\n    )\n    run_dir = tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id\n    manifest = read_manifest(run_dir / \"manifest.json\")\n    assert manifest[\"evidence_snapshot\"] == reference\n    sidecar = json.loads((run_dir / \"evidence-mode.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    assert sidecar[\"snapshot_ref\"] == {\"snapshot_id\": SNAPSHOT_ID, \"artifact_key\": ARTIFACT_KEY}\n\n\ndef
