          "state": {
            "status": "completed",
            "input": {
              "content": "\"\"\"E-owned evidence destination preparation (no publication).\n\nRole A owns evidence *publication* (``evidence.save_snapshot`` writes the\nsnapshot). This module only answers one E-side question: given a run and A's\ncanonical artifact key, *where* under that run's directory does the artifact\nbelong? The answer is ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/evidence/<artifact_key>``.\n\nThe canonical key grammar is ``v1/<64 lowercase hex>.json`` (see\n``evidence._ARTIFACT_KEY`` / ``artifact_key_for``). Anything else -- an absolute\npath, a ``..`` segment, a backslash, a different version, an upper-case or wrong\nlength digest -- is rejected rather than interpreted. The joined path is then\nresolved and asserted to stay inside the evidence root, so a symlinked\n``evidence``/version directory cannot redirect the write outside the run.\n\nThis module deliberately imports neither ``cli.run`` nor the graph: it is\nimportable by the graph as a plain path helper.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n# The one canonical artifact-key grammar (v1 schema). Mirrors\n# ``evidence._ARTIFACT_KEY`` without importing the heavy evidence module.\n_ARTIFACT_KEY = re.compile(r\"v1/[0-9a-f]{64}\\.json\\Z\")\n\n# A run id is used as a single directory component; reject separators and the\n# traversal token so the root cannot be escaped before the key is even joined.\n_RUN_ID_FORBIDDEN = (\"/\", \"\\\\\", \"..\")\n\n\ndef _validate_run_id(run_id: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id:\n        raise ValueError(\"run_id must be a non-empty string\")\n    if any(token in run_id for token in _RUN_ID_FORBIDDEN):\n        raise ValueError(f\"unsafe run_id {run_id!r} for an evidence path component\")\n    return run_id\n\n\ndef _validate_artifact_key(artifact_key: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(artifact_key, str) or not _ARTIFACT_KEY.fullmatch(artifact_key):\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"invalid artifact_key {artifact_key!r}; expected 'v1/<64 hex>.json'\"\n        )\n    return artifact_key\n\n\ndef evidence_destination(config: dict, run_id: str, artifact_key: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Return (and create) the on-disk path for ``artifact_key`` in this run.\n\n    Path: ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/evidence/<artifact_key>``. The parent\n    directories are created. ``local-fs`` is nowhere in the path: it is a\n    conceptual backend name, not a filesystem component. The final path is\n    resolved and must remain inside the evidence root, so an absolute key, a\n    ``..`` segment, or a symlinked directory that points outside is refused with\n    ``ValueError`` instead of being followed.\n    \"\"\"\n    run_id = _validate_run_id(run_id)\n    artifact_key = _validate_artifact_key(artifact_key)\n\n    root = (Path(config[\"results_dir\"]) / \"runs\" / run_id / \"evidence\").resolve()\n    destination = (root / artifact_key).resolve()\n\n    # Containment: the resolved destination must sit strictly inside the root.\n    try:\n        destination.relative_to(root)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"artifact_key {artifact_key!r} escapes the evidence root\"\n        ) from exc\n    if destination == root:\n        raise ValueError(f\"artifact_key {artifact_key!r} resolves to the evidence root\")\n\n    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return destination\n",
              "filePath": "/Users/erkangxue/CScourse/5351小组作业/TradingAgents-Coursework/src/tradingagents/evidence_store.py"

            "input": {
              "filePath": "/Users/erkangxue/CScourse/5351小组作业/TradingAgents-Coursework/src/cli/run.py",
              "newString": "def write_run_manifest(\n    *,\n    config: dict,\n    ticker: str,\n    trade_date: str,\n    asset_type: str,\n    outcome: str | None,\n    usage: dict,\n    failure: str | None,\n    variant: str,\n    repeat: int,\n    at: datetime,\n    version: str,\n    duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n    started_at: float | None = None,\n    clock=None,\n    stop_reason: str | None = None,\n    evidence_mode: str = \"strict\",\n    prompt_hashes: dict | None = None,\n    prompt_receipts: list | None = None,\n    run_id: str | None = None,\n    evidence_snapshot: dict | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n\n    ``stop_reason`` is read from the run's final state by the caller (C owns the\n    value domain); it is ``None`` when the graph did not reach a terminal state.\n    ``prompt_hashes`` (B) holds the three role template digests collected from\n    ``on_prompt`` and lands in the manifest; ``prompt_receipts`` (the raw receipts)\n    are written to sidecars beside the manifest for audit. Both default to empty\n    when no receipts were collected (e.g. legacy runs). ``evidence_snapshot`` (A)\n    is the run's evidence reference, stored unchanged; a legitimate ``None`` stays\n    ``None``.\n\n    ``run_id`` lets the caller pass an id already reserved via ``reserve_run_id``:\n    it is validated against ``RUN_ID_PATTERN`` and reused as-is -- no second\n    reservation, and the already-created directory is not re-reserved. When it is\n    ``None`` the id is built and reserved here (legacy behavior).\n\n    ``duration_seconds`` is measured from ``started_at`` and ``clock``\n    (``time.time`` by default) when not supplied; passing both keeps it testable.\n\n    A per-run ``evidence-mode.json`` sidecar (E4) is written next to the manifest\n    recording the evidence mode and the facts the run observed. started_at)\n\n    event = RunEvent(\n        run_id=run_id,\n        created_at=at.astimezone(UTC).isoformat(),\n        version=version,\n        ticker=ticker,\n        trade_date=trade_date,\n        asset_type=asset_type,\n        outcome=outcome,\n        config_snapshot=_manifest_config_snapshot(config),\n        prompt_hashes=prompt_hashes or {},\n        evidence_snapshot=evidence_snapshot,\n        usage=usage,\n        duration_seconds=duration_seconds,\n        failure=failure,\n        stop_reason=stop_reason,\n    )\n    path = write_manifest(event, manifest_dir / \"manifest.json\")\n    write_evidence_mode(\n        manifest_dir / \"evidence-mode.json\", run_id, evidence_mode,\n        snapshot_ref=_snapshot_ref(evidence_snapshot),\n    )\n    write_prompt_receipts(manifest_dir / \"prompt-receipts.jsonl\", prompt_receipts, run_id)\n    return path\n\n\ndef reserve_run_id(*, config: dict, variant: str, ticker: str, trade_date: str, repeat: int, at: datetime) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Reserve a collision-safe run directory up front and return its ``run_id``.\n\n    ``build_run_id`` has minute resolution, so two runs started in the same minute\n    (or a retry) produce the same id.               "oldString": "def write_run_manifest(\n    *,\n    config: dict,\n    ticker: str,\n    trade_date: str,\n    asset_type: str,\n    outcome: str | None,\n    usage: dict,\n    failure: str | None,\n    variant: str,\n    repeat: int,\n    at: datetime,\n    version: str,\n    duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n    started_at: float | None = None,\n    clock=None,\n    stop_reason: str | None = None,\n    evidence_mode: str = \"strict\",\n    prompt_hashes: dict | None = None,\n    prompt_receipts: list | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n\n    ``stop_reason`` is read from the run's final state by the caller (C owns the\n    value domain); it is ``None`` when the graph did not reach a terminal state.\n    ``prompt_hashes`` (B) holds the three role template digests collected from\n    ``on_prompt`` and lands in the manifest; ``prompt_receipts`` (the raw receipts)\n    are written to a ``prompt-receipts.jsonl`` sidecar beside the manifest for\n    audit.                 "text": "\"\"\"E-owned evidence destination preparation (no publication).\n\nRole A owns evidence *publication* (``evidence.save_snapshot`` writes the\nsnapshot). This module only answers one E-side question: given a run and A's\ncanonical artifact key, *where* under that run's directory does the artifact\nbelong? The answer is ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/evidence/<artifact_key>``.\n\nThe canonical key grammar is ``v1/<64 lowercase hex>.json`` (see\n``evidence._ARTIFACT_KEY`` / ``artifact_key_for``). The joined path is then\nresolved and asserted to stay inside the evidence root, so a symlinked\n``evidence``/version directory cannot redirect the write outside the run.\n\nThis module deliberately imports neither ``cli.run`` nor the graph: it is\nimportable by the graph as a plain path helper.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n# The one canonical artifact-key grammar (v1 schema).                 "text": "    *,\n    config: dict,\n    ticker: str,\n    trade_date: str,\n    asset_type: str,\n    outcome: str | None,\n    usage: dict,\n    failure: str | None,\n    variant: str,\n    repeat: int,\n    at: datetime,\n    version: str,\n    duration_seconds: float | None = None,\n    started_at: float | None = None,\n    clock=None,\n    stop_reason: str | None = None,\n    evidence_mode: str = \"strict\",\n    prompt_hashes: dict | None = None,\n    prompt_receipts: list | None = None,\n    run_id: str | None = None,\n    evidence_snapshot: dict | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Write this run's manifest to ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json``.\n\n    ``stop_reason`` is read from the run's final state by the caller (C owns the\n    value domain); it is ``None`` when the graph did not reach a terminal state.\n    ``prompt_hashes`` (B) holds the three role template digests collected from\n    ``on_prompt`` and lands in the manifest; ``prompt_receipts`` (the raw receipts)\n    are written to sidecars beside the manifest for audit. Unflagged path calls exactly as today.\n\n### (B) `evidence_store.evidence_destination` containment hardening\n- Validate `run_id` against `RUN_ID_PATTERN` (import from `run_recorder`; reject dot-only like `\"..\"`; reject separators). Fallback: mirror pattern if import fails.\n- **Anchor before resolve:** construct intended `run_root = results_root / \"runs\" / run_id` and `intended_evidence = run_root / \"evidence\"` as *lexical* paths (no `.resolve()` yet). If a sidecar step fails *after* `write_manifest` published, `write_run_manifest` records the sidecar failure but does not re-attempt `write_manifest`. The writer exposes `published`; `_finalize_run_manifest` (or the except) checks it: if already published, do **not** call `write` again — preserve and re-raise the original/sidecar error, and do not run cleanup.\n  - Concretely: `write_run_manifest` wraps the sidecar writes in try/except; on sidecar failure it writes a `sidecar-error` marker (or sets `failure` in a re-read? manifest already immutable/no-overwrite) — since the manifest is already published and cannot be safely overwritten, record the sidecar failure in a `sidecar-error.json` marker in the run dir and re-raise a `SidecarError` chaining the original. dot-only ids are not allowed\")\n     return run_id\n \n \n def _validate_artifact_key(artifact_key: str) -> str:\n     if not isinstance(artifact_key, str) or not _ARTIFACT_KEY.fullmatch(artifact_key):\n         raise ValueError(\n             f\"invalid artifact_key {artifact_key!r}; expected 'v1/<64 hex>.json'\"\n         )\n     return artifact_key\n \n \n+def _assert_lexically_under(path: Path, root: Path) -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Assert ``path`` is ``root`` or beneath it on a normalized (unresolved) path.\"\"\"\n+    try:\n+        path.relative_to(root)\n+    except ValueError as exc:\n+        raise ValueError(f\"{str(path)!r} is not inside {str(root)!r}\") from exc\n+\n+\n+def _reject_escaping_symlink(leaf: Path, containment_root: Path, *, anchor: Path) -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Refuse if any existing component from ``anchor`` down to ``leaf`` is a\n+    symlink that resolves outside ``containment_root`` (checked before mkdir).\"\"\"\n+    try:\n+        rel = leaf.relative_to(anchor)\n+    except ValueError:\n+        raise ValueError(f\"{str(leaf)!r} is not inside {str(anchor)!r}\") from None\n+    resolved_root = containment_root.resolve()\n+    current = anchor\n+    for part in (None, *rel.parts):\n+        if part is not None:\n+            current = current / part\n+        if not current.exists():\n+            # Nothing to follow yet;               "patch": "Index: test/offline/test_evidence_boundaries.py\n===================================================================\n--- test/offline/test_evidence_boundaries.py\t\n+++ test/offline/test_evidence_boundaries.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,338 @@\n+\"\"\"Offline tests for C's closeout-review boundary fixes (E side).\n+\n+Three concerns from ``C-to-E-evidence-interface-closeout-review.md``:\n+\n+1. **Capture opt-in** (default OFF, independent of run id and evidence mode).\n+   A real ``--capture-evidence`` flag threads into ``run_analysis``; the capture\n+   context reaches ``create_run_state`` only when the flag is on, still behind the\n+   ``source_run_id`` introspection guard. Capture with checkpointing enabled fails\n+   before graph construction, model calls, reservation or destination prep.\n+2. **Containment.** ``evidence_destination`` anchors to the intended reserved run\n+   directory first, validates ``run_id`` against ``RUN_ID_PATTERN`` (rejecting\n+   dot-only ids), and rejects symlinks along the root chain that escape the\n+   intended tree *before* creating any directory.\n+3. **Failure acceptance.** A post-reservation failure during initial state\n+   construction still writes a failure manifest using the same reservation and\n+   preserves the original error. A sidecar failure after the manifest is already\n+   published must NOT trigger a second ``write_manifest``; the original error is\n+   preserved and cleanup does not run.\n+\n+No model, no network, no ``.env``.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+import sys\n+from datetime import UTC, datetime\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+import pytest\n+\n+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"scripts\"))\n+\n+import cli.run as cli_run  # noqa: E402\n+from tradingagents import evidence_store  # noqa: E402\n+from tradingagents.run_recorder import read_manifest  # noqa: E402\n+\n+FIXED_AT = datetime(2026, 11, 22, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)\n+DIGEST = \"0123456789abcdef\" * 4\n+ARTIFACT_KEY = \"v1/\" + DIGEST + \".json\"\n+\n+\n+def _config(tmp_path, **overrides):\n+    config = {\n+        \"results_dir\": str(tmp_path),\n+        \"llm_provider\": \"openai\",\n+        \"quick_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-luna\",\n+        \"deep_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-sol\",\n+        \"output_language\": \"English\",\n+    }\n+    config.update(overrides)\n+    return config\n+\n+\n+# =============================================================================\n+# 1. Capture opt-in\n+# =============================================================================\n+\n+\n+def _supports(**_kwargs):\n+    pass\n+\n+\n+def test_capture_default_is_off(monkeypatch):\n+    \"\"\"run_analysis default must not request capture (signature default False).\"\"\"\n+    import inspect\n+\n+    params = inspect.signature(cli_run.run_analysis).parameters\n+    assert \"capture_evidence\" in params\n+    assert params[\"capture_evidence\"].default is False\n+\n+\n+def _capture_kwargs_seen():\n+    \"\"\"A fake create_run_state that records the kwargs it is called with.\"\"\"\n+    seen = {}\n+\n+    class _Graph:\n+        def create_run_state(self, company, trade_date, asset_type=\"stock\",\n+                             portfolio=None, *, source_run_id=None,\n+                             capture_context=None):\n+            seen[\"source_run_id\"] = source_run_id\n+            seen[\"capture_context\"] = capture_context\n+            return {}\n+\n+    return _Graph(), seen\n+\n+\n+def test_capture_off_does_not_pass_capture_context():\n+    graph, seen = _capture_kwargs_seen()\n+    cli_run._create_run_state(\n+        graph, \"NVDA\", \"2026-11-20\", \"stock\", None, \"reserved-id\",\n+        capture_evidence=False, capture_context={\"enabled\": True},\n+    )\n+    # Default-off: source_run_id still forwarded, but capture_context stays None.\n+    assert seen[\"source_run_id\"] == \"reserved-id\"\n+    assert seen[\"capture_context\"] is None\n+\n+\n+def test_capture_on_passes_capture_context():\n+    graph, seen = _capture_kwargs_seen()\n+    cli_run._create_run_state(\n+        graph, \"NVDA\", \"2026-11-20\", \"stock\", None, \"reserved-id\",\n+        capture_evidence=True, capture_context={\"enabled\": True},\n+    )\n+    assert seen[\"source_run_id\"] == \"reserved-id\"\n+    assert seen[\"capture_context\"] == {\"enabled\": True}\n+\n+\n+def test_capture_on_without_capture_param_fails_closed():\n+    \"\"\"Capture requested but graph's create_run_state cannot accept it -> raise.\"\"\"\n+\n+    class _LegacyGraph:\n+        def create_run_state(self, company, trade_date, asset_type=\"stock\",\n+                             portfolio=None, *, source_run_id=None):\n+            return {}\n+\n+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n+        cli_run._create_run_state(\n+            _LegacyGraph(), \"NVDA\", \"2026-11-20\", \"stock\", None, \"reserved-id\",\n+            capture_evidence=True, capture_context={\"enabled\": True},\n+        )\n+\n+\n+def test_capture_with_checkpoint_fails_before_any_work(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"capture + checkpoint enabled must refuse before graph/reservation/model.\"\"\"\n+    called = {\"graph\": False, \"reserve\": False}\n+\n+    def _boom_graph(*a, **k):\n+        called[\"graph\"] = True\n+        raise AssertionError(\"graph must not be built\")\n+\n+    def _boom_reserve(*a, **k):\n+        called[\"reserve\"] = True\n+        raise AssertionError(\"reservation must not happen\")\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"TradingAgentsGraph\", _boom_graph)\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"_build_graph\", _boom_graph)\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"reserve_run_id\", _boom_reserve)\n+    # Selections can be stubbed so the refusal is the only thing that can fire.\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"get_user_selections\", lambda flags: {\n+        \"ticker\": \"NVDA\", \"analysis_date\": \"2026-11-20\", \"asset_type\": \"stock\",\n+        \"analysts\": [], \"research_depth\": 1, \"quick_think_llm\": \"q\",\n+        \"deep_think_llm\": \"d\", \"backend_url\": None, \"llm_provider\": \"openai\",\n+        \"output_language\": \"English\",\n+    })\n+\n+    import cli.run as cr\n+    with pytest.raises((ValueError, SystemExit)) as exc:\n+        cr.run_analysis(checkpoint=True, flags={}, capture_evidence=True)\n+    assert not called[\"graph\"]\n+    assert not called[\"reserve\"]\n+    # No run directory was prepared.\n+    assert not (tmp_path / \"runs\").exists() or not any((tmp_path / \"runs\").iterdir())\n+    _ = exc\n+\n+\n+# =============================================================================\n+# 2. Containment\n+# =============================================================================\n+\n+\n+def test_canonical_key_ok(tmp_path):\n+    dest = evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\", ARTIFACT_KEY)\n+    assert dest.parent.is_dir()\n+    assert dest.name == DIGEST + \".json\"\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad_run_id\", [\n+    \"..\", \".\", \"a/b\", \"a\\\\b\", \"V0-upper\", \"\", \"-leading\", \"with space\",\n+], ids=[\"dotdot\", \"dot\", \"slash\", \"backslash\", \"uppercase\", \"empty\", \"leading-dash\", \"space\"])\n+def test_noncanonical_run_id_rejected(tmp_path, bad_run_id):\n+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n+        evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), bad_run_id, ARTIFACT_KEY)\n+\n+\n+def test_symlinked_evidence_dir_escape_rejected_before_creation(tmp_path):\n+    run_id = \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\"\n+    run_root = tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id\n+    run_root.mkdir(parents=True)\n+    outside = tmp_path / \"outside\"\n+    outside.mkdir()\n+    # evidence is a symlink pointing outside the run.\n+    (run_root / \"evidence\").symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)\n+    before = set((tmp_path / \"runs\").rglob(\"*\"))\n+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n+        evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), run_id, ARTIFACT_KEY)\n+    after = set((tmp_path / \"runs\").rglob(\"*\"))\n+    assert before == after  # nothing created\n+\n+\n+def test_symlinked_parent_run_escape_rejected(tmp_path):\n+    run_id = \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\"\n+    outside = tmp_path / \"outside\"\n+    outside.mkdir()\n+    runs = tmp_path / \"runs\"\n+    runs.mkdir()\n+    # runs/<run_id> is a symlink pointing outside results_dir.\n+    (runs / run_id).symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)\n+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n+        evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), run_id, ARTIFACT_KEY)\n+\n+\n+# =============================================================================\n+# 3. Failure acceptance\n+# =============================================================================\n+\n+\n+class _Stats:\n+    def get_stats(self):\n+        return {\"llm_calls\": 0, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 0, \"tokens_out\": 0}\n+\n+\n+def _selections():\n+    return {\"ticker\": \"NVDA\", \"analysis_date\": \"2026-11-20\", \"asset_type\": \"stock\"}\n+\n+\n+def test_init_failure_after_reservation_writes_one_failure_manifest(tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"A create_run_state failure routes to a failure manifest on the same id.\"\"\"\n+    run_id = cli_run.reserve_run_id(\n+        config=_config(tmp_path), variant=\"v0\", ticker=\"NVDA\",\n+        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\", repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n+    )\n+\n+    class _Graph:\n+        def run_id).glob(\"manifest.json\"))\n+    assert len(manifests) == 1\n+    assert read_manifest(manifests[0])[\"failure\"] == \"init boom\"\n+    assert not (tmp_path / \"runs\" / f\"{run_id}-2\").exists()\n+\n+\n+def test_sidecar_failure_after_publish_no_second_write(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    \"\"\"A sidecar failure after write_manifest must not cause a second write.\"\"\"\n+    run_id = cli_run.reserve_run_id(\n+        config=_config(tmp_path), variant=\"v0\", ticker=\"NVDA\",\n+        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\", repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n+    )\n+\n+    write_calls = {\"n\": 0}\n+    real_write_manifest = cli_run.write_manifest\n+\n+    def _counting_write_manifest(event, path):\n+        write_calls[\"n\"] += 1\n+        return real_write_manifest(event, path)\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"write_manifest\", _counting_write_manifest)\n+\n+    def _boom_sidecar(*a, **k):\n+        raise OSError(\"sidecar boom\")\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"write_evidence_mode\", _boom_sidecar)\n+\n+    with pytest.raises(cli_run.SidecarError) as exc:\n+        cli_run.write_run_manifest(\n+            config=_config(tmp_path), ticker=\"NVDA\", trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n+            asset_type=\"stock\", outcome=\"Buy\",\n+            usage={\"llm_calls\": 0, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 0, manifest write, and \"sidecar boom\" is the visible cause.\n+    assert write_calls[\"n\"] == 1\n+    assert \"sidecar boom\" in str(exc.value)\n+    manifest_path = tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id /    )\n+\n+    class _Graph:\n+        def __init__(self):\n+            self.recorded = False\n+            self.cleared = False\n+\n+        def record_decision(self, *a, **k):\n+               "content": "\"\"\"Offline tests for C's closeout-review boundary fixes (E side).\n\nThree concerns from ``C-to-E-evidence-interface-closeout-review.md``:\n\n1. **Capture opt-in** (default OFF, independent of run id and evidence mode).\n   A real ``--capture-evidence`` flag threads into ``run_analysis``; the capture\n   context reaches ``create_run_state`` only when the flag is on, still behind the\n   ``source_run_id`` introspection guard. Capture with checkpointing enabled fails\n   before graph construction, model calls, reservation or destination prep.\n2. **Containment.** ``evidence_destination`` anchors to the intended reserved run\n   directory first, validates ``run_id`` against ``RUN_ID_PATTERN`` (rejecting\n   dot-only ids), and rejects symlinks along the root chain that escape the\n   intended tree *before* creating any directory.\n3. **Failure acceptance.** A post-reservation failure during initial state\n   construction still writes a failure manifest using the same reservation and\n   preserves the original error. A sidecar failure after the manifest is already\n   published must NOT trigger a second ``write_manifest``; the original error is\n   preserved and cleanup does not run.\n\nNo model, no network, no ``.env``.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"scripts\"))\n\nimport cli.run as cli_run  # noqa: E402\nfrom tradingagents import evidence_store  # noqa: E402\nfrom tradingagents.run_recorder import read_manifest  # noqa: E402\n\nFIXED_AT = datetime(2026, 11, 22, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)\nDIGEST = \"0123456789abcdef\" * 4\nARTIFACT_KEY = \"v1/\" + DIGEST + \".json\"\n\n\ndef _config(tmp_path, **overrides):\n    config = {\n        \"results_dir\": str(tmp_path),\n        \"llm_provider\": \"openai\",\n        \"quick_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-luna\",\n        \"deep_think_llm\": \"gpt-6-sol\",\n        \"output_language\": \"English\",\n    }\n    config.update(overrides)\n    return config\n\n\n# =============================================================================\n# 1. Capture opt-in\n# =============================================================================\n\n\ndef _supports(**_kwargs):\n    pass\n\n\ndef test_capture_default_is_off(monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"run_analysis default must not request capture (signature default False).\"\"\"\n    import inspect\n\n    params = inspect.signature(cli_run.run_analysis).parameters\n    assert \"capture_evidence\" in params\n    assert params[\"capture_evidence\"].default is False\n\n\ndef _capture_kwargs_seen():\n    \"\"\"A fake create_run_state that records the kwargs it is called with.\"\"\"\n    seen = {}\n\n    class _Graph:\n        def create_run_state(self, company, trade_date, asset_type=\"stock\",\n                             portfolio=None, *, source_run_id=None,\n                             capture_context=None):\n            seen[\"source_run_id\"] = source_run_id\n            seen[\"capture_context\"] = capture_context\n            return {}\n\n    return _Graph(), seen\n\n\ndef test_capture_off_does_not_pass_capture_context():\n    graph, seen = _capture_kwargs_seen()\n    cli_run._create_run_state(\n        graph, \"NVDA\", \"2026-11-20\", \"stock\", None, \"reserved-id\",\n        capture_evidence=False, capture_context={\"enabled\": True},\n    )\n    # Default-off: source_run_id still forwarded, but capture_context stays None.\n    assert seen[\"source_run_id\"] == \"reserved-id\"\n    assert seen[\"capture_context\"] is None\n\n\ndef test_capture_on_passes_capture_context():\n    graph, seen = _capture_kwargs_seen()\n    cli_run._create_run_state(\n        graph, \"NVDA\", \"2026-11-20\", \"stock\", None, \"reserved-id\",\n        capture_evidence=True, capture_context={\"enabled\": True},\n    )\n    assert seen[\"source_run_id\"] == \"reserved-id\"\n    assert seen[\"capture_context\"] == {\"enabled\": True}\n\n\ndef test_capture_on_without_capture_param_fails_closed():\n    \"\"\"Capture requested but graph's create_run_state cannot accept it -> raise.\"\"\"\n\n    class _LegacyGraph:\n        def create_run_state(self, company, trade_date, asset_type=\"stock\",\n                             portfolio=None, *, source_run_id=None):\n            return {}\n\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        cli_run._create_run_state(\n            _LegacyGraph(), \"NVDA\", \"2026-11-20\", \"stock\", None, \"reserved-id\",\n            capture_evidence=True, capture_context={\"enabled\": True},\n        )\n\n\ndef test_capture_with_checkpoint_fails_before_any_work(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"capture + checkpoint enabled must refuse before graph/reservation/model.\"\"\"\n    called = {\"graph\": False, \"reserve\": False}\n\n    def _boom_graph(*a, **k):\n        called[\"graph\"] = True\n        raise AssertionError(\"graph must not be built\")\n\n    def _boom_reserve(*a, **k):\n        called[\"reserve\"] = True\n        raise AssertionError(\"reservation must not happen\")\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"TradingAgentsGraph\", _boom_graph)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"_build_graph\", _boom_graph)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"reserve_run_id\", _boom_reserve)\n    # Selections can be stubbed so the refusal is the only thing that can fire.\n    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"get_user_selections\", lambda flags: {\n        \"ticker\": \"NVDA\", \"analysis_date\": \"2026-11-20\", \"asset_type\": \"stock\",\n        \"analysts\": [], \"research_depth\": 1, \"quick_think_llm\": \"q\",\n        \"deep_think_llm\": \"d\", \"backend_url\": None, \"llm_provider\": \"openai\",\n        \"output_language\": \"English\",\n    })\n\n    import cli.run as cr\n    with pytest.raises((ValueError, SystemExit)) as exc:\n        cr.run_analysis(checkpoint=True, flags={}, capture_evidence=True)\n    assert not called[\"graph\"]\n    assert not called[\"reserve\"]\n    # No run directory was prepared.\n    assert not (tmp_path / \"runs\").exists() or not any((tmp_path / \"runs\").iterdir())\n    _ = exc\n\n\n# =============================================================================\n# 2. Containment\n# =============================================================================\n\n\ndef test_canonical_key_ok(tmp_path):\n    dest = evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\", ARTIFACT_KEY)\n    assert dest.parent.is_dir()\n    assert dest.name == DIGEST + \".json\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad_run_id\", [\n    \"..\", \".\", \"a/b\", \"a\\\\b\", \"V0-upper\", \"\", \"-leading\", \"with space\",\n], ids=[\"dotdot\", \"dot\", \"slash\", \"backslash\", \"uppercase\", \"empty\", \"leading-dash\", \"space\"])\ndef test_noncanonical_run_id_rejected(tmp_path, bad_run_id):\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), bad_run_id, ARTIFACT_KEY)\n\n\ndef test_symlinked_evidence_dir_escape_rejected_before_creation(tmp_path):\n    run_id = \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\"\n    run_root = tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id\n    run_root.mkdir(parents=True)\n    outside = tmp_path / \"outside\"\n    outside.mkdir()\n    # evidence is a symlink pointing outside the run.\n    (run_root / \"evidence\").symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)\n    before = set(p for p in (tmp_path / \"runs\").rglob(\"*\"))\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), run_id, ARTIFACT_KEY)\n    after = set(p for p in (tmp_path / \"runs\").rglob(\"*\"))\n    assert before == after  # nothing created\n\n\ndef test_symlinked_parent_run_escape_rejected(tmp_path):\n    run_id = \"v0-nvda-2026-11-20-r1-x\"\n    outside = tmp_path / \"outside\"\n    outside.mkdir()\n    runs = tmp_path / \"runs\"\n    runs.mkdir()\n    # runs/<run_id> is a symlink pointing outside results_dir.\n    (runs / run_id).symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        evidence_store.evidence_destination(_config(tmp_path), run_id, ARTIFACT_KEY)\n\n\n# =============================================================================\n# 3. Failure acceptance\n# =============================================================================\n\n\nclass _Stats:\n    def get_stats(self):\n        return {\"llm_calls\": 0, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 0, \"tokens_out\": 0}\n\n\ndef _selections():\n    return {\"ticker\": \"NVDA\", \"analysis_date\": \"2026-11-20\", \"asset_type\": \"stock\"}\n\n\ndef test_init_failure_after_reservation_writes_one_failure_manifest(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"A create_run_state failure routes to a failure manifest on the same id.\"\"\"\n    run_id = cli_run.reserve_run_id(\n        config=_config(tmp_path), variant=\"v0\", ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\", repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n    )\n\n    class _Graph:\n        def create_run_state(self, *a, **k):\n            raise RuntimeError(\"init boom\")\n\n    graph = _Graph()\n    write = cli_run._make_manifest_writer(\n        _config(tmp_path), _selections(), _Stats(), started_at=0.0,\n        variant=\"v0\", run_id=run_id,\n    )\n    # Simulate run_analysis wrapping init inside the finalize try/except.\n    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=\"init boom\"):\n        try:\n            cli_run._create_run_state(graph, \"NVDA\", \"2026-11-20\", \"stock\", None, run_id,\n                                      capture_evidence=False, capture_context=None)\n        except BaseException as failure:\n            cli_run._finalize_run_manifest(\n                write=write, graph=graph, ticker=\"NVDA\", trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n                asset_type=\"stock\", portfolio=None, final_state=None, failure=failure,\n            )\n    manifests = list((tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id).glob(\"manifest.json\"))\n    assert len(manifests) == 1\n    assert read_manifest(manifests[0])[\"failure\"] == \"init boom\"\n    assert not (tmp_path / \"runs\" / f\"{run_id}-2\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_sidecar_failure_after_publish_no_second_write(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A sidecar failure after write_manifest must not cause a second write.\"\"\"\n    run_id = cli_run.reserve_run_id(\n        config=_config(tmp_path), variant=\"v0\", ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\", repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n    )\n\n    write_calls = {\"n\": 0}\n    real_write_manifest = cli_run.write_manifest\n\n    def _counting_write_manifest(event, path):\n        write_calls[\"n\"] += 1\n        return real_write_manifest(event, path)\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"write_manifest\", _counting_write_manifest)\n\n    def _boom_sidecar(*a, **k):\n        raise OSError(\"sidecar boom\")\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run, \"write_evidence_mode\", _boom_sidecar)\n\n    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc:\n        cli_run.write_run_manifest(\n            config=_config(tmp_path), ticker=\"NVDA\", trade_date=\"2026-11-20\",\n            asset_type=\"stock\", outcome=\"Buy\",\n            usage={\"llm_calls\": 0, \"tool_calls\": 0, \"tokens_in\": 0, \"tokens_out\": 0},\n            duration_seconds=1.0, failure=None, variant=\"v0\", repeat=1,\n            at=FIXED_AT, version=\"0.7.1\", run_id=run_id,\n        )\n    # Exactly one terminal manifest write, and \"sidecar boom\" is the visible cause.\n    assert write_calls[\"n\"] == 1\n    assert \"sidecar boom\" in str(exc.value)\n    manifest_path = tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id / \"manifest.json\"\n    assert manifest_path.is_file()  # not overwritten / not removed\n    # A sidecar-error marker records the failure explicitly.\n    marker = tmp_path / \"runs\" / run_id / \"sidecar-error.json\"\n    assert marker.is_file()\n\n\ndef test_sidecar_failure_after_publish_no_cleanup(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"Cleanup (record_decision/clear_checkpoint) must not run when sidecar fails.\"\"\"\n    run_id = cli_run.reserve_run_id(\n        config=_config(tmp_path), variant=\"v0\", ticker=\"NVDA\",\n        trade_date=\"2026-11-20\", repeat=1, at=FIXED_AT,\n    )\n\n    class _Graph:\n        def __init__(self):\n            self.recorded = False\n            self.cleared = False\n\n        def record_decision(self, *a, **k):\n            self.recorded = True\n\n        def clear_checkpoint_on_success(self, *a, **k):\n            self.cleared = True\n\n    def _boom_sidecar(*a, **k):\n        raise OSError(\"sidecar boom\")\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_run,               "newString": "def _callable_accepts_source_run_id(fn) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether ``fn`` (``create_run_state``) has an explicit ``source_run_id`` param.\n\n    Only an explicit, named parameter (positional-or-keyword or keyword-only)\n    counts; a bare ``**kwargs`` catch-all does not, so a graph that would silently\n    swallow the id is treated as unsupported and called with the legacy signature.\n    \"\"\"\n    return _callable_accepts_param(fn, \"source_run_id\")\n\n\ndef _callable_accepts_param(fn, name: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether ``fn`` has an explicit, named ``name`` parameter (not ``**kwargs``).\"\"\"\n    try:\n        params = inspect.signature(fn).parameters\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return False\n    param = params.get(name)\n    return param is not None and param.kind in (\n        inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD,\n        inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY,\n    )\n\n\ndef _create_run_state(\n    graph, ticker, trade_date, asset_type, portfolio, source_run_id,\n    *, capture_evidence: bool = False, capture_context=None,\n):\n    \"\"\"Build the run state, forwarding ``source_run_id`` when the graph takes it.\n\n    ``source_run_id`` (the reserved run id) is forwarded whenever the graph's\n    ``create_run_state`` has an explicit ``source_run_id`` parameter. When\n    ``capture_evidence`` is on, a ``capture_context`` is forwarded too, but only\n    if the graph also has an explicit ``capture_context`` parameter; capture\n    requested without that support fails closed (``ValueError``) rather than\n    silently dropping the evidence. Unflagged runs call exactly as before: the\n    legacy four-arg form when the graph has neither parameter.\n    \"\"\"\n    create = graph.create_run_state\n    kwargs = {}\n    if _callable_accepts_param(create, \"source_run_id\"):\n        kwargs[\"source_run_id\"] = source_run_id\n    if capture_evidence:\n        if not _callable_accepts_param(create, \"capture_context\"):\n            raise ValueError(\n                \"evidence capture was requested but this graph's create_run_state \"\n                \"does not accept a capture_context parameter\"\n            )\n        kwargs[\"capture_context\"] = capture_context\n    return create(ticker, trade_date, asset_type, portfolio, **kwargs)",

            "status": "completed",
            "input": {
              "content": "\"\"\"E-owned evidence destination preparation (no publication).\n\nRole A owns evidence *publication* (``evidence.save_snapshot`` writes the\nsnapshot). This module only answers one E-side question: given a run and A's\ncanonical artifact key, *where* under that run's directory does the artifact\nbelong? The answer is ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/evidence/<artifact_key>``.\n\nThe canonical key grammar is ``v1/<64 lowercase hex>.json`` (see\n``evidence._ARTIFACT_KEY`` / ``artifact_key_for``). Anything else -- an absolute\npath, a ``..`` segment, a backslash, a different version, an upper-case or wrong\nlength digest -- is rejected rather than interpreted.\n\nContainment is anchored *before* any resolution: the intended reserved run\ndirectory ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>`` is built and checked to sit inside the\nconfigured results root, and the intended evidence directory is checked to sit\ninside that run directory -- all on lexically normalized (non-``resolve``d)\npaths. Only then is the path resolved for the final comparison, and any symlink\nalong the root chain that escapes the intended tree is refused *before* a\ndirectory is created. ``run_id`` must satisfy the recorder contract\n(``RUN_ID_PATTERN``), which also rejects dot-only ids.\n\nThis module deliberately imports neither ``cli.run`` nor the graph: it is\nimportable by the graph as a plain path helper.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ntry:  # Reuse the recorder's canonical pattern; mirror it if import is unavailable.\n    from tradingagents.run_recorder import RUN_ID_PATTERN\nexcept Exception:  # pragma: no cover - defensive fallback, keeps the grammar identical\n    RUN_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,62}$\")\n\n# The one canonical artifact-key grammar (v1 schema). Mirrors\n# ``evidence._ARTIFACT_KEY`` without importing the heavy evidence module.\n_ARTIFACT_KEY = re.compile(r\"v1/[0-9a-f]{64}\\.json\\Z\")\n\n\ndef _validate_run_id(run_id: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Validate against the recorder contract; also reject dot-only components.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id:\n        raise ValueError(\"run_id must be a non-empty string\")\n    if not RUN_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(run_id):\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"invalid run_id {run_id!r}; must match {RUN_ID_PATTERN.pattern}\"\n        )\n    # A purely dotted id (\"..\", \"...\") matches the charset but is unsafe as a\n    # directory component even though the pattern allows it.\n    if set(run_id) <= {\".\"}:\n        raise ValueError(f\"unsafe run_id {run_id!r}; dot-only ids are not allowed\")\n    return run_id\n\n\ndef _validate_artifact_key(artifact_key: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(artifact_key, str) or not _ARTIFACT_KEY.fullmatch(artifact_key):\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"invalid artifact_key {artifact_key!r}; expected 'v1/<64 hex>.json'\"\n        )\n    return artifact_key\n\n\ndef _assert_lexically_under(path: Path, root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Assert ``path`` is ``root`` or beneath it on a normalized (unresolved) path.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        path.relative_to(root)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{str(path)!r} is not inside {str(root)!r}\") from exc\n\n\ndef _reject_escaping_symlink(root_chain_leaf: Path, containment_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse if any existing component from ``containment_root`` to the leaf is a\n    symlink that resolves outside ``containment_root`` (checked before mkdir).\"\"\"\n    try:\n        rel = root_chain_leaf.relative_to(containment_root)\n    except ValueError:\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"{str(root_chain_leaf)!r} is not inside {str(containment_root)!r}\"\n        ) from None\n    current = containment_root\n    # ``rel.parts`` may be (); then only the containment root is checked.\n    for part in (None, *rel.parts):\n        if part is not None:\n            current = current / part\n        if not current.exists():\n            # Nothing to follow yet; later components do not exist either.\n            return\n        if current.is_symlink():\n            target = current.resolve()\n            try:\n                target.relative_to(containment_root.resolve())\n            except ValueError:\n                raise ValueError(\n                    f\"refusing symlink {str(current)!r} that escapes \"\n                    f\"{str(containment_root)!r}\"\n                ) from None\n\n\ndef evidence_destination(config: dict, run_id: str, artifact_key: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Return (and create) the on-disk path for ``artifact_key`` in this run.\n\n    Path: ``<results_dir>/runs/<run_id>/evidence/<artifact_key>``. The parent\n    directories are created **after** all containment checks pass. ``local-fs``\n    is nowhere in the path: it is a conceptual backend name, not a filesystem\n    component.\n\n    Order (containment before creation):\n\n    1. Validate ``run_id`` (recorder contract) and ``artifact_key`` (canonical).\n    2. Anchor the intended roots lexically and assert they nest:\n       ``results_root`` -> ``run_root`` -> ``evidence_root``.\n    3. Reject any symlink along ``results_root .. evidence_root`` (and the key's\n       parent) that resolves outside the intended run directory.\n    4. Only then resolve and re-check the destination stays inside ``run_root``.\n    \"\"\"\n    run_id = _validate_run_id(run_id)\n    artifact_key = _validate_artifact_key(artifact_key)\n\n    results_root = Path(config[\"results_dir\"])\n    runs_root = results_root / \"runs\"\n    run_root = runs_root / run_id\n    evidence_root = run_root / \"evidence\"\n    destination = evidence_root / artifact_key\n\n    # 2. Lexical nesting checks (no resolve yet).\n    _assert_lexically_under(run_root, results_root)\n    _assert_lexically_under(evidence_root, run_root)\n    _assert_lexically_under(destination, evidence_root)\n\n    # 3. Reject escaping symlinks anywhere from results_root down to the key parent.\n    _reject_escaping_symlink(evidence_root, results_root)\n    _reject_escaping_symlink(destination.parent, results_root)\n\n    # 4.
